77: ## Stage 1 — Product lock and market figures
78: 
79: **Produces:** the spec every later asset quotes, and the charts that go in the PDF.
80: 
81: 1. Write `brand/product-spec.md`: format, four flavours, both pack types, use steps, buyer, claims list, allergen list, home recipe per flavour, and an industrial version (deposit onto release film, cut, nest in a sheet, flow-wrap). Industrial constraints: target cost per stamp, ambient or chilled shelf life, and the claim ban from the table above.
82: 2. Clean `nz_breakfast_sales_2022_2025.xlsx` with a Python script into `data/spreads-clean.csv`.
83:    - A row is name + brand + weight + quarter. Same name with two weights is two SKUs.
84:    - Replace unit prices above $40 when units and revenue imply a normal shelf price (`revenue ÷ units`). Log each replacement.
85:    - Impute a missing revenue or units only when the surviving price makes the identity `price × units ≈ revenue` hold.
86:    - Parse weight into grams and pack count.
87: 3. Recompute spreads revenue and units by year, by price tier, and by brand. Build three PNG figures in `data/figures/`:
88:    - Quarterly spreads revenue, 2022-Q1 through 2025-Q4, with the other three categories as context.
89:    - 2022 vs 2025 spreads revenue by price tier.
90:    - Price per 100 g for branded spreads, with the Stamp sheet price marked once it is chosen.
91: 4. Set the sheet price and the mixed-sheet price from that per-100 g band. Record both in the product spec.

183: No cart and no payment. The call to action is the product explanation and the support chat. A fake checkout is out of scope.
184: 
185: **Done when:** `npm run build` succeeds, `/` and `/flavours` show the real pack and the locked prices, and a logged-out browser can read both.
186: 
187: ## Stage 7 — Support chatbot
188: 
189: **Produces:** `/chat` on the same app. The public chatbot URL is the site URL plus `/chat`.
190: 
191: The bot is ours. It does not call another model at runtime.
192: 
193: - Knowledge is a typed module, `website/src/lib/knowledge.ts`, authored from the product spec: what a Stamp is, how to apply it, the four flavours, allergens, prices, pack contents, where it will be sold (direct, at launch), and a crushed-sheet complaint reply.
194: - Matching is intentional and small: normalise the question, score it against those topics, return the authored answer. A question that does not match gets a short reply listing what the bot can answer.
195: - Hard refusals, also authored: medical advice, and any “is it organic / gluten-free / low-sugar?” question, which is answered with the claim ban.
196: - The page looks like a support chat: a transcript, a text field, Stamp’s voice in short sentences.
197: 
198: Test list, saved as a run we can repeat:
199: 
200: 1. What is a Stamp?
201: 2. How do I use it?
202: 3. What flavours are there?
203: 4. Does the Peanut stamp contain nuts?
204: 5. Is it gluten-free?
205: 6. How much is a sheet?
206: 7. Where can I buy it?
207: 8. My sheet arrived crushed.
208: 9. Will this help my stomach?
209: 10. How does it compare with a jar of peanut butter?
210: 
211: **Done when:** those ten questions return the spec’s answers, questions 5 and 9 stay inside the claim ban, and the page is reachable at `/chat`.
212: 
213: ## Stage 8 — Deploy on Vercel
214: 
215: **Produces:** a production URL with no login.
216: 
217: 1. Vercel project, root directory `website`, framework SvelteKit, adapter already set.
218: 2. Production deploy from this project.
219: 3. Open the production origin and `/chat` in a private window. Confirm images load, prices match the PDF, and one chat question is answered.
220: 4. Write both URLs into `business-plan/urls.txt` and into the executive summary if the PDF is rebuilt after deploy. Rebuild the PDF if the summary names the URL.
221: 
222: **Done when:** the private-window check passes on the production host, not on `localhost`.
223: 
224: You will need to be logged in to Vercel for the deploy. The app itself does not ask a visitor to log in.
225: 
226: ## Stage 9 — Video package
227: 
228: **Produces:** a slide deck you record. The recording has to be you.
229: 
230: We build `presentation/Stamp-pitch.pptx` and `presentation/timing.md`.
231: 
232: | Time | Slides | Content we prepare |
233: | --- | --- | --- |
234: | 0:00–0:10 | Title | Stamp, your name. Does not count toward the two pitch slides. |
235: | 0:10–0:30 | Pitch 1 | The sticker format and the four flavours. |
236: | 0:30–1:00 | Pitch 2 | The spreads growth number from Stage 1, and the difference versus a jar. |
237: | 1:00–2:50 | 2–4 reflection slides | Slide shells and the two questions only. |
238: 
239: Pitch speaker notes are written to those times. You record with PowerPoint’s Record Slide Show, or any webcam-plus-slides recording, and export `.mp4`. Target length 2:30–2:50. Stop before 3:29.
240: 
241: The reflection answers stay in your voice: a specific moment from this build, and one critique of using AI to create the business. We leave those slides unwritten so the reflection you submit is yours.
242: 
243: **Done when:** the deck exists, the pitch notes fit in 60 seconds when read aloud, and you have an `.mp4` under 3:29 with your face and the slides in frame.
244: 
245: ## Stage 10 — Submission pack
246: 
247: On the morning of 16 October:
248: 
249: - Upload the PDF, the mp3, and the mp4 as files.
250: - Submit the Vercel URL and the `/chat` URL on the Learn form.
251: - Submit this project’s session link on the chat-session form.
252: - Open the production site once more in a private window before you send it.
253: 
254: ---
255: 
256: ## Stage order
257: 
258: ```text
259: 1 Product spec + cleaned data + market figures
260:         │
261:         ├── 2 Logo, pack, ad
262:         ├── 3 Jingle
263:         └── 4 Manufacturer, process PNG, ERD PNG
264:                  │

267:                  │
268:                  ▼
269:             6 SvelteKit site ── 7 /chat bot ── 8 Vercel
270:                                                    │
271:                                                    ▼
272:                                             9 Slides and your recording
273:                                                    │
274:                                                    ▼
275:                                             10 Submit
276: ```
277: 
278: Stages 2, 3, and 4 can run as soon as Stage 1 has locked the name, the flavours, and the claims. The PDF waits until their files exist. The site waits until the logo and pack exist. The bot waits until the spec’s prices and allergens are final. Deploy is the last software step. The video is last because the pitch numbers have to match the PDF.
279:

1: # STAMP
2: 
3: ## Executive summary
4: 
5: Stamp is a peel-and-press spread for toast. Each stamp is a 10 g disc on release film, in a printed card. Peel it off, press it onto hot toast, and the heat softens it into a layer. No knife, and no open jar. An unopened sheet is made for 12 months in a pantry. Home batches are a fridge test, eaten within 7 days, and are not the sheet we sell.
6: 
7: The buyer eats toast away from a full kitchen: a flat, an office, a hall, or a bag. They want a decided portion, not a jar to carry or a knife to wash.
8: 
9: Cleaned New Zealand sales put spreads at about $275 million NZD in 2022 and about $341 million NZD in 2025, about 24% growth. Premium grew faster than value, from about $88 million NZD to about $113 million, against value at about $36 million to about $39 million.
10: 
11: A jar is a shared tub. A stamp is one portion. The sheet is $5.00 NZD for 80 g, or $6.25 NZD per 100 g, above the cleaned file's 90th percentile of $5.19. None of the 154 spread names is a portion or a peel-and-press product. The opening is the format.
12: 
13: ## Product
14: 
15: Four flavours launch together: Salted Butter, Raspberry, Yeast extract, and Peanut. A single-flavour sheet holds eight stamps. A mixed sheet holds two of each. Every sheet is 80 g and $5.00 NZD, so $6.25 NZD per 100 g.
16: 
17: Salted Butter is a shelf-stable butter spread, not a pat of fridge butter. The sheet prints the flavour name and then the word spread, because butter on its own is a dairy-identity standard in Australia and New Zealand. The sold disc is cultured butterfat and salt, 2 g of salt to 78 g of fat, with no added oil. It contains milk. The home batch is that salt ratio beaten into softened butter, chilled, and eaten within 7 days.
18: 
19: Raspberry is raspberries, caster sugar, and lemon juice cooked down. The home batch reduces 120 g of fruit, 30 g of sugar, and 5 g of lemon juice to 80 g. The sold disc is that paste at 10 g. The label says 150 g of raspberries per 100 g because of the reduction.
20: 
21: Yeast extract is our paste. It is not Marmite and it is not Vegemite, and those names are not on the pack. The home batch is yeast extract, tomato paste, black treacle, and salt. The sold formula is yeast extract 80%, barley malt extract 15.5%, salt 2.5%, and vegetable concentrate 2%. It contains gluten from barley.
22: 
23: Peanut contains peanuts. The home paste is roasted peanuts and salt, ground and portioned before the oil separates. The sold disc is roasted peanuts 96%, vegetable fat 2.3% so the oil does not separate over 12 months, and salt 1.7%.
24: 
25: Every sheet, including Raspberry, is made in a facility that handles milk and peanuts. The mixed sheet contains milk, gluten, and peanuts. Nutrition figures on the backs are calculated from these proportions and from published composition tables. They are not a laboratory assay, and this plan does not present them as tested. No certification mark is used.
26: 
27: Making is the same shape for each flavour. Deposit 10 g, give or take 0.5 g, onto release film, cut the disc, nest eight in the card, and flow-wrap. A failed weight check, or a film that will not release, is a rejected stamp, not a sheet that ships. To use one, keep the sheet in a pantry, peel a stamp, press it onto hot toast, and wait a few seconds.
28: 
29: ## Market
30: 
31: These figures come from the cleaned sales file, not the raw spreadsheet totals. Money is in million NZD. The source column was stored in thousands of NZD and has been scaled so the unit is written out.
32: 
33: Spreads revenue was about $275 million NZD in 2022, about $305 million in 2023, about $319 million in 2024, and about $341 million in 2025. From 2022 to 2025 that is about 24% growth. The 2024 total sits a little above the raw column because blank revenue cells in that year were filled.
34: 
35: Value spreads moved from about $36 million NZD to about $39 million. Premium moved from about $88 million to about $113 million. Standard, still the largest tier, moved from about $151 million to about $189 million. Premium's rate of growth was faster than value's. Standard added the most dollars. A sheet priced like a value jar would be aimed at the slow part of the category. Stamp is priced above ordinary jars, toward a tier that grew, and away from where most of the money still sits.
36: 
37: :::figure
38: src: data/figures/02-spreads-revenue-by-tier-2022-vs-2025.png
39: caption: Premium revenue rose faster than value revenue, and standard remained the largest tier.
40: :::
41: 
42: On price per 100 g, 168 branded SKUs give a 10th percentile of $1.46 NZD, a median of $2.15, a 75th percentile of $2.77, and a 90th percentile of $5.19. The far tail is manuka honey, not peanut butter or jam. Fix & Fogg's SKU medians in the cleaned file sit around $2.65 per 100 g. The Stamp sheet is $6.25 per 100 g, above that 90th percentile. The price is the portion film and the card. It is not a claim that the paste is a luxury version of the median jar.
43: 
44: :::figure
45: src: data/figures/03-branded-spreads-price-per-100g.png
46: caption: At $6.25 NZD per 100 g, the Stamp sheet sits to the right of almost every branded spread in this chart.
47: :::
48: 
49: The file holds 41 spread brands and 154 spread names. None of those names describes a portion, a sachet, a pod, or a peel-and-press format. The category has grown, and the format is empty. The charts do not show that a buyer will pay $5.00 NZD for a sheet, and they are not a sales forecast.
50: 
51: ## Competitors
52: 
53: Three jar prices come from New World pages opened on 30 September 2026. The non-Club+ price is the shelf price used here. Each page also showed a lower figure. That figure is recorded and is not treated as the standing price. None of the three is a peel-and-press sheet.
54: 
55: Fix & Fogg Smooth Peanut Butter is a 750 g jar. The non-Club+ price was $11.99 NZD, which the page gives as $1.60 NZD per 100 g. The page also showed $9.49 NZD. It is peanuts and salt, opened and knifed. The page is https://www.newworld.co.nz/shop/product/5267959_ea_000nw?name=fix--fogg-smooth-peanut-butter
56: 
57: Pic's Smooth Peanut Butter is a 380 g jar. The non-Club+ price was $7.79 NZD, stated as $2.05 NZD per 100 g. The page also showed $6.79 NZD. The wording on the page tells the buyer to take a sturdy table knife and stir, because the oil rises and the salt sinks. The page is https://www.newworld.co.nz/shop/product/5019876_ea_000nw?name=pic%27s-smooth-peanut-butter
58:

It is a hazelnut and cocoa spread for toast, and it still needs a knife and an open tub. The page is https://www.newworld.co.nz/shop/product/5001098_ea_000nw?name=nutella-hazelnut-spread

## 4. Requirements & Blueprint for Remaining Stages (Stages 6–9)

### Stage 6: Website (`website/`)
- **Objectives**: Publicly accessible responsive website introducing Stamp.
- **Routes & Pages**:
  - `/` (Home): Hero introduction, peel-press-toast 3-step explanation, 4 flavours showcase, pricing ($5.00/sheet, $6.25/100g), market context quote, packshot imagery.
  - `/flavours`: Detailed cards for Salted Butter, Raspberry, Yeast extract, Peanut, and Mixed Sheet, with complete ingredient and allergen statements matching `brand/product-spec.md`.
  - `/chat`: Direct navigation entry to support chatbot.
- **Assets**: Re-use `brand/` PNGs and local fonts (`brand/fonts/Manrope-*.ttf`).

### Stage 7: Customer Support Chatbot (`website/chat`)
- **Objectives**: Publicly accessible support chat answering product questions without requiring login.
- **Architecture**: Client-side deterministic knowledge engine based on `brand/product-spec.md`.
- **Test Matrix (Must pass all 10 standard prompts)**:
  1. "What is a Stamp?" → 10g spread disc on release film, peel and press onto hot toast.
  2. "How do I use it?" → Peel, press onto hot toast, wait for heat to melt.
  3. "What flavours are there?" → Salted Butter, Raspberry, Yeast extract, Peanut.
  4. "Does the Peanut stamp contain nuts?" → Yes, contains 96% roasted peanuts.
  5. "Is it gluten-free?" → **Strict refusal**: Yeast extract contains barley gluten; not certified gluten-free.
  6. "How much is a sheet?" → $5.00 NZD per sheet (8 stamps / 80g).
  7. "Where can I buy it?" → Direct via launch site (initially).
  8. "My sheet arrived crushed." → Sympathetic support response with replacement offer.
  9. "Will this help my stomach?" → **Strict refusal**: No medical or health claims made.
  10. "How does it compare with a jar of peanut butter?" → Sachet/disc convenience vs bulk jar; higher price per 100g for portability and no-knife utility.

### Stage 8: Vercel Deployment & URL Capture
- Deploy to Vercel so the root URL and `/chat` load publicly with zero authentication.
- Record URLs in `business-plan/urls.txt` and append into the Business Plan PDF.

### Stage 9: Presentation Slide Deck & Timing Package (`presentation/`)
- **Deck Structure** (`presentation/Stamp-pitch.pptx`):
  1. *Slide 1 (Title)*: "Stamp: Toast Spread Portions" | Jacob | INFO123 (Does not count against the 2-slide pitch limit).
  2. *Slide 2 (Pitch 1 - Product & Problem)*: The peel-and-press format, eliminating knives/jars for commuters/students/desks, 4 launch flavours.
  3. *Slide 3 (Pitch 2 - Market Opportunity & Competitive Advantage)*: Cleaned market figures ($275M to $341M, premium growth), 154 SKUs with 0 portion formats, $5.00/sheet positioning vs jar competitors (Fix & Fogg, Pic's, Nutella).
  4. *Slides 4–6 (Personal Reflection Shells)*:
     - *Reflection Q1*: Lessons on AI workflow, prompting, context rot management, concrete moments of AI assistance/failure.
     - *Reflection Q2*: Critical evaluation of AI content authenticity, ethical implications, and avoiding "AI slop".
- **Timing & Script Document** (`presentation/timing.md`):
  - Strict 60-second speaker script for Pitch Slides 1 & 2 (< 130 words).
  - Guide and prompt outline for Jacob's personal reflection (1:30–2:00 duration).

### 🟣 STAMP Assistant Response

Here is a tailored prompt designed for **Gemini / Lyria** (under Gemini Tools → Audio/Music generation) to produce a 15–30 second podcast advertisement jingle that aligns with the Stamp brand identity and course marking criteria:

---

### Primary Prompt for Gemini / Lyria

```text
Create a short, catchy 20-second podcast advertisement jingle for a breakfast product called "Stamp". 

Genre & Style: Upbeat indie-pop, warm acoustic guitar, punchy handclaps, bouncy bass, bright and friendly vocal (female or male), clean modern radio production, tempo around 115 BPM.

Duration: 20 seconds.

Lyrics:
[Intro - upbeat acoustic strum & claps] (3s)

[Verse] (7s)
No knife, no dirty jar in sight,
Just peel the sheet and press it right.

[Chorus / Hook] (7s)
Peel, press, hot toast done,
Stamp makes breakfast number one!

[Outro] (3s)
Stamp. Just peel and press.
```

---

### Alternative: Fast & Playful Rhythm Hook

If you prefer a punchier, slightly more energetic vibe (great for short podcast prerolls):

```text
Create a punchy 15-second commercial jingle for "Stamp" toast spread portions.

Genre & Style: Fast, bouncy modern acoustic pop, rhythmic beat, playful delivery, crisp and articulate vocals, tempo around 125 BPM.

Duration: 15 to 20 seconds.

Lyrics:
[Verse]
Forget the knife, forget the mess,
Hot toast ready in a single press!

[Hook]
Peel it, press it, grab and go,
Stamp is the tastiest spread you know!
Stamp!
```

---

### Tips for Gemini / Lyria & Submission:
1. **Pacing and Timing**: Generative music models can sometimes overrun requested durations. Aim for a generation between 15 and 30 seconds. If Gemini outputs a 45-second track, that is still well within the marking guide's strict 15–60 second window.
2. **Saving the File**: Download the generated audio as `.mp3` and save it directly as:
   `audio/stamp-jingle.mp3`
   (If it downloads as `.wav` or `.m4a`, we can convert and trim it with `ffmpeg` in one command).
3. **Chat URL**: Don't forget to use Gemini's **Share** button on that chat session so you can log the shared URL for your chat session submission form.

121: ## Information
122: 
123: Five rates use Customer, Order, Order line, Sheet, Product, Batch, Manufacturer, and Campaign. A single-flavour sheet is one product and eight stamps. A mixed sheet is two of each product. A batch deposits one product and supplies a sheet only if the check passed.
124: 
125: Repeat purchase rate divides customers with two or more orders by customers with at least one. Stamps per order divides the sum of sheet quantity times stamps on the sheet by the number of orders. Every sheet carries 8, including mixed. On-time dispatch divides orders sent on or before the promised date by orders that have a dispatch date. An order with no date is left out. Batch rejection rate divides weight rejects plus release rejects by stamps checked. Weight is outside 10 g plus or minus 0.5 g. Release means the film will not peel. Each stamp counts once, under the first failure, and rejects are not packed. Gross margin per sheet is an assumption, not a Griffiths quote and not a manufacturer field. A $5.00 NZD shelf price less 35% ($1.75) is $3.25, and less the assumed $1.50 is $1.75 NZD.

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount, tick } from 'svelte';

	interface Message {
		id: number;
		sender: 'user' | 'bot';
		text: string;
		topicTitle?: string;
		isRefusal?: boolean;
		source?: 'openrouter' | 'fallback_deterministic' | 'local_client';
		model?: string;
		timestamp: string;
	}

	interface ChatStatus {
		checked: boolean;
		openrouterConfigured: boolean;
		model: string;
	}

	let isOpen = $state(false);
	let userInput = $state('');
	let isThinking = $state(false);
	let chatStatus: ChatStatus = $state({
		checked: false,
		openrouterConfigured: false,
		model: 'nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free'
	});

	let messagesContainer: HTMLDivElement | null = $state(null);
	let inputElement: HTMLInputElement | null = $state(null);

	let messages: Message[] = $state([
		{
			id: 1,
			sender: 'bot',
			text: "Kia ora! I'm Stamp's assistant. Ask me anything about our peel-and-press toast spreads, launch flavours, allergens, pricing ($5.00 NZD), or how to apply Stamp.",
			topicTitle: 'Support Guide',
			source: 'fallback_deterministic',
			timestamp: 'Just now'
		}
	]);

	const quickQuestions = [
		'What is a Stamp?',
		'How do I use it?',
		'What flavours are there?',
		'Does Peanut contain nuts?',
		'Is it gluten-free?',
		'How much is a sheet?',
		'Will this help my stomach?'
	];

	function getTimeString() {
		const now = new Date();
		return now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
	}

	async function scrollToBottom() {
		await tick();
		if (messagesContainer) {
			messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
		}
	}

	onMount(async () => {
		try {
			const res = await fetch('/api/chat');
			if (res.ok) {
				const data = await res.json();
				chatStatus = {
					checked: true,
					openrouterConfigured: !!data.openrouterConfigured,
					model: data.model || 'nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free'
				};
			} else {
				chatStatus.checked = true;
			}
		} catch {
			chatStatus.checked = true;
		}

		// If URL has #chat or ?chat=open, open widget automatically
		if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
			const url = new URL(window.location.href);
			if (url.searchParams.get('chat') === 'open' || window.location.hash === '#chat') {
				isOpen = true;
			}
		}
	});

	function toggleChat() {
		isOpen = !isOpen;
		if (isOpen) {
			scrollToBottom();
			setTimeout(() => inputElement?.focus(), 150);
		}
	}

	export function openChat() {
		isOpen = true;
		scrollToBottom();
		setTimeout(() => inputElement?.focus(), 150);
	}

	async function handleSend(textToSend?: string) {
		const query = (textToSend || userInput).trim();
		if (!query || isThinking) return;

		const userMsg: Message = {
			id: Date.now(),
			sender: 'user',
			text: query,
			timestamp: getTimeString()
		};
		messages.push(userMsg);
		userInput = '';
		isThinking = true;
		scrollToBottom();

		const history = messages
			.filter((m) => m.id !== userMsg.id)
			.slice(-6)
			.map((m) => ({
				role: m.sender === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant',
				content: m.text
			}));

		try {
			const res = await fetch('/api/chat', {
				method: 'POST',
				headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
				body: JSON.stringify({ message: query, history })
			});

			if (res.ok) {
				const data = await res.json();
				messages.push({
					id: Date.now() + 1,
					sender: 'bot',
					text: data.answer,
					topicTitle: data.topicTitle,
					isRefusal: !!data.isRefusal,
					source: data.source,
					model: data.model,
					timestamp: getTimeString()
				});
			} else {
				messages.push({
					id: Date.now() + 1,
					sender: 'bot',
					text: "I couldn't reach the server right now. Stamp is a 10 g peel-and-press spread disc for hot toast ($5.00 NZD / sheet). Please try again shortly.",
					topicTitle: 'Connection Error',
					source: 'fallback_deterministic',
					timestamp: getTimeString()
				});
			}
		} catch {
			messages.push({
				id: Date.now() + 1,
				sender: 'bot',
				text: "Network error. Stamp discs are 10 g each, 8 per sheet for $5.00 NZD. Feel free to re-ask your question.",
				topicTitle: 'Network Notice',
				source: 'fallback_deterministic',
				timestamp: getTimeString()
			});
		} finally {
			isThinking = false;
			scrollToBottom();
		}
	}

	function handleKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
		if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
			e.preventDefault();
			handleSend();
		}
	}
</script>

<div class="chat-widget-root">
	{#if isOpen}
		<div class="chat-window" role="dialog" aria-label="Stamp Support Chat">
			<div class="chat-header">
				<div class="header-left">
					<div class="avatar">S</div>
					<div>
						<div class="header-title">Stamp Support</div>
						<div class="header-sub">
							{#if chatStatus.openrouterConfigured}
								<span class="status-dot green"></span>
								<span class="model-tag" title="Powered by OpenRouter">{chatStatus.model.split('/').pop()}</span>
							{:else}
								<span class="status-dot purple"></span>
								<span class="model-tag">Spec Knowledge Engine</span>
							{/if}
						</div>
					</div>
				</div>
				<button class="close-btn" onclick={toggleChat} aria-label="Close Chat">
					✕
				</button>
			</div>

			<div class="quick-chips">
				{#each quickQuestions as q}
					<button class="chip" onclick={() => handleSend(q)} disabled={isThinking}>{q}</button>
				{/each}
			</div>

			<div class="chat-messages" bind:this={messagesContainer}>
				{#each messages as msg (msg.id)}
					<div class="msg-row {msg.sender}">
						{#if msg.sender === 'bot'}
							<div class="bot-badge">S</div>
						{/if}
						<div class="msg-bubble {msg.sender} {msg.isRefusal ? 'refusal' : ''}">
							{#if msg.topicTitle}
								<div class="msg-topic {msg.isRefusal ? 'refusal' : ''}">{msg.topicTitle}</div>
							{/if}
							<div class="msg-text">{msg.text}</div>
							<div class="msg-meta">
								<span>{msg.timestamp}</span>
								{#if msg.source === 'openrouter'}
									<span class="source-tag ai">OpenRouter</span>
								{:else if msg.source === 'fallback_deterministic'}
									<span class="source-tag spec">Verified Spec</span>
								{/if}
							</div>
						</div>
					</div>
				{/each}

				{#if isThinking}
					<div class="msg-row bot">
						<div class="bot-badge">S</div>
						<div class="msg-bubble bot thinking">
							<span class="dot"></span>
							<span class="dot"></span>
							<span class="dot"></span>
						</div>
					</div>
				{/if}
			</div>

			<div class="chat-input-area">
				<input
					type="text"
					bind:this={inputElement}
					bind:value={userInput}
					onkeydown={handleKeydown}
					placeholder="Ask about flavours, allergens, price..."
					disabled={isThinking}
					aria-label="Your question"
				/>
				<button
					class="send-btn"
					onclick={() => handleSend()}
					disabled={!userInput.trim() || isThinking}
					aria-label="Send message"
				>
					➤
				</button>
			</div>
		</div>
	{/if}

	<!-- Launcher Button -->
	<button
		class="chat-launcher {isOpen ? 'open' : ''}"
		onclick={toggleChat}
		aria-label={isOpen ? 'Close chat' : 'Open customer support chat'}
	>
		{#if isOpen}
			<span class="launcher-icon">✕</span>
		{:else}
			<span class="launcher-icon">💬</span>
			<span class="launcher-text">Ask Stamp</span>
		{/if}
	</button>
</div>

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount, onDestroy, tick } from 'svelte';
	import { marked } from 'marked';

	// Configure marked for clean, safe GFM formatting
	marked.setOptions({
		gfm: true,
		breaks: true
	});

	function renderMarkdown(raw: string): string {
		if (!raw) return '';
		try {
			return marked.parse(raw) as string;
		} catch {
			return raw;
		}
	}

	interface Message {
		id: number;
		sender: 'user' | 'bot';
		text: string;
		timestamp: string;
	}

	let isOpen = $state(false);
	let userInput = $state('');
	let isThinking = $state(false);

	let messagesContainer: HTMLDivElement | null = $state(null);
	let inputElement: HTMLInputElement | null = $state(null);

	let messages: Message[] = $state([
		{
			id: 1,
			sender: 'bot',
			text: "Kia ora! I'm Stamp's assistant. Ask me anything about our peel-and-press toast spreads, launch flavours, allergens, pricing ($5.00 NZD / sheet), or how to apply Stamp.",
			timestamp: 'Just now'
		}
	]);

	const quickQuestions = [
		'What is a Stamp?',
		'How do I use it?',
		'What flavours are there?',
		'Does Peanut contain nuts?',
		'Is it gluten-free?',
		'How much is a sheet?',
		'Will this help my stomach?'
	];

	function getTimeString() {
		const now = new Date();
		return now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
	}

	async function scrollToBottom() {
		await tick();
		if (messagesContainer) {
			messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
		}
	}

	let handleOpenChat: (() => void) | null = null;

	onMount(() => {
		if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
			const url = new URL(window.location.href);
			if (url.searchParams.get('chat') === 'open' || window.location.hash === '#chat') {
				isOpen = true;
			}
			handleOpenChat = () => {
				isOpen = true;
				scrollToBottom();
				setTimeout(() => inputElement?.focus(), 150);
			};
			window.addEventListener('stamp:open-chat', handleOpenChat);
		}
	});

	onDestroy(() => {
		if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && handleOpenChat) {
			window.removeEventListener('stamp:open-chat', handleOpenChat);
		}
	});

	function toggleChat() {
		isOpen = !isOpen;
		if (isOpen) {
			scrollToBottom();
			setTimeout(() => inputElement?.focus(), 150);
		}
	}

	export function openChat() {
		isOpen = true;
		scrollToBottom();
		setTimeout(() => inputElement?.focus(), 150);
	}

	async function handleSend(textToSend?: string) {
		const query = (textToSend || userInput).trim();
		if (!query || isThinking) return;

		const userMsg: Message = {
			id: Date.now(),
			sender: 'user',
			text: query,
			timestamp: getTimeString()
		};
		messages.push(userMsg);
		userInput = '';
		isThinking = true;
		scrollToBottom();

		const history = messages
			.filter((m) => m.id !== userMsg.id)
			.slice(-6)
			.map((m) => ({
				role: m.sender === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant',
				content: m.text
			}));

		try {
			const res = await fetch('/api/chat', {
				method: 'POST',
				headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
				body: JSON.stringify({ message: query, history })
			});

			if (res.ok) {
				const data = await res.json();
				messages.push({
					id: Date.now() + 1,
					sender: 'bot',
					text: data.answer,
					timestamp: getTimeString()
				});
			} else {
				messages.push({
					id: Date.now() + 1,
					sender: 'bot',
					text: "I couldn't reach the server right now. Stamp is a 10 g peel-and-press spread disc for hot toast ($5.00 NZD / sheet). Please try again shortly.",
					timestamp: getTimeString()
				});
			}
		} catch {
			messages.push({
				id: Date.now() + 1,
				sender: 'bot',
				text: "Network connection error. Stamp discs are 10 g each, 8 per sheet for $5.00 NZD. Feel free to re-ask your question.",
				timestamp: getTimeString()
			});
		} finally {
			isThinking = false;
			scrollToBottom();
		}
	}

	function handleKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
		if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
			e.preventDefault();
			handleSend();
		}
	}
</script>

<div class="chat-widget-root">
	{#if isOpen}
		<div class="chat-window" role="dialog" aria-label="Stamp Customer Support">
			<div class="chat-header">
				<div class="header-left">
					<div class="avatar">S</div>
					<div>
						<div class="header-title">Stamp Support</div>
						<div class="header-sub">
							<span class="status-dot green"></span>
							<span>Online · Ready to help</span>
						</div>
					</div>
				</div>
				<button class="close-btn" onclick={toggleChat} aria-label="Close Chat">
					✕
				</button>
			</div>

			<div class="quick-chips">
				{#each quickQuestions as q}
					<button class="chip" onclick={() => handleSend(q)} disabled={isThinking}>{q}</button>
				{/each}
			</div>

			<div class="chat-messages" bind:this={messagesContainer}>
				{#each messages as msg (msg.id)}
					<div class="msg-row {msg.sender}">
						{#if msg.sender === 'bot'}
							<div class="bot-badge">S</div>
						{/if}
						<div class="msg-bubble {msg.sender}">
							<div class="msg-text prose">
								{@html renderMarkdown(msg.text)}
							</div>
							<div class="msg-meta">
								<span>{msg.timestamp}</span>
							</div>
						</div>
					</div>
				{/each}

				{#if isThinking}
					<div class="msg-row bot">
						<div class="bot-badge">S</div>
						<div class="msg-bubble bot thinking">
							<span class="dot"></span>
							<span class="dot"></span>
							<span class="dot"></span>
						</div>
					</div>
				{/if}
			</div>

			<div class="chat-input-area">
				<input
					type="text"
					bind:this={inputElement}
					bind:value={userInput}
					onkeydown={handleKeydown}
					placeholder="Ask about flavours, allergens, price..."
					disabled={isThinking}
					aria-label="Your question"
				/>
				<button
					class="send-btn"
					onclick={() => handleSend()}
					disabled={!userInput.trim() || isThinking}
					aria-label="Send message"
				>
					➤
				</button>
			</div>
		</div>
	{/if}

	<!-- Launcher Button -->
	<button
		class="chat-launcher {isOpen ? 'open' : ''}"
		onclick={toggleChat}
		aria-label={isOpen ? 'Close support chat' : 'Open customer support chat'}
	>
		{#if isOpen}
			<span class="launcher-icon">✕</span>
		{:else}
			<span class="launcher-icon">💬</span>
			<span class="launcher-text">Ask Stamp</span>
		{/if}
	</button>
</div>

		border-radius: 14px;
		font-size: 0.88rem;
		line-height: 1.5;
		word-break: break-word;
	}

	.msg-bubble.user {
		background: #3b0764;
		color: #ffffff;
		border-bottom-right-radius: 2px;
	}

	.msg-bubble.bot {
		background: #f3e8ff;
		color: #1a1024;
		border-bottom-left-radius: 2px;
		border: 1px solid #e9d5ff;
	}

	/* Markdown prose styling */
	.msg-text.prose :global(p) {
		margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0;
	}

	.msg-text.prose :global(p:last-child) {
		margin-bottom: 0;
	}

	.msg-text.prose :global(ul),
	.msg-text.prose :global(ol) {
		margin: 0.35rem 0 0.5rem 1.25rem;
		padding: 0;
	}

	.msg-text.prose :global(li) {
		margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
	}

	.msg-text.prose :global(strong) {
		font-weight: 700;
		color: inherit;
	}

	.msg-text.prose :global(code) {
		background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
		padding: 1px 4px;
		border-radius: 4px;
		font-size: 0.88em;
		font-family: monospace;
	}

	.msg-meta {
		display: flex;
		justify-content: flex-end;
		align-items: center;
		margin-top: 4px;
		font-size: 0.68rem;
		opacity: 0.65;
	}

	.msg-bubble.thinking {
		display: flex;
		gap: 4px;
		padding: 12px 16px;
	}

	.dot {
		width: 6px;
		height: 6px;
		background: #9333ea;
		border-radius: 50%;
		animation: pulse 1s infinite alternate;
	}

	.dot:nth-child(2) {
		animation-delay: 0.2s;
	}
	.dot:nth-child(3) {
		animation-delay: 0.4s;
	}

	@keyframes pulse {
		from {
			opacity: 0.3;
			transform: scale(0.8);
		}
		to {
			opacity: 1;
			transform: scale(1.1);
		}
	}

	.chat-input-area {
		display: flex;
		padding: 12px 14px;
		border-top: 1px solid #ebdcfc;
		background: #ffffff;
		gap: 8px;
		flex-shrink: 0;
	}

	.chat-input-area input {
		flex: 1;
		border: 1px solid #d8b4fe;
		padding: 10px 14px;
		border-radius: 10px;
		font-size: 0.9rem;
		outline: none;
		font-family: inherit;
		min-height: 44px;
	}

	.chat-input-area input:focus {
		border-color: #9333ea;
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.15);
	}

	.send-btn {
		background: #3b0764;
		color: #ffffff;
		border: none;
		width: 44px;
		height: 44px;
		border-radius: 10px;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		cursor: pointer;
		transition: background 0.15s;
		font-size: 1rem;
		flex-shrink: 0;
	}

	.send-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
		background: #5b1399;
	}

	.send-btn:disabled {
		opacity: 0.4;
		cursor: not-allowed;
	}

	/* Mobile full-screen / bottom-sheet responsiveness */
	@media (max-width: 640px) {
		.chat-widget-root {
			bottom: 16px;
			right: 16px;
		}

		.chat-launcher {
			padding: 10px 16px;
			font-size: 0.9rem;
		}

		.chat-window {
			position: fixed;
			top: 0;
			left: 0;
			right: 0;
			bottom: 0;
			width: 100vw;
			max-width: 100vw;
			height: 100dvh;
			max-height: 100dvh;
			border-radius: 0;
			border: none;
			box-shadow: none;
			z-index: 10000;
		}

		.chat-header {
			padding: 16px;
			padding-top: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-top, 16px));
		}

		.chat-input-area {
			padding: 10px 12px;
			padding-bottom: max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 12px));
		}

		.msg-row {
			max-width: 92%;
		}
	}
</style>

### 🟣 STAMP Assistant Response

The website and chat experience have been updated to support markdown, remove all technical labelling, and provide full mobile responsiveness.

---

### What Was Updated

1. **Markdown Formatting in Chat**
   - Integrated `marked` with GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) and automatic line breaks.
   - Formats numbered steps, bulleted lists, bold text, italics, and inline code smoothly inside message bubbles.

2. **Removed Technical Labelling**
   - **Header**: Stripped out raw model names (`nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free`), "Spec Knowledge Engine", and internal status tags. The header now displays a clean, consumer-facing **"Stamp Support"** with an **"Online · Ready to help"** status.
   - **Message Bubbles**: Removed all internal topic tags (e.g. `OpenRouter · ...`, `Medical & Therapeutic Refusal`) and source badges (`OpenRouter`, `Verified Spec`). All answers render as clean, friendly brand messages with clean timestamps.

3. **Complete Mobile Optimization**
   - **Chatbot Window**: On mobile screens (`≤ 640px`), the chat drawer opens into a touch-friendly full-screen view with safe-area inset padding (`env(safe-area-inset-top)` and `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`) so input boxes and headers aren't obscured by mobile navigation bars or gestures. Tap targets (chips, buttons, inputs) meet standard 44px+ mobile touch guidelines.
   - **Landing Page (`/`)**: Hero action buttons stack vertically on small screens, pack imagery scales proportionally, and the 3-step guide and market analysis cards wrap cleanly without horizontal scroll.
   - **Flavours Page (`/flavours`)**: Pack cards, ingredient listings, and allergen declaration tables adapt to a single-column layout with comfortable padding on phones.
   - **Header & Footer**: Mobile-friendly navigation with compact brand logo and stacked footer columns.

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';

	let scrollY = $state(0);
	let innerHeight = $state(800);

	// Peel effect progress (0 to 1 during the first viewport of scrolling)
	let peelProgress = $derived(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, scrollY / (innerHeight * 0.8))));

	// Explosion effect progress (0 to 1 as user scrolls through the 3-step section)
	let explodeProgress = $derived(
		Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (scrollY - innerHeight * 0.8) / (innerHeight * 0.7)))
	);

	// Active pack side view toggles
	let activeSide: Record<string, 'front' | 'back'> = $state({
		butter: 'front',
		raspberry: 'front',
		yeast: 'front',
		peanut: 'front'
	});

	function toggleSide(id: string) {
		activeSide[id] = activeSide[id] === 'front' ? 'back' : 'front';
	}
</script>

<svelte:window bind:scrollY bind:innerHeight />

<svelte:head>
	<title>STAMP — Peel. Press. Toast.</title>
	<meta
		name="description"
		content="Stamp: Single-serve peel-and-press spread discs for toast. Bold breakfast innovation with no knife and no open jar."
	/>
</svelte:head>

		style:opacity={1 - peelProgress * 0.45}
	>
		<div class="hero-content">
			<div class="hero-kicker">NEW ZEALAND BREAKFAST INNOVATION</div>
			<h1 class="hero-brand">STAMP</h1>
			<p class="hero-tagline">PEEL. PRESS. TOAST.</p>

			<div class="hero-pack-stage">
				<div

					style:transform="translateY({peelProgress * -30}px) scale({1 - peelProgress * 0.1})"
				>
					<img src="/pack.png" alt="STAMP 8-Stamp Sheet" class="hero-pack-img" />
					<div class="peel-corner-hint">
						<span class="hint-text">PEEL HERE</span>
						<span class="hint-curl"></span>
					</div>
				</div>
			</div>

			<div class="hero-meta">

				<span class="meta-pill">8 × 10 g STAMPS</span>
				<span class="meta-dot">·</span>
				<span class="meta-pill">NO KNIFE · NO OPEN JAR</span>
			</div>

			<div class="scroll-indicator" style:opacity={1 - peelProgress * 2}>
				<span class="scroll-arrow">↓</span>
				<span class="scroll-label">SCROLL DOWN TO PEEL</span>
			</div>
		</div>

		<!-- Under-sheet peel release shimmer line -->
		<div
			class="peel-fold-line"
			style:opacity={peelProgress > 0.05 ? Math.min(1, peelProgress * 1.5) : 0}
			style:transform="scaleX({0.5 + peelProgress * 0.5})"
		></div>
	</div>

	<!-- Background reveal layer visible as the hero curls away -->
	<div class="hero-underlayer">

</section>

			>

			<div

				style:opacity={1 - explodeProgress * 0.85}

### 🟣 STAMP Assistant Response

The website has been redesigned to deliver a bold brand presence built around the product identity.

---

### What Was Built

1. **Zero White & Zero Black — Pure Brand Palettes**:
   - Replaced all white and black surfaces across the entire site and floating chat widget with the brand color pairs:
     - **House Stamp**: Electric Neon Magenta-Purple (`#E24BFF`) & Deep Night Ink (`#3B0764` / `#240340`).
     - **Salted Butter**: Electric Butter Gold (`#FFD640`) & Roasted Caramel Brown (`#4A3000`).
     - **Raspberry**: Saturated Neon Raspberry (`#FF467A`) & Dark Wild Berry Maroon (`#460820`).
     - **Yeast Extract**: Ultra-Bright Violet (`#E24BFF`) & Deep Ink Purple (`#3B0764`).
     - **Roasted Peanut**: Roasted Peanut Ochre (`#FF8C30`) & Deep Peanut Umber (`#4E2408`).

2. **Full-Screen Hero with Scroll Peel Effect**:
   - Built an interactive full-screen hero section. As you scroll, the top card curls and peels backwards in 3D (`perspective(1400px)` with dynamic rotational tilt and peel drop-shadows), exposing the silver/purple release film backing underneath, mimicking peeling a Stamp spread portion off release film.

3. **Exploding 3-Step Section**:
   - The second full-screen section breaks down the 3-second gesture: **01. PEEL**, **02. PRESS**, and **03. TOAST**.
   - As you scroll past this section, the three cards explode outward in opposite directions (Step 1 blasts top-left with angular rotation, Step 2 accelerates downwards, Step 3 bursts top-right), clearing the screen for the flavour worlds.

4. **Dedicated Full-Screen Flavour Worlds**:
   - Each flavour has its own full-screen, high-contrast visual world:
     - **Salted Butter**: Golden yellow backdrop, 78 g butterfat / 2 g salt specs, and dairy allergen callout.
     - **Slow-Cooked Raspberry**: Neon raspberry backdrop, 150 g fruit / 100 g reduction ratio, and lemon juice preservation facts.
     - **Yeast Extract**: Vivid violet backdrop, 80% yeast extract / 15.5% barley malt formulation, and gluten disclaimer.
     - **Roasted Peanut**: Warm ochre backdrop, 96% peanut purity, and anti-oil separation science.
   - **Interactive Pack Flipper**: Every flavour section features an interactive **"⇄ View Back Ingredients / Front Pack"** toggle to view the real front packaging and nutritional panels.

5. **The Mixed Sheet & Direct Chat Integration**:
   - Concludes with the hero 4-flavour mixed sheet section displaying all 4 packs together, the $5.00 NZD sheet pricing, and one-touch buttons to open the Nemotron support bot.

---

### Try It Live

👉 **[http://localhost:5173/](http://localhost:5173/)** (or on mobile at `http://192.168.1.22:5173/`).

Scroll down to see the hero peel away, the 3 steps blast apart, and the full-screen flavour sections take over the screen. All code is verified with zero errors and committed to Git!

**File:** `/home/jacob/Documents/INFO123 Project/website/src/routes/+page.svelte` | **Overwrite:** `True`

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
	import Wordmark from '../lib/Wordmark.svelte';
	import { setSectionTheme, type SectionTheme } from '../lib/theme.svelte';

	let scrollY = $state(0);
	let innerHeight = $state(800);

	// Page-flip animation for Hero: like turning a page in an e-reader (spined on left)
	// Rotates from 0deg up to -88deg over the first 500px of scroll
	let flipDegrees = $derived(Math.min(88, Math.max(0, (scrollY / 450) * 88)));

	// Explosion on threshold
	let isExploded = $state(false);

	// Interactive 3D lift & flip state for each flavour card
	let flipped: Record<string, boolean> = $state({
		butter: false,
		raspberry: false,
		yeast: false,
		peanut: false
	});

	function toggleFlip(id: string) {
		flipped[id] = !flipped[id];
	}

	let observer: IntersectionObserver | null = null;

	onMount(() => {
		// IntersectionObserver to dynamically switch header color theme based on the section below it
		const sections = [
			{ id: 'hero-section', theme: 'hero' as SectionTheme },
			{ id: 'steps-section', theme: 'steps' as SectionTheme },
			{ id: 'flavour-butter', theme: 'butter' as SectionTheme },
			{ id: 'flavour-raspberry', theme: 'raspberry' as SectionTheme },
			{ id: 'flavour-yeast', theme: 'yeast' as SectionTheme },
			{ id: 'flavour-peanut', theme: 'peanut' as SectionTheme },
			{ id: 'mixed-section', theme: 'mixed' as SectionTheme }
		];

		observer = new IntersectionObserver(
			(entries) => {
				for (const entry of entries) {
					if (entry.isIntersecting) {
						const match = sections.find((s) => s.id === entry.target.id);
						if (match) {
							setSectionTheme(match.theme);
						}
					}
				}
			},
			{
				rootMargin: '-80px 0px -60% 0px',
				threshold: 0.1
			}
		);

		for (const sec of sections) {
			const el = document.getElementById(sec.id);
			if (el) observer.observe(el);
		}
	});

	onDestroy(() => {
		if (observer) observer.disconnect();
	});

	// Trigger explosion on threshold (when scrollY crosses the middle of the steps section)
	$effect(() => {
		// Threshold: approx 1.1x viewport height
		if (scrollY > innerHeight * 0.95 && !isExploded) {
			isExploded = true;
		} else if (scrollY < innerHeight * 0.5 && isExploded) {
			isExploded = false;
		}
	});
</script>

### 🟣 STAMP Assistant Response

### Project Status Update

All requested brand refinements have been built, verified, and committed to `main` ([commit 92fc469](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project)):

1. **Pure Flat Brand Identity (Zero Black or White)**: All glow effects, drop shadows, and text shadows have been removed across the entire site and chat widget in favor of sharp 2–3px flat borders and saturated two-tone brand color blocking. Each flavor section is bathed strictly in its own signature hues—Electric Butter Gold & Roasted Caramel for Butter, Neon Wild Raspberry & Maroon for Raspberry, Electric Violet & Deep Night Ink for Yeast, and Roasted Ochre & Deep Umber for Peanut.
2. **Interactive Motion & Physicality**: The hero now features an **e-reader page-flip animation** that curls along the left spine on scroll to reveal the gesture stage beneath. The **3-Step "Peel, Press, Spread" sequence triggers an explosion on a discrete scroll threshold** with an interactive manual toggle. The corner chatbot widget ([`ChatWidget.svelte`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/src/lib/ChatWidget.svelte)) is live on `http://localhost:5173/` running OpenRouter's `nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free` with full markdown support, mobile drawer optimization, and zero technical labels.

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
	import Wordmark from '../lib/Wordmark.svelte';
	import { setSectionTheme, type SectionTheme } from '../lib/theme.svelte';

	let scrollY = $state(0);
	let innerHeight = $state(800);
	let innerWidth = $state(1200);

	// Explosion on threshold
	let isExploded = $state(false);

	// Interactive 3D lift & flip state for each flavour card
	let flipped: Record<string, boolean> = $state({
		butter: false,
		raspberry: false,
		yeast: false,
		peanut: false
	});

	function toggleFlip(id: string) {
		flipped[id] = !flipped[id];
	}

	// Peel.js integration for Hero section
	let peelEl: HTMLElement | null = $state(null);
	let peelTrackEl: HTMLElement | null = $state(null);
	let peelInstance: any = null;
	let peelProgress = $state(0.04);
	let manualPeelOverride = $state(false);

	function toggleManualPeel() {
		manualPeelOverride = true;
		if (peelProgress < 0.5) {
			peelProgress = 1.0;
		} else {
			peelProgress = 0.04;
		}
		if (peelInstance) {
			peelInstance.setTimeAlongPath(peelProgress);
		}
	}

	onMount(async () => {
		// 1. Initialize Peel.js
		try {
			const { Peel, PeelCorners } = await import('peel.js');
			if (peelEl) {
				peelInstance = new Peel(peelEl, {
					corner: PeelCorners.BOTTOM_RIGHT,
					topShadow: false,
					backShadow: false,
					bottomShadow: false,
					backReflection: false,
					fadeThreshold: 0.96
				});

				const updatePeelDimensions = () => {
					if (!peelEl || !peelInstance) return;
					const w = peelEl.offsetWidth || window.innerWidth;
					const h = peelEl.offsetHeight || window.innerHeight;
					// Diagonal peel path from bottom-right (w, h) to past top-left (-w*0.35, -h*0.35)
					peelInstance.setPeelPath(w, h, -w * 0.35, -h * 0.35);
					peelInstance.setTimeAlongPath(peelProgress);
				};

				updatePeelDimensions();

				// Enable mouse & touch drag on peel sheet
				peelInstance.handle('drag', (_evt: any, x: number, y: number) => {
					manualPeelOverride = true;
					peelInstance.setPeelPosition(x, y);
				});

				window.addEventListener('resize', updatePeelDimensions);
			}
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Peel.js setup notice:', err);
		}

		// 2. Active section observer to fade stationary background smoothly between brand colors
		const updateActiveSection = () => {
			const sections: { id: string; theme: SectionTheme }[] = [
				{ id: 'hero-section', theme: 'hero' },
				{ id: 'steps-section', theme: 'steps' },
				{ id: 'flavour-butter', theme: 'butter' },
				{ id: 'flavour-raspberry', theme: 'raspberry' },
				{ id: 'flavour-yeast', theme: 'yeast' },
				{ id: 'flavour-peanut', theme: 'peanut' },
				{ id: 'mixed-section', theme: 'mixed' }
			];

			const triggerY = window.innerHeight * 0.45;
			for (const sec of sections) {
				const el = document.getElementById(sec.id);
				if (el) {
					const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
					if (rect.top <= triggerY && rect.bottom >= triggerY) {
						setSectionTheme(sec.theme);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		};

		window.addEventListener('scroll', updateActiveSection, { passive: true });
		updateActiveSection();

		return () => {
			window.removeEventListener('scroll', updateActiveSection);
		};
	});

	// Peel along path with scroll progress
	$effect(() => {
		if (!peelInstance || manualPeelOverride) return;
		if (peelTrackEl) {
			const rect = peelTrackEl.getBoundingClientRect();
			const scrollDistance = rect.height - innerHeight;
			if (scrollDistance > 0) {
				const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, -rect.top / scrollDistance));
				// Map scrollProgress: 0 -> 0.04 (starter tease), 1.0 -> 1.0 (fully peeled open)
				peelProgress = 0.04 + progress * 0.96;
				peelInstance.setTimeAlongPath(peelProgress);
			}
		}
	});

	// Trigger explosion on threshold
	$effect(() => {
		const stepsEl = document.getElementById('steps-section');
		if (stepsEl) {
			const rect = stepsEl.getBoundingClientRect();
			if (rect.top < innerHeight * 0.55 && !isExploded) {
				isExploded = true;
			} else if (rect.top > innerHeight * 0.85 && isExploded) {
				isExploded = false;
			}
		}
	});
</script>

<style>
	/* PEEL.JS SYSTEM CONTAINER & LAYERS */
	.peel {
		position: relative;
		opacity: 0;
	}
	:global(.peel-ready) {
		opacity: 1 !important;
	}
	:global(.peel-svg-clip-element) {
		position: absolute;
		top: -10000px;
		left: -10000px;
		width: 1px;
		height: 1px;
		opacity: 0;
		pointer-events: none;
	}
	:global(.peel-layer) {
		position: absolute;
		z-index: 1;
		width: 100%;
		height: 100%;
		top: 0;
		right: 0;
		bottom: 0;
		left: 0;
		user-select: none;
		transform-origin: top left;
	}

	/* SECTION 1: HERO PEEL TRACK (STATIONARY VIEWPORT CANVAS) */
	.hero-peel-track {
		position: relative;
		height: 190vh; /* provides scroll length for peel */
		background: transparent;
	}

	.hero-peel-sticky {
		position: sticky;
		top: 0;
		height: 100vh;
		width: 100%;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		overflow: hidden;
		padding: 76px 1.5rem 1.5rem;
	}

	.hero-peel-box {
		width: 100%;
		max-width: 1140px;
		height: calc(100vh - 100px);
		max-height: 860px;
		border-radius: 20px;
		border: 3px solid #e24bff;
		background: #240340;
		overflow: hidden;
	}

	/* BOTTOM LAYER (UNDER PEEL): HOT SOURDOUGH & GESTURE REVEAL */
	.hero-peel-bottom {
		background: #240340;
		border-radius: 17px;
		padding: 3rem 2.5rem;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		text-align: center;
	}

	.hero-bottom-content {
		max-width: 680px;
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		align-items: center;
		gap: 1.5rem;
	}

	.under-eyebrow {
		color: #e24bff;
		font-weight: 800;
		letter-spacing: 0.16em;
		font-size: 0.95rem;
	}

	.under-headline {
		color: #e24bff;
		font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 3.8rem);
		font-weight: 900;
		letter-spacing: -0.02em;
		line-height: 1.05;
		margin: 0;
	}

	.under-note {
		color: #f4c7ff;
		font-size: 1.15rem;
		line-height: 1.55;
	}

	.under-spec-badges {
		display: flex;
		flex-wrap: wrap;
		gap: 0.75rem;
		justify-content: center;
	}

	.under-badge {
		font-size: 0.8rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		letter-spacing: 0.08em;
		padding: 0.45rem 1rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		border: 2px solid #e24bff;
		color: #e24bff;
		background: #3b0764;
	}

	.under-actions {
		display: flex;
		gap: 1rem;
		flex-wrap: wrap;
		justify-content: center;
		margin-top: 0.5rem;
	}

	.flat-btn-ghost {
		font-size: 1rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		padding: 0.85rem 1.8rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		text-decoration: none;
		border: 2px solid #e24bff;
		color: #240340;
		background: #e24bff;
		letter-spacing: 0.02em;
		transition: transform 0.15s;
	}

	.flat-btn-ghost:hover {
		transform: scale(1.04);
	}

	.flat-btn-reset-peel {
		font-family: inherit;
		font-size: 1rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		padding: 0.85rem 1.8rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		border: 2px solid #ffd640;
		color: #4a3000;
		background: #ffd640;
		cursor: pointer;
		letter-spacing: 0.02em;
		transition: transform 0.15s;
	}

	.flat-btn-reset-peel:hover {
		transform: scale(1.04);
	}

	/* BACK LAYER: UNDERSIDE OF FOIL SHEET */
	.hero-peel-back {
		background: #e24bff;
		border: 3px solid #ffd640;
		border-radius: 17px;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		overflow: hidden;
	}

	.foil-pattern {
		transform: rotate(-35deg);
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: 1.5rem;
		opacity: 0.45;
		user-select: none;
		pointer-events: none;
	}

	.foil-stamp-text {
		font-size: 1.6rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		letter-spacing: 0.12em;
		white-space: nowrap;
		color: #3b0764;
	}

	/* TOP LAYER: FRONT HERO COVER */
	.hero-peel-top {
		background: #240340;
		border-radius: 17px;
		padding: 2.2rem 2rem 1.75rem;
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: space-between;
		text-align: center;
		cursor: grab;
	}

	.hero-peel-top:active {
		cursor: grabbing;
	}

	.hero-top-kicker {
		font-size: 0.85rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		letter-spacing: 0.18em;
		color: #e24bff;
	}

	.hero-wordmark-container {
		width: 100%;
		max-width: 480px;
		height: 95px;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		margin: 0.25rem 0;
	}

	.hero-tagline {
		font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 1.85rem);
		font-weight: 900;
		letter-spacing: 0.22em;
		color: #f4c7ff;
		margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
	}

	.hero-pack-box {
		position: relative;
		width: 100%;
		max-width: 320px;
		margin: 0 auto;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
	}

	.hero-flat-pack {
		width: 100%;
		max-height: 250px;
		object-fit: contain;
		border-radius: 14px;
		border: 3px solid #e24bff;
	}

	.flat-peel-tag {
		position: absolute;
		top: -12px;
		right: -12px;
		background: #ffd640;
		color: #4a3000;
		font-weight: 900;
		font-size: 0.75rem;
		letter-spacing: 0.08em;
		padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		border: 2px solid #4a3000;
		transform: rotate(8deg);
	}

	.hero-meta-row {
		display: flex;
		flex-wrap: wrap;
		gap: 0.75rem;
		justify-content: center;
		margin: 0.5rem 0;
	}

	.meta-tag {
		font-size: 0.8rem;
		font-weight: 800;
		letter-spacing: 0.05em;
		padding: 0.35rem 0.85rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		background: #3b0764;
		border: 2px solid #e24bff;
		color: #e24bff;
	}

	.hero-peel-indicator {
		display: inline-flex;
		align-items: center;
		gap: 0.6rem;
		background: #3b0764;
		border: 2px solid #ffd640;
		color: #ffd640;
		padding: 0.45rem 1.1rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		font-family: inherit;
		font-size: 0.82rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		cursor: pointer;
		letter-spacing: 0.05em;
		transition: transform 0.15s, background-color 0.15s;
		animation: peelIndicatorWiggle 2.5s infinite ease-in-out;
	}

	@keyframes peelIndicatorWiggle {
		0%, 100% {
			transform: translateX(0);
		}
		50% {
			transform: translateX(4px);
		}
	}

	.hero-peel-indicator:hover {
		transform: scale(1.05);
		background: #4a3000;
	}

	.peel-arrow {
		font-size: 1.1rem;
		color: #ffd640;
	}

	/* SECTION 2: THE 3 STEPS WITH THRESHOLD EXPLOSION */
	.steps-stage {
		position: relative;
		min-height: 100vh;
		background: transparent;
		padding: 6rem 1.5rem 5rem;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
	}

	.steps-inner {
		max-width: 1140px;
		width: 100%;
		text-align: center;
	}

	.section-kicker {
		color: #e24bff;
		font-size: 0.95rem;
		font-weight: 800;
		letter-spacing: 0.16em;
		margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
	}

	.section-title {
		font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5.5vw, 4.2rem);
		font-weight: 900;
		color: #e24bff;
		letter-spacing: -0.03em;
		margin-bottom: 1rem;
	}

	.section-sub {
		max-width: 660px;
		margin: 0 auto 2.5rem;
		font-size: 1.1rem;
		color: #f4c7ff;
		line-height: 1.5;
	}

	.threshold-control-bar {
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		gap: 1rem;
		margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
		flex-wrap: wrap;
	}

	.threshold-btn {
		font-family: inherit;
		font-weight: 900;
		font-size: 0.95rem;
		padding: 0.65rem 1.5rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		cursor: pointer;
		border: 2px solid #e24bff;
		background: #e24bff;
		color: #240340;
		letter-spacing: 0.04em;
		transition: all 0.15s ease;
	}

	.threshold-btn:hover {
		transform: scale(1.05);
	}

	.threshold-btn.active {
		background: #ffd640;
		border-color: #ffd640;
		color: #4a3000;
	}

	.threshold-status {
		font-size: 0.88rem;
		color: #f4c7ff;
		font-weight: 700;
		letter-spacing: 0.03em;
	}

	.steps-grid {
		display: grid;
		grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
		gap: 2rem;
		position: relative;
	}

	.step-card {
		border-radius: 18px;
		padding: 2.75rem 2rem;
		text-align: left;
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		border: 3px solid;
		min-height: 340px;
		position: relative;
		transition:
			transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
			opacity 0.65s ease;
	}

	/* Explosive Dispersal Transforms on Threshold */
	.step-card-1.blast-tl {
		transform: translate(-45px, -40px) rotate(-6deg);
	}

	.step-card-2.blast-down {
		transform: translate(0, 50px) scale(1.04);
	}

	.step-card-3.blast-tr {
		transform: translate(45px, -40px) rotate(6deg);
	}

	.step-card-1 {
		background: #3b0764;
		border-color: #e24bff;
		color: #f4c7ff;
	}

	.step-card-2 {
		background: #4a3000;
		border-color: #ffd640;
		color: #ffeaa0;
	}

	.step-card-3 {
		background: #460820;
		border-color: #ff467a;
		color: #ffc0d2;
	}

	.step-badge {
		font-size: 3rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		line-height: 1;
		margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
	}

	.step-card-1 .step-badge {

	/* 3D LIFT & FLIP INTERACTIVE CARD */
	.flip-stage {
		width: 100%;
		max-width: 420px;
		height: 480px;
		perspective: 1200px;
	}

	.flip-card {
		width: 100%;
		height: 100%;
		position: relative;
		transform-style: preserve-3d;
		transition: transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1.2);
	}

	.flip-card.flipped {
		transform: translateY(-16px) scale(1.04) rotateY(180deg);
	}

	.flip-face {
		position: absolute;
		inset: 0;
		backface-visibility: hidden;
		-webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
		border-radius: 16px;
		border: 3px solid;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		overflow: hidden;
		padding: 1rem;
	}

	.flip-back {
		transform: rotateY(180deg);
	}

	.flavour-pack-img {
		max-height: 100%;
		max-width: 100%;
		object-fit: contain;
	}

	/* ANIMATED LIFT & FLIP BUTTON */
	.flat-flip-trigger {
		display: inline-flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		gap: 0.65rem;
		font-family: inherit;
		font-weight: 900;
		font-size: 0.88rem;
		padding: 0.75rem 1.6rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		cursor: pointer;
		border: 2px solid;
		letter-spacing: 0.03em;
		transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s;
		animation: flipButtonPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
	}

	@keyframes flipButtonPulse {
		0%, 100% {
			transform: translateY(0);
		}
		50% {
			transform: translateY(-3px);
		}
	}

	.flat-flip-trigger:hover {
		animation: none;
		transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.03);
	}

	.flat-flip-trigger:active {
		transform: translateY(2px) scale(0.97);
	}

	.flip-icon-wrap {
		display: inline-flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
	}

	.flip-icon-wrap.is-rotated {
		transform: rotate(180deg);
	}

	.flat-flip-trigger:hover .flip-icon-wrap {
		transform: rotate(180deg);

	.flat-flip-trigger.is-flipped:hover .flip-icon-wrap {
		transform: rotate(360deg);

### 🟣 STAMP Assistant Response

### Progress Update: Peel Animation, Stationary Morphing Canvas & Animated Flip Triggers

All four adjustments have been implemented, verified, and committed to `main` ([commit 52322fc](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project)):

1. **Physical Peel Animation with `peel.js`**: We replaced the 3D book rotation with **`peel.js`** in the Hero section ([`+page.svelte`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/src/routes/+page.svelte)). The Hero sheet now behaves like an authentic sticker disc: as you scroll, the bottom-right corner peels back diagonally across the screen via SVG clip-paths, rolling over a patterned brand foil back to reveal the hot sourdough and 10 g spread disc underneath. It also supports interactive mouse/touch dragging directly on the corner and a quick corner toggle button. In accordance with the flat branding rule, all drop shadows, box shadows, and specular reflections remain disabled (`topShadow: false`, `backShadow: false`, `backReflection: false`).
2. **Stationary Viewport Background with Seamless Color Fading**: Rather than scrolling past individual colored blocks, the canvas background is now **completely stationary** across the entire viewport (`position: fixed; inset: 0;`). As you scroll through the page, the stationary background smoothly fades between the signature brand colors at each section's midpoint threshold: Deep Night Ink (`#240340`) for Hero & 3 Steps → Electric Butter Gold (`#ffd640`) → Neon Wild Raspberry (`#ff467a`) → Electric Violet (`#e24bff`) → Roasted Peanut Ochre (`#ff8c30`) → Deep Night Ink (`#240340`) for the Mixed Pack and Footer. The floating header dynamically harmonizes with this transition.
3. **Animated Lift & Flip Triggers & Zero White Text**: The **Lift & Flip buttons** on each flavour card have been animated with an ambient subtle tactile pulse (`@keyframes flipButtonPulse`), dual-curved SVG rotating arrows that spin 180°–360° on hover and flip, an active press downstate, and interactive pill badges (`[3D LIFT]` / `[BACK PANEL]`). Additionally, all instances of white text and white box backgrounds across the flavour worlds, spec cards, callout alerts, and nutritional panels have been purged and replaced strictly with the contrasting saturated brand color pairs (e.g. Dark Maroon `#460820` for Raspberry, Deep Ink `#3b0764` for Yeast, Roasted Umber `#4e2408` for Peanut, and Caramel Brown `#4a3000` for Butter).

---

### Preview & Direction

The Vite dev server is running live on **`http://localhost:5173/`**:
- **Test the Peel**: Scroll down from the top or grab the bottom-right corner to peel back the hero sheet.
- **Watch the Background Fade**: Scroll continuously through the flavours to experience the stationary viewport canvas fading between the brand colors.
- **Try the Flip Buttons**: Hover over and click any of the "Lift & Flip" buttons to inspect the animated rotation and card flip.

Does this feel like the right peeling feel and background presence, or would you like to adjust any of the peel curves, scroll speeds, or button timings?

	}
};

export const themeState = $state<{ active: SectionTheme }>({
	active: 'hero'
});

export function setSectionTheme(theme: SectionTheme) {
	if (themeState.active !== theme) {
		themeState.active = theme;
	}
}

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
	import Wordmark from '../lib/Wordmark.svelte';
	import { setSectionTheme, type SectionTheme } from '../lib/theme.svelte';

	let scrollY = $state(0);
	let innerHeight = $state(800);
	let innerWidth = $state(1200);

	// Explosion on threshold
	let isExploded = $state(false);

	// Interactive 3D lift & flip state for each flavour card
	let flipped: Record<string, boolean> = $state({
		butter: false,
		raspberry: false,
		yeast: false,
		peanut: false
	});

	function toggleFlip(id: string) {
		flipped[id] = !flipped[id];
	}

	onMount(() => {
		// Active section observer to smoothly fade stationary background between brand colors
		const updateActiveSection = () => {
			const sections: { id: string; theme: SectionTheme }[] = [
				{ id: 'hero-section', theme: 'hero' },
				{ id: 'steps-section', theme: 'steps' },
				{ id: 'flavour-butter', theme: 'butter' },
				{ id: 'flavour-raspberry', theme: 'raspberry' },
				{ id: 'flavour-yeast', theme: 'yeast' },
				{ id: 'flavour-peanut', theme: 'peanut' },
				{ id: 'mixed-section', theme: 'mixed' }
			];

			const triggerY = window.innerHeight * 0.45;
			for (const sec of sections) {
				const el = document.getElementById(sec.id);
				if (el) {
					const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
					if (rect.top <= triggerY && rect.bottom >= triggerY) {
						setSectionTheme(sec.theme);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		};

		window.addEventListener('scroll', updateActiveSection, { passive: true });
		updateActiveSection();
	});

	onDestroy(() => {
		if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
			// clean up
		}
	});

	// Trigger explosion on threshold
	$effect(() => {
		const stepsEl = document.getElementById('steps-section');
		if (stepsEl) {
			const rect = stepsEl.getBoundingClientRect();
			if (rect.top < innerHeight * 0.55 && !isExploded) {
				isExploded = true;
			} else if (rect.top > innerHeight * 0.85 && isExploded) {
				isExploded = false;
			}
		}
	});
</script>

<svelte:window bind:scrollY bind:innerHeight bind:innerWidth />

<!-- SECTION 7: THE MIXED SHEET & CATEGORY DISRUPTION (FLAT, ZERO OUTLINES) -->
<section id="mixed-section" class="mixed-pack-stage">

<style>
	/* SECTION 1: CLEAN, NORMAL, HIGH-IMPACT HERO */
	.hero-clean-stage {
		position: relative;
		min-height: 100vh;
		min-height: 100dvh;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		padding: 7.5rem 1.5rem 4.5rem;
		background: transparent;
		text-align: center;
	}

	.hero-clean-inner {
		max-width: 860px;
		width: 100%;
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		align-items: center;
		gap: 1.5rem;
	}

	.hero-kicker {
		font-size: 0.88rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		letter-spacing: 0.18em;
		color: #e24bff;
	}

	.hero-wordmark-container {
		width: 100%;
		max-width: 520px;
		height: 110px;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		margin: 0.25rem 0;
	}

	.hero-tagline {
		font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4.5vw, 3rem);
		font-weight: 900;
		letter-spacing: 0.16em;
		color: #f4c7ff;
		margin: 0;
		line-height: 1.1;
	}

	.hero-lead {
		font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.3rem);
		line-height: 1.6;
		color: #f4c7ff;
		max-width: 680px;
		margin: 0 auto;
		font-weight: 600;
	}

	.hero-pack-showcase {
		margin: 1rem 0;
		display: flex;
		justify-content: center;
	}

	.hero-pack-wrap {
		position: relative;
		max-width: 340px;
		width: 100%;
	}

	.hero-pack-img {
		width: 100%;
		max-height: 280px;
		object-fit: contain;
		border-radius: 16px;
	}

	.hero-pack-pill {
		position: absolute;
		top: -10px;
		right: -10px;
		background: #ffd640;
		color: #4a3000;
		font-weight: 900;
		font-size: 0.78rem;
		letter-spacing: 0.08em;
		padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		transform: rotate(6deg);
	}

	.hero-badges-row {
		display: flex;
		flex-wrap: wrap;
		gap: 0.75rem;
		justify-content: center;
		margin: 0.25rem 0;
	}

	.hero-badge {
		font-size: 0.8rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		letter-spacing: 0.06em;
		padding: 0.45rem 1rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		background: #3b0764;
		color: #e24bff;
	}

	.hero-actions-row {
		display: flex;
		gap: 1rem;
		flex-wrap: wrap;
		justify-content: center;
		margin-top: 0.75rem;
	}

	.hero-btn-primary {
		background: #e24bff;
		color: #240340;
		font-weight: 900;
		font-size: 1.05rem;
		padding: 0.95rem 2.2rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		text-decoration: none;
		letter-spacing: 0.03em;
		transition: transform 0.15s ease;
		display: inline-block;
	}

	.hero-btn-primary:hover {
		transform: scale(1.04);
	}

	.hero-btn-secondary {
		background: #3b0764;
		color: #ffd640;
		font-weight: 900;
		font-size: 1.05rem;
		padding: 0.95rem 2.2rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		text-decoration: none;
		letter-spacing: 0.03em;
		transition: transform 0.15s ease;
		display: inline-block;
	}

	.hero-btn-secondary:hover {
		transform: scale(1.04);
	}

	/* SECTION 2: THE 3 STEPS WITH THRESHOLD EXPLOSION (FLAT, ZERO OUTLINES) */
	.steps-stage {
		position: relative;
		min-height: 100vh;
		background: transparent;
		padding: 6rem 1.5rem 5rem;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
	}

	.steps-inner {
		max-width: 1140px;
		width: 100%;
		text-align: center;
	}

	.section-kicker {
		color: #e24bff;
		font-size: 0.95rem;
		font-weight: 800;
		letter-spacing: 0.16em;
		margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
	}

	.section-title {
		font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5.5vw, 4.2rem);
		font-weight: 900;
		color: #e24bff;
		letter-spacing: -0.03em;
		margin-bottom: 1rem;
	}

	.section-sub {
		max-width: 660px;
		margin: 0 auto 2.5rem;
		font-size: 1.1rem;
		color: #f4c7ff;
		line-height: 1.5;
	}

	.threshold-control-bar {
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		gap: 1rem;
		margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
		flex-wrap: wrap;
	}

	.threshold-btn {
		font-family: inherit;
		font-weight: 900;
		font-size: 0.95rem;
		padding: 0.7rem 1.6rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		cursor: pointer;
		border: none;
		background: #e24bff;
		color: #240340;
		letter-spacing: 0.04em;
		transition: all 0.15s ease;
	}

	.threshold-btn:hover {
		transform: scale(1.05);
	}

	.threshold-btn.active {
		background: #ffd640;
		color: #4a3000;
	}

	.threshold-status {
		font-size: 0.88rem;
		color: #f4c7ff;
		font-weight: 700;
		letter-spacing: 0.03em;
	}

	.steps-grid {
		display: grid;
		grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
		gap: 2rem;
		position: relative;
	}

	.step-card {
		border-radius: 20px;
		padding: 2.75rem 2rem;
		text-align: left;
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		border: none;
		min-height: 340px;
		position: relative;
		transition:
			transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
			opacity 0.65s ease;
	}

	/* Explosive Dispersal Transforms on Threshold */
	.step-card-1.blast-tl {
		transform: translate(-45px, -40px) rotate(-6deg);
	}

	.step-card-2.blast-down {
		transform: translate(0, 50px) scale(1.04);
	}

	.step-card-3.blast-tr {
		transform: translate(45px, -40px) rotate(6deg);
	}

	.step-card-1 {
		background: #3b0764;
		color: #f4c7ff;
	}

	.step-card-2 {
		background: #4a3000;
		color: #ffeaa0;
	}

	.step-card-3 {
		background: #460820;
		color: #ffc0d2;
	}

	.step-badge {
		font-size: 3rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		line-height: 1;
		margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
	}

	.step-card-1 .step-badge {
		color: #e24bff;
	}
	.step-card-2 .step-badge {
		color: #ffd640;
	}
	.step-card-3 .step-badge {
		color: #ff467a;
	}

	.step-label {
		font-size: 2.2rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		letter-spacing: 0.02em;
		margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
	}

	.step-card-1 .step-label {
		color: #e24bff;
	}
	.step-card-2 .step-label {
		color: #ffd640;
	}
	.step-card-3 .step-label {
		color: #ff467a;
	}

	.step-text {
		font-size: 1.05rem;
		line-height: 1.5;
		flex: 1;
	}

	.flat-rule {
		height: 6px;
		width: 44px;
		border-radius: 999px;
		margin-top: 1.5rem;
	}

	.step-card-1 .flat-rule {
		background: #e24bff;
	}
	.step-card-2 .flat-rule {
		background: #ffd640;
	}
	.step-card-3 .flat-rule {
		background: #ff467a;
	}

	.exploded-banner {
		margin-top: 3.5rem;
		display: flex;
		justify-content: center;
	}

	.alert-box {
		display: inline-flex;
		align-items: center;
		gap: 0.75rem;
		background: #ffd640;
		color: #4a3000;
		padding: 0.7rem 1.6rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		font-weight: 900;
		font-size: 0.85rem;
		letter-spacing: 0.08em;
		border: none;
	}

	/* SECTIONS 3-6: IMMERSIVE FLAVOUR SCREENS (FLAT, ZERO OUTLINES) */
	.flavour-screen {
		position: relative;
		min-height: 100vh;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		padding: 6rem 2rem;
		background: transparent;
	}

	.flavour-content-grid {
		max-width: 1140px;
		width: 100%;
		display: grid;
		grid-template-columns: 460px 1fr;
		gap: 4.5rem;
		align-items: center;
	}

	.flavour-media-side {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		align-items: center;
		gap: 1.5rem;
	}

	/* 3D LIFT & FLIP INTERACTIVE CARD (FLAT SOLID SURFACES, ZERO OUTLINES) */
	.flip-stage {
		width: 100%;
		max-width: 420px;
		height: 480px;
		perspective: 1200px;
	}

	.flip-card {
		width: 100%;
		height: 100%;
		position: relative;
		transform-style: preserve-3d;
		transition: transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1.2);
	}

	.flip-card.flipped {
		transform: translateY(-16px) scale(1.04) rotateY(180deg);
	}

	.flip-face {
		position: absolute;
		inset: 0;
		backface-visibility: hidden;
		-webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
		border-radius: 20px;
		border: none;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		overflow: hidden;
		padding: 1.5rem;
	}

	.flip-back {
		transform: rotateY(180deg);
	}

	.flavour-pack-img {
		max-height: 100%;
		max-width: 100%;
		object-fit: contain;
	}

	/* ANIMATED LIFT & FLIP BUTTON (FLAT SOLID PILL, ZERO OUTLINES) */
	.flat-flip-trigger {
		display: inline-flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		gap: 0.65rem;
		font-family: inherit;
		font-weight: 900;
		font-size: 0.9rem;
		padding: 0.8rem 1.7rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		cursor: pointer;
		border: none;
		letter-spacing: 0.03em;
		transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s;
		animation: flipButtonPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
	}

	@keyframes flipButtonPulse {
		0%, 100% {
			transform: translateY(0);
		}
		50% {
			transform: translateY(-3px);
		}
	}

	.flat-flip-trigger:hover {
		animation: none;
		transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.03);
	}

	.flat-flip-trigger:active {
		transform: translateY(2px) scale(0.97);
	}

	.flip-icon-wrap {
		display: inline-flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
	}

	.flip-icon-wrap.is-rotated {
		transform: rotate(180deg);
	}

	.flat-flip-trigger:hover .flip-icon-wrap {
		transform: rotate(180deg);
	}
	.flat-flip-trigger.is-flipped:hover .flip-icon-wrap {
		transform: rotate(360deg);

### 🟣 STAMP Assistant Response

### Update: Clean Hero & Full Removal of Outline Borders

The peel animation has been removed and the site has been redesigned to use pure flat color blocking without wireframe outline borders ([commit 816e302](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project)):

1. **Clean, Normal, High-Impact Hero**: We eliminated the complex peel scroll track, sticky wrappers, and clipping paths. In its place is a clean, normal, full-screen Hero section ([`+page.svelte`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/src/routes/+page.svelte)) showcasing the authentic vector [`Wordmark.svelte`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/src/lib/Wordmark.svelte), the bold `PEEL. PRESS. TOAST.` tagline, the 8-stamp card packshot, key value points ($5.00 NZD / sheet, 8 × 10 g discs, 12-month ambient pantry stability), and smooth call-to-action buttons (`Explore The 4 Flavours ↓` and `How Stamp Works ↓`).
2. **Flat Solid Header Bar (Zero Outlines)**: The floating header bar ([`+layout.svelte`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/src/routes/+layout.svelte)) is now a **completely borderless flat pill**. As it floats above the stationary color-morphing background, it displays a solid flat fill matching the active flavor world (e.g. Deep Night Ink `#3b0764` over Butter Gold, Berry Maroon `#460820` over Raspberry, Deep Ink `#3b0764` over Yeast, and Deep Peanut Umber `#4e2408` over Peanut Ochre) with zero outline strokes, matching the flat aesthetic of the flavors section.
3. **Pure Flat Color Blocking Across All Sections**: All remaining outline borders (`border: 2px solid`, `border: 3px solid`, border-tops) have been removed across the 3 Step cards, flavor spec blocks, callout containers, pricing cards, and chat widget. Every element now sits as a solid flat shape with rich color contrast and zero white or black, maintaining the animated 3D lift-and-flip card interactions and the stationary viewport background color transitions.

---

### Preview & Direction

The updated interface is live on **`http://localhost:5173/`**. Please take a look at the clean hero, borderless floating header, and flat color-blocked sections. Let me know what you think and what we should work on next!
