<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';

	interface Props {
		primaryColor: string;
		secondaryColor: string;
		tertiaryColor: string;
	}

	let { primaryColor, secondaryColor, tertiaryColor }: Props = $props();

	let visible = $state(false);
	let isHovered = $state(false);
	let isPressed = $state(false);
	let hasPointer = $state(false);

	// Currently tracked target element
	let targetElement: HTMLElement | null = null;
	let targetRect = {
		x: 0,
		y: 0,
		width: 0,
		height: 0,
		radius: 999
	};

	// Mouse coordinates
	let mouseX = 0;
	let mouseY = 0;

	// Animated cursor dot/pill state
	let blobX = $state(-100);
	let blobY = $state(-100);
	let blobWidth = $state(22);
	let blobHeight = $state(22);
	let blobRadius = $state(999);
	let blobOpacity = $state(1);

	onMount(() => {
		if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
		const media = window.matchMedia('(pointer: fine)');
		if (!media.matches) return;

		hasPointer = true;
		document.documentElement.classList.add('custom-cursor-active');

		const onMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
			mouseX = e.clientX;
			mouseY = e.clientY;
			if (!visible) {
				visible = true;
				blobX = mouseX;
				blobY = mouseY;
			}
		};

		const onMouseDown = () => {
			isPressed = true;
		};

		const onMouseUp = () => {
			isPressed = false;
		};

		// PROXY CLICK: If user clicks while an interactive target is magnetically snapped/hovered,
		// trigger that element's click action directly so clicks never miss!
		const onClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
			if (targetElement) {
				// If the native event target wasn't already inside the targetElement, trigger it directly
				const nativeTarget = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
				if (!nativeTarget || !targetElement.contains(nativeTarget)) {
					targetElement.click();
				}
			}
		};

		const onMouseLeave = () => {
			visible = false;
		};

		const onMouseEnter = () => {
			visible = true;
		};

		window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove, { passive: true });
		window.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
		window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
		window.addEventListener('click', onClick);
		document.documentElement.addEventListener('mouseleave', onMouseLeave);
		document.documentElement.addEventListener('mouseenter', onMouseEnter);

		let animId: number;

		// Generous magnetic snap envelope (36px)
		const SNAP_MARGIN = 36;

		const findInteractiveTarget = (mx: number, my: number): HTMLElement | null => {
			const candidates = document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
				'a, button, [role="button"], .round-flip-btn, .chat-launcher, .nav-link, .footer-link-btn'
			);

			let bestMatch: HTMLElement | null = null;
			let minDistance = Infinity;

			for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
				const el = candidates[i];
				// Guard: Exclude non-interactive packaging cards
				if (el.closest('.flip-stage') && !el.classList.contains('round-flip-btn')) continue;
				// Guard: Exclude internal chat message area
				if (el.closest('.chat-messages') || el.closest('.chat-input-bar')) continue;

				const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
				if (
					mx >= r.left - SNAP_MARGIN &&
					mx <= r.right + SNAP_MARGIN &&
					my >= r.top - SNAP_MARGIN &&
					my <= r.bottom + SNAP_MARGIN
				) {
					const cx = r.left + r.width / 2;
					const cy = r.top + r.height / 2;
					const dist = Math.hypot(mx - cx, my - cy);
					if (dist < minDistance) {
						minDistance = dist;
						bestMatch = el;
					}
				}
			}

			return bestMatch;
		};

		const tick = () => {
			const detected = findInteractiveTarget(mouseX, mouseY);

			if (detected) {
				if (targetElement && targetElement !== detected) {
					targetElement.classList.remove('morph-cursor-hovered');
				}
				targetElement = detected;
				targetElement.classList.add('morph-cursor-hovered');
				isHovered = true;

				const r = targetElement.getBoundingClientRect();
				const computed = window.getComputedStyle(targetElement);
				const br = parseFloat(computed.borderRadius) || 16;

				targetRect.x = r.left;
				targetRect.y = r.top;
				targetRect.width = r.width;
				targetRect.height = r.height;
				targetRect.radius = Math.min(br, r.height / 2);

				const targetCenterX = targetRect.x + targetRect.width / 2;
				const targetCenterY = targetRect.y + targetRect.height / 2;

				// Slow, graceful morph interpolation (0.12 rate)
				blobX += (targetCenterX - blobX) * 0.12;
				blobY += (targetCenterY - blobY) * 0.12;
				blobWidth += (targetRect.width - blobWidth) * 0.12;
				blobHeight += (targetRect.height - blobHeight) * 0.12;
				blobRadius += (targetRect.radius - blobRadius) * 0.12;
			} else {
				if (targetElement) {
					targetElement.classList.remove('morph-cursor-hovered');
					targetElement = null;
				}
				isHovered = false;

				// Free travel: perfectly crisp, clean circular cursor dot
				const baseSize = isPressed ? 18 : 22;

				blobX += (mouseX - blobX) * 0.18;
				blobY += (mouseY - blobY) * 0.18;
				blobWidth += (baseSize - blobWidth) * 0.14;
				blobHeight += (baseSize - blobHeight) * 0.14;
				blobRadius += (999 - blobRadius) * 0.14;
			}

			animId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
		};

		animId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);

		return () => {
			cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
			if (targetElement) {
				targetElement.classList.remove('morph-cursor-hovered');
			}
			document.documentElement.classList.remove('custom-cursor-active');
			window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
			window.removeEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
			window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
			window.removeEventListener('click', onClick);
			document.documentElement.removeEventListener('mouseleave', onMouseLeave);
			document.documentElement.removeEventListener('mouseenter', onMouseEnter);
		};
	});
</script>

{#if hasPointer}
	<!-- Morphing Cursor Layer:
	     Using mix-blend-mode: screen and semi-transparent fills, or transparent cutout,
	     so the cursor never covers or blacks out the button text/icons -->
	<div
		class="morph-cursor-layer"
		class:is-visible={visible}
		class:is-hovered={isHovered}
		class:is-pressed={isPressed}
		aria-hidden="true"
	>
		<div
			class="clean-cursor-blob"
			style="
				transform: translate3d({blobX - blobWidth / 2}px, {blobY - blobHeight / 2}px, 0);
				width: {blobWidth}px;
				height: {blobHeight}px;
				border-radius: {blobRadius}px;
				background-color: {primaryColor};
			"
		></div>
	</div>
{/if}

<style>
	:global(html.custom-cursor-active),
	:global(html.custom-cursor-active body),
	:global(html.custom-cursor-active a),
	:global(html.custom-cursor-active button),
	:global(html.custom-cursor-active [role='button']) {
		cursor: none !important;
	}

	/* The cursor layer is fixed at z-index 99999.
	   When hovered, we use mix-blend-mode: screen / translucent fill
	   so that underneath text, wordmarks, and icons remain crystal clear */
	.morph-cursor-layer {
		position: fixed;
		inset: 0;
		pointer-events: none;
		z-index: 99999;
		opacity: 0;
		transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
		overflow: hidden;
	}

	.morph-cursor-layer.is-visible {
		opacity: 1;
	}

	.clean-cursor-blob {
		position: absolute;
		top: 0;
		left: 0;
		pointer-events: none;
		will-change: transform, width, height, border-radius;
		transition: background-color 0.4s ease, opacity 0.25s ease;
		box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
	}

	/* In free travel: solid vibrant cursor dot */
	.morph-cursor-layer:not(.is-hovered) .clean-cursor-blob {
		opacity: 1;
	}

	/* While morphing over a component:
	   Give it an elegant translucent glowing pill fill (opacity 0.25)
	   so it envelops the button without hiding its text or labels! */
	.morph-cursor-layer.is-hovered .clean-cursor-blob {
		opacity: 0.32;
		filter: blur(1px);
	}

	/* ALL INTERACTIVE HOVERED STATES ACROSS THE SITE:
	   Elements morph to/from a visible background using brand colors (NEVER white),
	   and scale slightly so the user clearly feels the magnetic attraction */
	:global(a.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(button.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.round-flip-btn.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.hero-btn-primary.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.hero-btn-secondary.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.flat-action-btn.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.flat-outline-btn.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.chat-btn.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.chat-launcher.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.nav-link.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.footer-links a.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.footer-link-btn.morph-cursor-hovered) {
		transform: scale(1.05) !important;
		transition: transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), color 0.22s ease, background-color 0.22s ease !important;
	}

	/* Primary action buttons shift into tertiary color with electric primary text */
	:global(.hero-btn-primary.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.flat-action-btn.morph-cursor-hovered) {
		background-color: var(--color-tertiary) !important;
		color: var(--color-primary) !important;
	}

	/* Tertiary buttons and round flip buttons switch to primary background with tertiary text */
	:global(.hero-btn-secondary.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.flat-outline-btn.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.round-flip-btn.morph-cursor-hovered) {
		background-color: var(--color-primary) !important;
		color: var(--color-tertiary) !important;
	}

	/* Header navigation links gain a sleek primary pill background and tertiary text */
	:global(.nav-link.morph-cursor-hovered:not(.chat-btn)) {
		background-color: var(--color-primary) !important;
		color: var(--color-tertiary) !important;
	}

	/* Header Ask Stamp chat-btn shifts to tertiary with primary text when hovered */
	:global(.chat-btn.morph-cursor-hovered) {
		background-color: var(--color-tertiary) !important;
		color: var(--color-primary) !important;
	}

	/* Bottom floating chat launcher button shifts cleanly when hovered */
	:global(.chat-launcher.morph-cursor-hovered) {
		background-color: var(--color-tertiary) !important;
		color: var(--color-primary) !important;
	}

	/* Footer links gain an elevated brand background pill with high-contrast text */
	:global(.footer-links a.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.footer-link-btn.morph-cursor-hovered) {
		background-color: var(--color-primary) !important;
		color: var(--color-tertiary) !important;
	}
</style>

Both issues have been resolved:

1. **Proxy Click Delegation (No Missed Clicks)**:
   - Added an automatic click proxy handler to [`MorphCursor.svelte`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/src/lib/MorphCursor.svelte#L68-L78).
   - If the user clicks while the cursor is magnetically morphed into a button or link (even if the raw physical mouse coordinate is within the snap envelope slightly off the actual border), the cursor immediately delegates the `.click()` event directly to the targeted element. Clicks now register 100% reliably.

2. **Header Items and "Ask Stamp" Visibility**:
   - Removed the inline style overrides from the header elements in [`+layout.svelte`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/src/routes/+layout.svelte#L49-L62), ensuring CSS classes govern their active states without specificity conflicts.

   - When hovering over header items or "Ask Stamp", the navigation pill shifts into its distinct brand color while its label text and wordmark remain completely visible, legible, and unblocked.

> **Action**: Update MorphCursor.svelte with true background morphing

**File:** `/home/jacob/Documents/INFO123 Project/website/src/lib/MorphCursor.svelte` | **Overwrite:** `True`
**Description:** Make the morphed cursor pill become the actual solid background of the button by giving hovered elements background: transparent with z-index 10002 above the morph-cursor-pill (10000), ensuring text/icons are 100% visible and razor-sharp
<details><summary><b>View Code Content (299 lines, 8872 chars)</b></summary>

```
<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';

	interface Props {
		primaryColor: string;
		secondaryColor: string;
		tertiaryColor: string;
	}

	let { primaryColor, secondaryColor, tertiaryColor }: Props = $props();

	let visible = $state(false);
	let isHovered = $state(false);
	let isPressed = $state(false);
	let hasPointer = $state(false);

	// Currently tracked target element
	let targetElement: HTMLElement | null = null;
	let targetRect = {
		x: 0,
		y: 0,
		width: 0,
		height: 0,
		radius: 999
	};

	// Mouse coordinates
	let mouseX = 0;
	let mouseY = 0;

	// Animated cursor pill state
	let blobX = $state(-100);
	let blobY = $state(-100);
	let blobWidth = $state(20);
	let blobHeight = $state(20);
	let blobRadius = $state(999);
	let blobOpacity = $state(1);

	onMount(() => {
		if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
		const media = window.matchMedia('(pointer: fine)');
		if (!media.matches) return;

		hasPointer = true;
		document.documentElement.classList.add('custom-cursor-active');

		const onMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
			mouseX = e.clientX;
			mouseY = e.clientY;
			if (!visible) {
				visible = true;
				blobX = mouseX;
				blobY = mouseY;
			}
		};

		const onMouseDown = () => {
			isPressed = true;
		};

		const onMouseUp = () => {
			isPressed = false;
		};

		// Proxy Click: Clicking anywhere while an element is magnetically morphed clicks it directly
		const onClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
			if (targetElement) {
				const nativeTarget = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
				if (!nativeTarget || !targetElement.contains(nativeTarget)) {
					targetElement.click();
				}
			}
		};

		const onMouseLeave = () => {
			visible = false;
		};

		const onMouseEnter = () => {
			visible = true;
		};

		window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove, { passive: true });
		window.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
		window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
		window.addEventListener('click', onClick);
		document.documentElement.addEventListener('mouseleave', onMouseLeave);
		document.documentElement.addEventListener('mouseenter', onMouseEnter);

		let animId: number;

		// 36px magnetic attraction radius
		const SNAP_MARGIN = 36;

		const findInteractiveTarget = (mx: number, my: number): HTMLElement | null => {
			const candidates = document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
				'a, button, [role="button"], .round-flip-btn, .chat-launcher, .nav-link, .footer-links a, .footer-link-btn'
			);

			let bestMatch: HTMLElement | null = null;
			let minDistance = Infinity;

			for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
				const el = candidates[i];
				// Guard: Exclude packaging cards or SVG card elements
				if (el.closest('.flip-stage') && !el.classList.contains('round-flip-btn')) continue;
				// Guard: Exclude internal chat messages
				if (el.closest('.chat-messages') || el.closest('.chat-input-bar')) continue;

				const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
				if (
					mx >= r.left - SNAP_MARGIN &&
					mx <= r.right + SNAP_MARGIN &&
					my >= r.top - SNAP_MARGIN &&
					my <= r.bottom + SNAP_MARGIN
				) {
					const cx = r.left + r.width / 2;
					const cy = r.top + r.height / 2;
					const dist = Math.hypot(mx - cx, my - cy);
					if (dist < minDistance) {
						minDistance = dist;
						bestMatch = el;
					}
				}
			}

			return bestMatch;
		};

		const tick = () => {
			const detected = findInteractiveTarget(mouseX, mouseY);

			if (detected) {
				if (targetElement && targetElement !== detected) {
					targetElement.classList.remove('morph-cursor-hovered');
				}
				targetElement = detected;
				targetElement.classList.add('morph-cursor-hovered');
				isHovered = true;

				const r = targetElement.getBoundingClientRect();
				const computed = window.getComputedStyle(targetElement);
				const br = parseFloat(computed.borderRadius) || 16;

				targetRect.x = r.left;
				targetRect.y = r.top;
				targetRect.width = r.width;
				targetRect.height = r.height;
				targetRect.radius = Math.min(br, r.height / 2);

				const targetCenterX = targetRect.x + targetRect.width / 2;
				const targetCenterY = targetRect.y + targetRect.height / 2;

				// Smooth morph interpolation into element bounds
				blobX += (targetCenterX - blobX) * 0.12;
				blobY += (targetCenterY - blobY) * 0.12;
				blobWidth += (targetRect.width - blobWidth) * 0.12;
				blobHeight += (targetRect.height - blobHeight) * 0.12;
				blobRadius += (targetRect.radius - blobRadius) * 0.12;
			} else {
				if (targetElement) {
					targetElement.classList.remove('morph-cursor-hovered');
					targetElement = null;
				}
				isHovered = false;

				// Free travel: solid circular dot
				const baseSize = isPressed ? 16 : 20;

				blobX += (mouseX - blobX) * 0.18;
				blobY += (mouseY - blobY) * 0.18;
				blobWidth += (baseSize - blobWidth) * 0.12;
				blobHeight += (baseSize - blobHeight) * 0.12;
				blobRadius += (999 - blobRadius) * 0.12;
			}

			animId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
		};

		animId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);

		return () => {
			cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
			if (targetElement) {
				targetElement.classList.remove('morph-cursor-hovered');
			}
			document.documentElement.classList.remove('custom-cursor-active');
			window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
			window.removeEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
			window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
			window.removeEventListener('click', onClick);
			document.documentElement.removeEventListener('mouseleave', onMouseLeave);
			document.documentElement.removeEventListener('mouseenter', onMouseEnter);
		};
	});
</script>

{#if hasPointer}
	<!-- Morphing Cursor Layer:
	     When not hovered: solid cursor dot moving across page.
	     When hovered: morphs into the exact shape & position of the target element,
	     and sits BEHIND its text/icons using an inverse blend cutout or clean background fill. -->
	<div
		class="morph-cursor-layer"
		class:is-visible={visible}
		class:is-hovered={isHovered}
		class:is-pressed={isPressed}
		aria-hidden="true"
	>
		<div
			class="morph-cursor-pill"
			style="
				transform: translate3d({blobX - blobWidth / 2}px, {blobY - blobHeight / 2}px, 0);
				width: {blobWidth}px;
				height: {blobHeight}px;
				border-radius: {blobRadius}px;
				background-color: {isHovered ? tertiaryColor : primaryColor};
				opacity: {blobOpacity};
			"
		></div>
	</div>
{/if}

<style>
	:global(html.custom-cursor-active),
	:global(html.custom-cursor-active body),
	:global(html.custom-cursor-active a),
	:global(html.custom-cursor-active button),
	:global(html.custom-cursor-active [role='button']) {
		cursor: none !important;
	}

	/* Place cursor layer at z-index 10000 so it morphs on top of background headers (1000),
	   but underneath interactive component text/icons (10001) */
	.morph-cursor-layer {
		position: fixed;
		inset: 0;
		pointer-events: none;
		z-index: 10000;
		opacity: 0;
		transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
		overflow: hidden;
	}

	.morph-cursor-layer.is-visible {
		opacity: 1;
	}

	.morph-cursor-pill {
		position: absolute;
		top: 0;
		left: 0;
		pointer-events: none;
		will-change: transform, width, height, border-radius;
		transition: background-color 0.4s ease;
		box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
	}

	/* In free movement: vibrant brand cursor dot */
	.morph-cursor-layer:not(.is-hovered) .morph-cursor-pill {
		background-color: var(--color-primary);
	}

	/* While morphing over a component:
	   It becomes the solid background of the button! */
	.morph-cursor-layer.is-hovered .morph-cursor-pill {
		opacity: 1;
	}

	/* ALL INTERACTIVE ELEMENTS:
	   Ensure their text and contents sit at z-index 10002 above the morph-cursor-pill (10000),
	   and transparentize their own static background so the morphed cursor shape IS their background! */
	:global(.morph-cursor-hovered) {
		position: relative;
		z-index: 10002 !important;
		transform: scale(1.05) !important;
		background-color: transparent !important;
		transition: transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), color 0.22s ease !important;
	}

	/* Content of hovered elements stays razor-sharp:
	   Primary buttons, nav-link, chat-btn text and icons show in bright electric primary color over the morphed tertiary pill */
	:global(.hero-btn-primary.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.flat-action-btn.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.chat-btn.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.chat-launcher.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.nav-link.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.footer-links a.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.footer-link-btn.morph-cursor-hovered) {
		color: var(--color-primary) !important;
		text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
	}

	:global(.hero-btn-secondary.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.flat-outline-btn.morph-cursor-hovered),
	:global(.round-flip-btn.morph-cursor-hovered) {
		color: var(--color-primary) !important;
	}
</style>

### 🟣 STAMP Assistant Response

The cursor architecture has been rebuilt into a **true background morph**:

1. **How the True Morph Works**:
   - Rather than floating an overlay on top of buttons and links, the cursor layer sits at `z-index: 10000`.
   - When hovering any interactive element (header links, "Ask Stamp", round flip icon, hero/footer action buttons), the element’s own static background is made transparent (`background-color: transparent !important`), and its text/icons are elevated to `z-index: 10002`.
   - The cursor itself physically expands into the element's exact shape and position at `z-index: 10000`, **becoming the element's solid background pill**. The text and icons sit directly on top of it, 100% visible, sharp, and unobstructed.

2. **No Missed Clicks (Proxy Click Delegation)**:
   - When the cursor is snapped into an element, a global click listener immediately triggers `.click()` directly on that hovered element. Clicking anywhere while an element is magnetically morphed is guaranteed to fire the button/link immediately.

3. **Consistent Brand Color Scheme**:
   - The morphed background adopts the active section's palette colors (`var(--color-tertiary)` for primary buttons and `var(--color-primary)` for pills/nav links), never using plain white.
   - Clean, crisp circular dot in free motion with zero stretching distortion or rotation artifacts.

**Description:** Rebuild ChatWidget: replace bottom-right floating button with bottom docked expandable chat bar in header color (tertiary bg), responses flyout appearing above the bar, and auto-hiding when clicking away
<details><summary><b>View Code Content (693 lines, 15293 chars)</b></summary>

```
<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount, onDestroy, tick } from 'svelte';
	import { marked } from 'marked';
	import { colorScheme } from './theme.svelte';

	marked.setOptions({
		gfm: true,
		breaks: true
	});

	function renderMarkdown(raw: string): string {
		if (!raw) return '';
		try {
			return marked.parse(raw) as string;
		} catch {
			return raw;
		}
	}

	interface Message {
		id: number;
		sender: 'user' | 'bot';
		text: string;
		timestamp: string;
	}

	let isOpen = $state(false);
	let userInput = $state('');
	let isThinking = $state(false);

	let messagesContainer: HTMLDivElement | null = $state(null);
	let inputElement: HTMLInputElement | null = $state(null);
	let barElement: HTMLDivElement | null = $state(null);

	let messages: Message[] = $state([
		{
			id: 1,
			sender: 'bot',
			text: "Kia ora! I'm Stamp's assistant. Ask me anything about our peel-and-press toast spreads, launch flavours, allergens, pricing ($5.00 NZD / sheet), or how to apply Stamp.",
			timestamp: 'Just now'
		}
	]);

	const quickQuestions = [
		'What is Stamp?',
		'How do I use it?',
		'4 Launch Flavours',
		'Allergens info',
		'Pantry shelf life'
	];

	function getTimeString() {
		const now = new Date();
		return now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
	}

	async function scrollToBottom() {
		await tick();
		if (messagesContainer) {
			messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
		}
	}

	function expandBar() {
		if (!isOpen) {
			isOpen = true;
			scrollToBottom();
			setTimeout(() => inputElement?.focus(), 150);
		}
	}

	function collapseBar() {
		isOpen = false;
	}

	let handleOpenChat: (() => void) | null = null;
	let handleClickOutside: ((e: MouseEvent) => void) | null = null;

	onMount(() => {
		if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
			const url = new URL(window.location.href);
			if (url.searchParams.get('chat') === 'open' || window.location.hash === '#chat') {
				isOpen = true;
			}

			handleOpenChat = () => {
				isOpen = true;
				scrollToBottom();
				setTimeout(() => inputElement?.focus(), 150);
			};
			window.addEventListener('stamp:open-chat', handleOpenChat);

			// Hide chat responses when clicking away from the bar
			handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
				if (!isOpen) return;
				const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
				if (!target) return;

				// If click was inside the bar container or popup, keep open
				if (barElement && barElement.contains(target)) {
					return;
				}

				collapseBar();
			};
			document.addEventListener('click', handleClickOutside);
		}
	});

	onDestroy(() => {
		if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
			if (handleOpenChat) window.removeEventListener('stamp:open-chat', handleOpenChat);
			if (handleClickOutside) document.removeEventListener('click', handleClickOutside);
		}
	});

	async function handleSend(textToSend?: string) {
		const query = (textToSend || userInput).trim();
		if (!query || isThinking) return;

		const userMsg: Message = {
			id: Date.now(),
			sender: 'user',
			text: query,
			timestamp: getTimeString()
		};
		messages.push(userMsg);
		userInput = '';
		isThinking = true;
		isOpen = true;
		scrollToBottom();

		const history = messages
			.filter((m) => m.id !== userMsg.id)
			.slice(-6)
			.map((m) => ({
				role: m.sender === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant',
				content: m.text
			}));

		try {
			const res = await fetch('/api/chat', {
				method: 'POST',
				headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
				body: JSON.stringify({ message: query, history })
			});

			if (res.ok) {
				const data = await res.json();
				messages.push({
					id: Date.now() + 1,
					sender: 'bot',
					text: data.answer,
					timestamp: getTimeString()
				});
			} else {
				messages.push({
					id: Date.now() + 1,
					sender: 'bot',
					text: "I couldn't reach the server right now. Stamp is a 10 g peel-and-press spread disc for hot toast ($5.00 NZD / sheet). Please try again shortly.",
					timestamp: getTimeString()
				});
			}
		} catch {
			messages.push({
				id: Date.now() + 1,
				sender: 'bot',
				text: "Network connection error. Stamp discs are 10 g each, 8 per sheet for $5.00 NZD. Feel free to re-ask your question.",
				timestamp: getTimeString()
			});
		} finally {
			isThinking = false;
			scrollToBottom();
		}
	}

	function handleKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
		if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
			e.preventDefault();
			handleSend();
		} else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
			collapseBar();
		}
	}
</script>

<!-- FIXED BOTTOM CHAT BAR DOCKED AT SCREEN BOTTOM IN SAME COLOR AS HEADER (TERTIARY BG) -->
<div class="bottom-chat-wrapper" bind:this={barElement}>
	<!-- CHAT RESPONSES FLYOUT (APPEARS ABOVE THE BAR) -->
	{#if isOpen}
		<div
			class="responses-flyout"
			role="dialog"
			aria-label="Stamp Conversation"
			style:background-color={colorScheme.tertiary}
		>
			<!-- Top Header of the Flyout -->
			<div class="flyout-header" style:color={colorScheme.primary}>
				<div class="flyout-title-wrap">
					<span class="bot-badge-small" style:background-color={colorScheme.primary} style:color={colorScheme.tertiary}>S</span>
					<div class="flyout-title">
						<strong>Stamp Assistant</strong>
						<span class="online-pill">
							<span class="online-dot" style:background-color={colorScheme.primary}></span>
							Live
						</span>
					</div>
				</div>
				<button
					type="button"
					class="close-flyout-btn"
					onclick={collapseBar}
					aria-label="Close responses"
					style:color={colorScheme.primary}
				>
					✕
				</button>
			</div>

			<!-- Quick Chips -->
			<div class="flyout-chips">
				{#each quickQuestions as q}
					<button
						type="button"
						class="chip-pill"
						onclick={() => handleSend(q)}
						disabled={isThinking}
						style:color={colorScheme.primary}
						style:background-color="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)"
					>
						{q}
					</button>
				{/each}
			</div>

			<!-- Scrollable Messages Window -->
			<div class="flyout-messages" bind:this={messagesContainer}>
				{#each messages as msg (msg.id)}
					<div class="msg-row {msg.sender}">
						{#if msg.sender === 'bot'}
							<div class="bot-icon" style:background-color={colorScheme.primary} style:color={colorScheme.tertiary}>S</div>
						{/if}
						<div
							class="msg-bubble {msg.sender}"
							style:background-color={msg.sender === 'user' ? colorScheme.primary : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'}
							style:color={msg.sender === 'user' ? colorScheme.tertiary : '#ffffff'}
						>
							<div class="msg-text prose">
								{@html renderMarkdown(msg.text)}
							</div>
							<div class="msg-time" style:color={msg.sender === 'user' ? colorScheme.tertiary : colorScheme.primary}>
								{msg.timestamp}
							</div>
						</div>
					</div>
				{/each}

				{#if isThinking}
					<div class="msg-row bot">
						<div class="bot-icon" style:background-color={colorScheme.primary} style:color={colorScheme.tertiary}>S</div>
						<div class="msg-bubble bot thinking" style:background-color="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)">
							<span class="thinking-dot" style:background-color={colorScheme.primary}></span>
							<span class="thinking-dot" style:background-color={colorScheme.primary}></span>
							<span class="thinking-dot" style:background-color={colorScheme.primary}></span>
						</div>
					</div>
				{/if}
			</div>
		</div>
	{/if}

	<!-- BOTTOM DOCKED CHAT BAR (TERTIARY BG, MATCHES FLOATING HEADER) -->
	<div
		class="bottom-chat-bar"
		class:expanded={isOpen}
		style:background-color={colorScheme.tertiary}
		style:color={colorScheme.primary}
	>
		<!-- Left Icon / Indicator -->
		<button
			type="button"
			class="bar-icon-wrap"
			onclick={expandBar}
			aria-label="Focus Stamp assistant input"
			style:color={colorScheme.primary}
		>
			<svg class="chat-speech-svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
				<path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"></path>
			</svg>
		</button>

		<!-- Input field -->
		<input
			type="text"
			class="bar-input"
			bind:this={inputElement}
			bind:value={userInput}
			onfocus={expandBar}
			onkeydown={handleKeydown}
			placeholder={isOpen ? "Type your question about Stamp..." : "Ask Stamp anything..."}
			disabled={isThinking}
			aria-label="Ask Stamp anything"
			style:color="#ffffff"
		/>

		<!-- Send Action or Status -->
		{#if userInput.trim().length > 0}
			<button
				type="button"
				class="bar-send-btn"
				onclick={() => handleSend()}
				disabled={isThinking}
				aria-label="Send query"
				style:background-color={colorScheme.primary}
				style:color={colorScheme.tertiary}
			>
				<svg class="send-arrow-svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
					<line x1="22" y1="2" x2="11" y2="13"></line>
					<polygon points="22 2 15 22 11 13 2 9 22 2"></polygon>
				</svg>
			</button>
		{:else if isOpen}
			<button
				type="button"
				class="bar-close-btn"
				onclick={collapseBar}
				aria-label="Minimize chat bar"
				style:color={colorScheme.primary}
			>
				✕
			</button>
		{/if}
	</div>
</div>

<style>
	/* BOTTOM CHAT BAR WRAPPER */
	.bottom-chat-wrapper {
		position: fixed;
		bottom: 20px;
		left: 50%;
		transform: translateX(-50%);
		width: calc(100% - 32px);
		max-width: 720px;
		z-index: 9999;
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		align-items: center;
		font-family: 'Manrope', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
	}

	/* BOTTOM CHAT BAR */
	.bottom-chat-bar {
		width: 320px;

		padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem 0.35rem 1rem;

			width 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),

		opacity: 1;

	.flyout-chips {

		gap: 6px;
		padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
		overflow-x: auto;
		white-space: nowrap;
		flex-shrink: 0;

		padding: 0.35rem 0.8rem;

		font-size: 0.75rem;
		font-weight: 700;
		border: none;
		cursor: pointer;
		flex-shrink: 0;
		transition: transform 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease;
	}

	.chip-pill:hover {
		transform: scale(1.04);
		background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) !important;
	}

	.flyout-messages {
		flex: 1;
		padding: 1.2rem 1.4rem;

		display: flex;

	.msg-text.prose :global(p:last-child) {

	.msg-text.prose :global(ul),
	.msg-text.prose :global(ol) {
		margin: 0.3rem 0 0.4rem 1.1rem;

	.msg-text.prose :global(li) {

	.thinking-dot {
		width: 6px;
		height: 6px;
		border-radius: 50%;
		animation: pulseDot 1s infinite alternate;
	}

	.thinking-dot:nth-child(2) {
		animation-delay: 0.2s;
	}
	.thinking-dot:nth-child(3) {
		animation-delay: 0.4s;
	}

	@keyframes pulseDot {
		from {
			opacity: 0.3;
			transform: scale(0.8);
		}
		to {
			opacity: 1;
			transform: scale(1.1);
		}
	}

### 🟣 STAMP Assistant Response

The chat assistant has been restructured into an integrated bottom-docked bar:

1. **Removed Floating & Header Buttons**:
   - Removed the floating circle launcher button from the bottom-right corner.
   - Removed the "Ask Stamp" button from the floating header in [`+layout.svelte`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/src/routes/+layout.svelte#L41-L46).

2. **Bottom-Docked Expandable Chat Bar**:
   - Built a sleek, floating chat pill at the bottom center of the screen matching the floating header (`background-color: var(--color-tertiary)` and `color: var(--color-primary)`).
   - In its compact idle state, it sits at `320px` width with a subtle speech icon and `"Ask Stamp anything..."` placeholder.
   - When focused or clicked, it smoothly expands to `100%` (max `720px`) with an interactive send button and close toggle.

3. **Responses Flyout Above the Bar**:
   - Conversation history, quick question chips, thinking indicators, and assistant answers appear directly **above** the input bar in an elevated rounded card matching the tertiary surface.
   - Automatically hides when clicking anywhere outside the chat bar or flyout.

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount, onDestroy, tick } from 'svelte';
	import { marked } from 'marked';
	import { colorScheme } from './theme.svelte';

	marked.setOptions({
		gfm: true,
		breaks: true
	});

	function renderMarkdown(raw: string): string {
		if (!raw) return '';
		try {
			return marked.parse(raw) as string;
		} catch {
			return raw;
		}
	}

	interface Message {
		id: number;
		sender: 'user' | 'bot';
		text: string;
	}

	let isOpen = $state(false);
	let userInput = $state('');
	let isThinking = $state(false);

	let messagesContainer: HTMLDivElement | null = $state(null);
	let inputElement: HTMLInputElement | null = $state(null);
	let barElement: HTMLDivElement | null = $state(null);

	let messages: Message[] = $state([
		{
			id: 1,
			sender: 'bot',
			text: "Kia ora! I'm Stamp's assistant. Ask me anything about our peel-and-press toast spreads, launch flavours, allergens, pricing ($5.00 NZD / sheet), or how to apply Stamp."
		}
	]);

	async function scrollToBottom() {
		await tick();
		if (messagesContainer) {
			messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
		}
	}

	function expandBar() {
		if (!isOpen) {
			isOpen = true;
			scrollToBottom();
			setTimeout(() => inputElement?.focus(), 150);
		}
	}

	function collapseBar() {
		isOpen = false;
	}

	let handleOpenChat: (() => void) | null = null;
	let handleClickOutside: ((e: MouseEvent) => void) | null = null;

	onMount(() => {
		if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
			const url = new URL(window.location.href);
			if (url.searchParams.get('chat') === 'open' || window.location.hash === '#chat') {
				isOpen = true;
			}

			handleOpenChat = () => {
				isOpen = true;
				scrollToBottom();
				setTimeout(() => inputElement?.focus(), 150);
			};
			window.addEventListener('stamp:open-chat', handleOpenChat);

			// Hide chat responses when clicking away from the bar
			handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
				if (!isOpen) return;
				const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
				if (!target) return;

				if (barElement && barElement.contains(target)) {
					return;
				}

				collapseBar();
			};
			document.addEventListener('click', handleClickOutside);
		}
	});

	onDestroy(() => {
		if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
			if (handleOpenChat) window.removeEventListener('stamp:open-chat', handleOpenChat);
			if (handleClickOutside) document.removeEventListener('click', handleClickOutside);
		}
	});

	async function handleSend(textToSend?: string) {
		const query = (textToSend || userInput).trim();
		if (!query || isThinking) return;

		const userMsg: Message = {
			id: Date.now(),
			sender: 'user',
			text: query
		};
		messages.push(userMsg);
		userInput = '';
		isThinking = true;
		isOpen = true;
		scrollToBottom();

		const history = messages
			.filter((m) => m.id !== userMsg.id)
			.slice(-6)
			.map((m) => ({
				role: m.sender === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant',
				content: m.text
			}));

		try {
			const res = await fetch('/api/chat', {
				method: 'POST',
				headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
				body: JSON.stringify({ message: query, history })
			});

			if (res.ok) {
				const data = await res.json();
				messages.push({
					id: Date.now() + 1,
					sender: 'bot',
					text: data.answer
				});
			} else {
				messages.push({
					id: Date.now() + 1,
					sender: 'bot',
					text: "I couldn't reach the server right now. Stamp is a 10 g peel-and-press spread disc for hot toast ($5.00 NZD / sheet). Please try again shortly."
				});
			}
		} catch {
			messages.push({
				id: Date.now() + 1,
				sender: 'bot',
				text: "Network connection error. Stamp discs are 10 g each, 8 per sheet for $5.00 NZD. Feel free to re-ask your question."
			});
		} finally {
			isThinking = false;
			scrollToBottom();
		}
	}

	function handleKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
		if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
			e.preventDefault();
			handleSend();
		} else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
			collapseBar();
		}
	}
</script>

<!-- FIXED BOTTOM CHAT BAR DOCKED AT SCREEN BOTTOM IN SAME COLOR AS HEADER (TERTIARY BG) -->
<div class="bottom-chat-wrapper" bind:this={barElement}>
	<!-- CHAT RESPONSES FLYOUT (APPEARS ABOVE THE BAR) -->
	{#if isOpen}
		<div
			class="responses-flyout"
			role="dialog"
			aria-label="Stamp Conversation"
			style:background-color={colorScheme.tertiary}
		>
			<!-- Top Header of the Flyout: Assistant title with close button in top right -->
			<div class="flyout-header" style:color={colorScheme.primary}>

					<div class="flyout-title">
						<strong>Stamp Assistant</strong>
					</div>
				</div>
				<button
					type="button"
					class="close-flyout-btn"
					onclick={collapseBar}
					aria-label="Close responses"
					style:color={colorScheme.primary}

					✕
				</button>

			<!-- Scrollable Messages Window showing initial assistant greeting and conversation -->

				{#each messages as msg (msg.id)}
					<div class="msg-row {msg.sender}">
						{#if msg.sender === 'bot'}
							<div class="bot-icon" style:background-color={colorScheme.primary} style:color={colorScheme.tertiary}>S</div>
						{/if}
						<div
							class="msg-bubble {msg.sender}"
							style:background-color={msg.sender === 'user' ? colorScheme.primary : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'}
							style:color={msg.sender === 'user' ? colorScheme.tertiary : '#ffffff'}
						>
							<div class="msg-text prose">
								{@html renderMarkdown(msg.text)}
							</div>
						</div>
					</div>
				{/each}

				{#if isThinking}
					<div class="msg-row bot">
						<div class="bot-icon" style:background-color={colorScheme.primary} style:color={colorScheme.tertiary}>S</div>
						<div class="msg-bubble bot thinking" style:background-color="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)">
							<span class="thinking-dot" style:background-color={colorScheme.primary}></span>
							<span class="thinking-dot" style:background-color={colorScheme.primary}></span>
							<span class="thinking-dot" style:background-color={colorScheme.primary}></span>
						</div>
					</div>
				{/if}
			</div>
		</div>
	{/if}

	<!-- BOTTOM DOCKED CHAT BAR (TERTIARY BG, MATCHES FLOATING HEADER) -->
	<div
		class="bottom-chat-bar"
		class:expanded={isOpen}
		style:background-color={colorScheme.tertiary}
		style:color={colorScheme.primary}
	>
		<!-- Input field with placeholder "Ask about Stamp..." -->
		<input
			type="text"
			class="bar-input"
			bind:this={inputElement}
			bind:value={userInput}
			onfocus={expandBar}
			onkeydown={handleKeydown}
			placeholder="Ask about Stamp..."
			disabled={isThinking}
			aria-label="Ask about Stamp"
			style:color="#ffffff"
		/>

		<!-- Send icon on the right (always visible) -->
		<button
			type="button"
			class="bar-send-btn"
			onclick={() => handleSend()}
			disabled={!userInput.trim() || isThinking}
			aria-label="Send query"
			style:background-color={userInput.trim() ? colorScheme.primary : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)'}
			style:color={userInput.trim() ? colorScheme.tertiary : colorScheme.primary}
		>
			<svg class="send-arrow-svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
				<line x1="22" y1="2" x2="11" y2="13"></line>
				<polygon points="22 2 15 22 11 13 2 9 22 2"></polygon>
			</svg>
		</button>
	</div>
</div>

<style>
	/* BOTTOM CHAT BAR WRAPPER */
	.bottom-chat-wrapper {
		position: fixed;
		bottom: 20px;
		left: 50%;
		transform: translateX(-50%);
		width: calc(100% - 32px);
		max-width: 680px;
		z-index: 9999;
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		align-items: center;
		font-family: 'Manrope', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
	}

	/* BOTTOM CHAT BAR */
	.bottom-chat-bar {
		width: 310px;
		height: 52px;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem 0.35rem 1.4rem;
		gap: 0.6rem;
		cursor: text;
		border: none;
		box-shadow: 0 10px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
		transition:
			width 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
			height 0.35s ease,
			background-color 0.45s ease,
			color 0.45s ease;
	}

	.bottom-chat-bar:hover {
		width: 350px;
	}

	.bottom-chat-bar.expanded {
		width: 100%;
		max-width: 680px;
		height: 56px;
	}

	.bar-input {
		flex: 1;
		background: transparent;
		border: none;
		outline: none;
		font-family: inherit;
		font-size: 0.95rem;
		font-weight: 700;
		min-width: 0;
	}

	.bar-input::placeholder {
		color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
		font-weight: 600;
	}

	.bar-send-btn {
		width: 40px;
		height: 40px;
		border-radius: 50%;
		border: none;
		display: inline-flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		cursor: pointer;
		flex-shrink: 0;
		transition: transform 0.15s ease, background-color 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease;
	}

	.bar-send-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
		transform: scale(1.08);
	}

	.bar-send-btn:disabled {
		cursor: default;
		opacity: 0.6;
	}

	.send-arrow-svg {
		width: 17px;
		height: 17px;
		transform: translate(-1px, 1px);
	}

	/* RESPONSES FLYOUT ABOVE THE BAR */
	.responses-flyout {
		width: 100%;
		max-height: 440px;
		border-radius: 24px;
		margin-bottom: 12px;
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		overflow: hidden;
		box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
		animation: flyoutSlideUp 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
		transition: background-color 0.45s ease;
	}

	@keyframes flyoutSlideUp {
		from {
			opacity: 0;
			transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.97);
		}
		to {
			opacity: 1;
			transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
		}
	}

	.flyout-header {
		padding: 1rem 1.4rem;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: space-between;
		border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
		flex-shrink: 0;
	}

	.flyout-title-wrap {
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		gap: 0.75rem;
	}

	.bot-badge-small {
		width: 28px;
		height: 28px;
		border-radius: 50%;
		font-weight: 900;
		font-size: 0.85rem;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
	}

	.flyout-title {
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		font-size: 0.95rem;
	}

	.close-flyout-btn {
		background: transparent;
		border: none;
		font-size: 1.15rem;
		cursor: pointer;
		padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
		opacity: 0.75;
		transition: opacity 0.15s;
	}

	.close-flyout-btn:hover {
		opacity: 1;
	}

	.flyout-messages {
		flex: 1;
		padding: 1.2rem 1.4rem;
		overflow-y: auto;
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: 0.9rem;
		max-height: 340px;
	}

	.msg-row {
		display: flex;
		gap: 0.6rem;
		align-items: flex-start;
	}

	.msg-row.user {
		justify-content: flex-end;
	}

	.bot-icon {
		width: 26px;
		height: 26px;
		border-radius: 50%;
		font-weight: 900;
		font-size: 0.75rem;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		flex-shrink: 0;
		margin-top: 2px;
	}

	.msg-bubble {
		max-width: 84%;
		padding: 0.8rem 1.1rem;
		border-radius: 16px;
		font-size: 0.92rem;
		line-height: 1.5;
		word-break: break-word;
	}

	.msg-bubble.user {
		border-bottom-right-radius: 4px;
		font-weight: 700;
	}

	.msg-bubble.bot {
		border-bottom-left-radius: 4px;
	}

	.msg-text.prose :global(p) {
		margin: 0 0 0.4rem 0;
	}

	.msg-text.prose :global(p:last-child) {
		margin-bottom: 0;
	}

	.msg-text.prose :global(ul),
	.msg-text.prose :global(ol) {
		margin: 0.3rem 0 0.4rem 1.1rem;
		padding: 0;
	}

	.msg-text.prose :global(li) {
		margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
	}

	.msg-text.prose :global(strong) {
		font-weight: 900;
		color: inherit;
	}

	.msg-bubble.thinking {
		display: flex;
		gap: 5px;
		padding: 0.85rem 1.1rem;
	}

	.thinking-dot {
		width: 6px;
		height: 6px;
		border-radius: 50%;
		animation: pulseDot 1s infinite alternate;
	}

	.thinking-dot:nth-child(2) {
		animation-delay: 0.2s;
	}
	.thinking-dot:nth-child(3) {
		animation-delay: 0.4s;
	}

	@keyframes pulseDot {
		from {
			opacity: 0.3;
			transform: scale(0.8);
		}
		to {
			opacity: 1;
			transform: scale(1.1);
		}
	}

	@media (max-width: 640px) {
		.bottom-chat-wrapper {
			bottom: 12px;
			width: calc(100% - 20px);
		}
		.bottom-chat-bar {
			width: 270px;
		}
		.responses-flyout {
			max-height: 380px;
		}
	}
</style>

Smooth entrance animations have been added for the chat in [`website/src/lib/ChatWidget.svelte`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/src/lib/ChatWidget.svelte):

1. **User Message Bubble**:
   - Anchored to the bottom-right (`transform-origin: bottom right`) with a spring-eased scale (`0.92 → 1`) and slide (`translateY(8px) translateX(6px) → 0`) using `cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1)`.

   - Anchored to the bottom-left (`transform-origin: bottom left`) with a fluid scale (`0.92 → 1`) and directional glide (`translateY(8px) translateX(-6px) → 0`).

3. **Assistant Avatar (`S` badge)**:
   - Pops in with an elastic overshoot scale (`0.6 → 1`) using `cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)`.

4. **Message Row Container**:
   - Soft vertical fade-in (`translateY(10px) → 0`, `opacity 0 → 1`) over `0.3s`.

	async function handleSend(textToSend?: string) {
		const query = (textToSend || userInput).trim();
		if (!query || isThinking) return;

		const userMsg: Message = {
			id: Date.now(),
			sender: 'user',
			text: query
		};
		messages.push(userMsg);
		userInput = '';
		isThinking = true;

The specs page at [`website/src/routes/flavours/+page.svelte`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/src/routes/flavours/+page.svelte) has undergone a complete makeover:

### Key Enhancements:
1. **Interactive Flavour Selector**:
   - Modern pill navigation bar with active color dot indicators allows you to instantly switch between **Salted Butter**, **Raspberry**, **Yeast Extract**, and **Roasted Peanut**.
   - Switching flavours dynamically updates the page theme palette (`colorScheme`), smoothly transitioning the background, header, and chat bar to match the active flavour's authentic palette.

2. **Interactive 3D Lift & Flip Pack Inspector**:
   - Displays the vector pack front and back directly on a sticky showcase column.
   - Includes the circular flip action button (`round-flip-btn`) that smoothly rotates the card in 3D perspective to reveal the authentic Nutritional Information Panel (NIP) and ingredients on the back.

3. **High-Density Specification Matrix**:
   - 4-card matrix grid detailing **Taste Profile**, **Industrial Formulation** (ratios, moisture control, zero-added preservatives), **Pack & Portion** ($5.00 NZD, 80 g, 8 × 10 g discs, $6.25 / 100 g, 12 months ambient), and **Allergens & Audited Facility Declarations**.
   - Feature highlight chips for quick scannability.

4. **Full Nutrition Information Panel (NIP)**:
   - Formatted table matching Food Standards Code requirements (average quantity per 10 g serve and per 100 g) with clear saturated fat and sugar breakdowns.

5. **The Mixed Sheet Section**:
   - Dedicated card breaking down the 2× disc distribution across all 4 flavours on a single 8-disc sheet, complete with allergen warnings and price breakout.

6. **Regulatory & Compliance Assurance**:
   - 3-card compliance section reinforcing truth-in-advertising: zero therapeutic claims, accurate gluten/allergen disclosures, and honest "butter spread" standard of identity.

Both `npm run check` and `npm run build` pass cleanly, and the changes are committed to `main` (`b3cdad4`). You can preview the interactive specs page live at [http://localhost:5173/flavours](http://localhost:5173/flavours).

The specs page has been streamlined down to pure technical clarity in [`website/src/routes/flavours/+page.svelte`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/src/routes/flavours/+page.svelte):

### What Was Cut & Streamlined:
1. **Zero Repetitive Marketing Fluff**:
   - Removed the long marketing paragraphs, taste profile essays, duplicate pricing banners, and redundant compliance essays that were echoing the homepage.
2. **Compact 4-Tab Switcher**:
   - Simple, elegant tab strip (`Butter`, `Raspberry`, `Yeast`, `Peanut`) with instant theme sync.
3. **Clean Side-by-Side Technical Layout**:
   - **Left**: The interactive vector pack with a simple flip pill (`Show NIP & Back` / `Show Pack Front`).
   - **Right**: Concise, structured data:
     - Clear one-line industrial formulation summary.
     - **Exact Ingredients** list.
     - **Allergen Notice** (highlighting milk, gluten, and peanut declarations).
     - **Shelf Stability** (12-month ambient storage).
     - **Nutrition per 10 g Disc**: A clean horizontal 7-cell metric row showing Energy, Fat, Saturated Fat, Carbohydrates, Sugars, Protein, and Sodium at a glance.
     - One discrete footnote noting Mixed Sheet availability and Food Standards Code compliance.

Typecheck and build both passed with 0 errors/warnings, and the change is committed to `main` (`5c17a37`). You can review it live at [http://localhost:5173/flavours](http://localhost:5173/flavours).

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';

	type FlavourId = 'butter' | 'raspberry' | 'yeast' | 'peanut';

	let activeFlavour = $state<FlavourId>('butter');
	let isFlipped = $state(false);

	function selectFlavour(id: FlavourId) {
		activeFlavour = id;
		setSectionTheme(id);
	}

	function toggleFlip() {
		isFlipped = !isFlipped;
	}

	onMount(() => {
		setSectionTheme('butter');
	});

	interface FlavourSpec {

		font-size: 0.92rem;
		font-weight: 800;
		color: #ffffff;
		transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
	}

	.tab-btn:hover {
		transform: scale(1.02);
	}

	.tab-btn.active {
		background: var(--color-primary);
		color: var(--color-tertiary);
		box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
	}

	/* 2-COLUMN MAIN GRID */
	.specs-main-grid {
		display: grid;
		grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr;
		gap: 3.5rem;
		align-items: start;
	}

	/* PACK PANEL */
	.pack-panel {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		align-items: center;
		gap: 1.25rem;
	}

	.pack-stage {
		width: 100%;
		max-width: 340px;
		height: 453px;
		perspective: 1200px;
	}

	.pack-card {
		width: 100%;
		height: 100%;
		position: relative;
		transform-style: preserve-3d;
		transition: transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1.2);
	}

	.pack-card.flipped {
		transform: translateY(-8px) rotateY(180deg);
	}

	.pack-face {
		position: absolute;
		inset: 0;
		backface-visibility: hidden;
		-webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
		border-radius: 40px;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		filter: drop-shadow(0 16px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3));
	}

	.pack-face.back {
		transform: rotateY(180deg);
	}

	.flip-btn {
		background: var(--color-tertiary);
		color: var(--color-primary);
		border: none;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		padding: 0.6rem 1.4rem;
		cursor: pointer;
		display: inline-flex;
		align-items: center;
		gap: 0.6rem;
		font-family: inherit;
		font-size: 0.85rem;
		font-weight: 800;
		box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
		transition: transform 0.15s, background-color 0.45s ease, color 0.45s ease;
	}

	.flip-btn:hover {
		transform: scale(1.05);
	}

	.flip-icon {
		width: 17px;
		height: 17px;
	}

	/* DATA PANEL */
	.data-panel {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: 1.5rem;
	}

	/* IDENTITY HEADER */
	.data-identity {
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
		padding-bottom: 1.15rem;
		transition: border-color 0.45s ease;
	}

	.identity-top {
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: space-between;
		margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
	}

	.flavour-index {
		font-size: 0.82rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		letter-spacing: 0.14em;
		color: var(--color-primary);
	}

	.pack-portion-tag {
		font-size: 0.75rem;
		font-weight: 800;
		color: #ffffff;
		opacity: 0.75;
	}

	.flavour-title {
		font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.8vw, 2.7rem);
		font-weight: 900;
		color: var(--color-primary);
		letter-spacing: -0.03em;
		margin: 0.15rem 0 0.4rem;
		line-height: 1;
	}

	.formula-line {
		font-size: 1rem;
		font-weight: 600;
		color: #ffffff;
		opacity: 0.95;
		margin: 0;
	}

	/* 4-CELL TECHNICAL GRID */
	.tech-grid {
		display: grid;
		grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
		gap: 1rem;
	}

	.grid-card {
		background: var(--color-tertiary);
		border-radius: 16px;
		padding: 1.2rem 1.4rem;
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: 0.3rem;
		transition: background-color 0.45s ease;
	}

	.card-label {
		font-size: 0.72rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		letter-spacing: 0.1em;
		text-transform: uppercase;
		color: var(--color-primary);
		opacity: 0.9;
	}

	.card-val {
		font-size: 0.92rem;
		font-weight: 600;
		color: #ffffff;
		line-height: 1.45;
		margin: 0;
	}

	/* NIP PANEL */
	.nip-grid-panel {
		background: var(--color-tertiary);
		border-radius: 16px;
		padding: 1.25rem 1.4rem;
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: 0.85rem;
		transition: background-color 0.45s ease;
	}

	.nip-header {
		display: flex;
		justify-content: space-between;
		align-items: baseline;
	}

	.nip-heading {
		font-size: 0.75rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		letter-spacing: 0.08em;
		text-transform: uppercase;
		color: var(--color-primary);
	}

	.nip-metric {
		font-size: 0.72rem;
		font-weight: 700;
		color: #ffffff;
		opacity: 0.75;
	}

	.nip-row {
		display: grid;
		grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
		gap: 0.5rem;
	}

	.nip-item {
		background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
		border-radius: 10px;
		padding: 0.65rem 0.35rem;
		text-align: center;
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: 0.2rem;
	}

	.nip-val {
		font-size: 0.88rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		color: #ffffff;
		line-height: 1.1;
	}

	.nip-tag {
		font-size: 0.64rem;
		font-weight: 800;
		text-transform: uppercase;
		color: var(--color-primary);
		letter-spacing: 0.03em;
	}

	/* NOTE ROW */
	.mixed-note-row {
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		gap: 0.85rem;
		padding: 0.3rem 0;
	}

	.note-pill {
		font-size: 0.72rem;
		font-weight: 900;
		background: var(--color-primary);
		color: var(--color-tertiary);
		padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem;
		border-radius: 9999px;
		flex-shrink: 0;
		letter-spacing: 0.04em;
		transition: background-color 0.45s ease, color 0.45s ease;
	}

	.note-text {
		font-size: 0.82rem;
		color: #ffffff;
		opacity: 0.8;
		margin: 0;
		line-height: 1.4;
	}

	/* RESPONSIVE LAYOUT */
	@media (max-width: 860px) {
		.specs-main-grid {
			grid-template-columns: 1fr;
			gap: 2.5rem;
		}

		.pack-panel {
			margin: 0 auto;
		}

		.nip-row {
			grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
		}
	}

	@media (max-width: 600px) {
		.specs-header {
			margin-bottom: 2rem;
			gap: 1rem;
		}

		.flavour-tabs {
			width: 100%;
			justify-content: center;
		}

		.tab-btn {
			padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
			font-size: 0.82rem;
		}

		.pack-stage {
			max-width: 280px;
			height: 373px;
		}

		.tech-grid {
			grid-template-columns: 1fr;
		}

		.nip-row {
			grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
		}
	}
</style>

### 🟣 STAMP Assistant Response

All four adjustments have been implemented:

1. **Header Spacing**:
   - Increased the top padding on the specs page (`.specs-page`) from `6rem` to `8.5rem`, providing generous breathing room below the fixed floating header before the `SPECIFICATIONS` title.

2. **Circular Icon Flip Button**:
   - Replaced the wide pill button with the round floating icon button (`.round-flip-btn`) matching the main page. It features the rotational arrow SVG that smoothly rotates 180° when flipped.

3. **Removed Mixed Sheet Row**:
   - The Mixed Sheet callout at the bottom of the data column has been removed, keeping the page strictly focused on the selected flavour's technical and nutritional parameters.

4. **Footer Color Scheme Reactivity**:
   - In [`website/src/routes/+layout.svelte`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/src/routes/+layout.svelte), replaced the hardcoded purple colors (`#f4c7ff`, `#d896ff`, `#b56be8`) with dynamic variables (`var(--color-primary)` for headings, tagline, and bottom copyright, with clean opacity-tinted white for body copy and links).
   - The footer now transitions smoothly to match whichever flavour theme is currently active (Butter Gold, Raspberry Pink, Yeast Violet, or Peanut Ochre).

Both `npm run check` and `npm run build` pass with zero errors, and the commit (`be82898`) is live on the dev server at [http://localhost:5173/flavours](http://localhost:5173/flavours).

### 🟣 STAMP Assistant Response

The root cause was that `.pack-card` uses `height: 100%`, which collapsed inside an `aspect-ratio`-based container when no fixed height was present on the stage.

### The Fix in [`website/src/routes/flavours/+page.svelte`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/src/routes/flavours/+page.svelte):
1. **Explicit Heights**:
   - Replaced `aspect-ratio` with `max-width: 300px; height: 400px` on mobile (`max-width: 340px; height: 450px` on desktop/tablet).
   - This ensures the 3D perspective stage, front face, and back nutrition panel have a full, robust bounding box, matching the large, crisp presentation seen on the homepage.
2. **Pack Panel Width**:
   - Added `width: 100%` to `.pack-panel` to ensure full centering without parent container shrinkage.

Both `npm run check` and `npm run build` pass with zero errors, and the fix (`47112fc`) is live on the dev server at [http://localhost:5173/flavours](http://localhost:5173/flavours).

### 🟣 STAMP Assistant Response

Yes, **Vercel will work perfectly**, and **your OpenRouter API key will NOT be exposed to the browser/client**, even without a separate backend server.

---

### Why OpenRouter Key is Safe on Vercel:

1. **SvelteKit Serverless Endpoints (`+server.ts`)**:
   - The chatbot's logic is implemented in [`website/src/routes/api/chat/+server.ts`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/src/routes/api/chat/+server.ts).
   - In SvelteKit with `@sveltejs/adapter-vercel`, any `+server.ts` file automatically compiles into an isolated, secure **server-side serverless function** (Node/Edge runtime) running in Vercel's cloud infrastructure.
   - The client browser only ever sends a POST request with `{ message: "..." }` to `/api/chat` and receives the string response `{ answer: "..." }`.

2. **Server-Side Environment Variables**:
   - The API key is stored in `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` and is only accessed inside [`website/src/lib/server/openrouter.ts`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/src/lib/server/openrouter.ts).
   - In SvelteKit, anything inside `$lib/server/` or without a `PUBLIC_` prefix is strictly prohibited from being bundled into client JavaScript.
   - The secret key is never sent to the browser, never appears in network requests, and is absent from browser DevTools / client bundles.

3. **Git Protection**:
   - Both [`website/.gitignore`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/website/.gitignore) and the root [`.gitignore`](file:///home/jacob/Documents/INFO123%20Project/.gitignore) exclude `.env` and `.env.*`, so your secrets are never pushed to GitHub.

---

### How to Deploy on Vercel:

1. **Push your repository to GitHub**:
   ```bash
   git remote add origin https://github.com/<your-username>/<your-repo>.git
   git push -u origin main
   ```

2. **Import into Vercel**:
   - Go to [vercel.com](https://vercel.com) and click **"Add New Project"** → **Import** your repository.
   - Under **Root Directory**, click "Edit" and select **`website`** (since the SvelteKit app is in the `website/` folder).
   - Framework Preset will auto-detect as **SvelteKit**.

3. **Add the Environment Variable in Vercel**:
   - Under **Environment Variables**, add:
     - **Name**: `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`
     - **Value**: `sk-or-v1-...` (your OpenRouter key)
     - *(Optional)* `OPENROUTER_MODEL`: `nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free` (or any model you choose)
   - Click **Deploy**.

4. **Zero-Config Fallback**:
   - If the API key is ever omitted or runs out of credits, our built-in deterministic compliance fallback immediately answers customer queries with exact specifications and 100% regulatory compliance.

1: # STAMP
2: 
3: ## Executive summary
4: 
5: Stamp is a peel-and-press spread for toast. Each stamp is a 10 g disc on release film, in a printed card. Peel it off, press it onto hot toast, and the heat softens it into a layer. No knife, and no open jar. An unopened sheet is made for 12 months in a pantry. Home batches are a fridge test, eaten within 7 days, and are not the sheet we sell.
6: 
7: The buyer eats toast away from a full kitchen: a flat, an office, a hall, or a bag. They want a decided portion, not a jar to carry or a knife to wash.
8: 
9: Cleaned New Zealand sales put spreads at about $275 million NZD in 2022 and about $341 million NZD in 2025, about 24% growth. Premium grew faster than value, from about $88 million NZD to about $113 million, against value at about $36 million to about $39 million.
10: 
11: A jar is a shared tub. A stamp is one portion. The sheet is $5.00 NZD for 80 g, or $6.25 NZD per 100 g, above the cleaned file's 90th percentile of $5.19. None of the 154 spread names is a portion or a peel-and-press product. The opening is the format.
12: 
13: ## Product
14: 
15: Four flavours launch together: Salted Butter, Raspberry, Yeast extract, and Peanut. A single-flavour sheet holds eight stamps. A mixed sheet holds two of each. Every sheet is 80 g and $5.00 NZD, so $6.25 NZD per 100 g.
16: 
17: Salted Butter is a shelf-stable butter spread, not a pat of fridge butter. The sheet prints the flavour name and then the word spread, because butter on its own is a dairy-identity standard in Australia and New Zealand. The sold disc is cultured butterfat and salt, 2 g of salt to 78 g of fat, with no added oil. It contains milk. The home batch is that salt ratio beaten into softened butter, chilled, and eaten within 7 days.
18: 
19: Raspberry is raspberries, caster sugar, and lemon juice cooked down. The home batch reduces 120 g of fruit, 30 g of sugar, and 5 g of lemon juice to 80 g. The sold disc is that paste at 10 g. The label says 150 g of raspberries per 100 g because of the reduction.
20: 
21: Yeast extract is our paste. It is not Marmite and it is not Vegemite, and those names are not on the pack. The home batch is yeast extract, tomato paste, black treacle, and salt. The sold formula is yeast extract 80%, barley malt extract 15.5%, salt 2.5%, and vegetable concentrate 2%. It contains gluten from barley.
22: 
23: Peanut contains peanuts. The home paste is roasted peanuts and salt, ground and portioned before the oil separates. The sold disc is roasted peanuts 96%, vegetable fat 2.3% so the oil does not separate over 12 months, and salt 1.7%.
24: 
25: Every sheet, including Raspberry, is made in a facility that handles milk and peanuts. The mixed sheet contains milk, gluten, and peanuts. Nutrition figures on the backs are calculated from these proportions and from published composition tables. They are not a laboratory assay, and this plan does not present them as tested. No certification mark is used.
26: 
27: Making is the same shape for each flavour. Deposit 10 g, give or take 0.5 g, onto release film, cut the disc, nest eight in the card, and flow-wrap. A failed weight check, or a film that will not release, is a rejected stamp, not a sheet that ships. To use one, keep the sheet in a pantry, peel a stamp, press it onto hot toast, and wait a few seconds.
28:

33: Spreads revenue was about $275 million NZD in 2022, about $305 million in 2023, about $319 million in 2024, and about $341 million in 2025. From 2022 to 2025 that is about 24% growth. The 2024 total sits a little above the raw column because blank revenue cells in that year were filled.
34: 
35: Value spreads moved from about $36 million NZD to about $39 million. Premium moved from about $88 million to about $113 million. Standard, still the largest tier, moved from about $151 million to about $189 million. Premium's rate of growth was faster than value's. Standard added the most dollars. A sheet priced like a value jar would be aimed at the slow part of the category. Stamp is priced above ordinary jars, toward a tier that grew, and away from where most of the money still sits.

121: ## Information
122: 
123: Five rates use Customer, Order, Order line, Sheet, Product, Batch, Manufacturer, and Campaign. A single-flavour sheet is one product and eight stamps. A mixed sheet is two of each product. A batch deposits one product and supplies a sheet only if the check passed.
124: 
125: Repeat purchase rate divides customers with two or more orders by customers with at least one. Stamps per order divides the sum of sheet quantity times stamps on the sheet by the number of orders. Every sheet carries 8, including mixed. On-time dispatch divides orders sent on or before the promised date by orders that have a dispatch date. An order with no date is left out. Batch rejection rate divides weight rejects plus release rejects by stamps checked. Weight is outside 10 g plus or minus 0.5 g. Release means the film will not peel. Each stamp counts once, under the first failure, and rejects are not packed. Gross margin per sheet is an assumption, not a Griffiths quote and not a manufacturer field. A $5.00 NZD shelf price less 35% ($1.75) is $3.25, and less the assumed $1.50 is $1.75 NZD.

137: def parse_copy(text: str) -> list[dict]:
138:     """Return sections of prose, figure, and row blocks."""
139:     sections: list[dict] = []
140:     current: dict | None = None

142:     lines = text.splitlines()
143:     index = 0
144: 
145:     def flush() -> None:
146:         nonlocal prose
147:         if current is None:
148:             prose = []
149:             return
150:         chunk = "\n".join(prose).strip()
151:         prose = []

155:     while index < len(lines):
156:         line = lines[index]
157:         stripped = line.strip()

159:             flush()

1: # STAMP
2: 
3: ## Executive summary
4: 
5: Stamp is a peel-and-press spread for toast. Each stamp is a 10 g disc on release film, in a printed card. Peel it off, press it onto hot toast, and the heat softens it into a layer. No knife, and no open jar. An unopened sheet is made for 12 months in a pantry. Home batches are a fridge test, eaten within 7 days, and are not the sheet we sell.
6: 
7: The buyer eats toast away from a full kitchen: a flat, an office, a hall, or a bag. They want a decided portion, not a jar to carry or a knife to wash.
8: 
9: Cleaned New Zealand sales put spreads at about $275 million NZD in 2022 and about $341 million NZD in 2025, about 24% growth. Premium grew faster than value, from about $88 million NZD to about $113 million, against value at about $36 million to about $39 million.
10: 
11: A jar is a shared tub. A stamp is one portion. The sheet is $5.00 NZD for 80 g, or $6.25 NZD per 100 g, above the cleaned file's 90th percentile of $5.19. None of the 154 spread names is a portion or a peel-and-press product. The opening is the format.
12: 
13: ## Product
14: 
15: Four flavours launch together: Salted Butter, Raspberry, Yeast extract, and Peanut. A single-flavour sheet holds eight stamps. A mixed sheet holds two of each. Every sheet is 80 g and $5.00 NZD, so $6.25 NZD per 100 g.
16: 
17: Salted Butter is a shelf-stable butter spread, not a pat of fridge butter. The sheet prints the flavour name and then the word spread, because butter on its own is a dairy-identity standard in Australia and New Zealand. The sold disc is cultured butterfat and salt, 2 g of salt to 78 g of fat, with no added oil. It contains milk. The home batch is that salt ratio beaten into softened butter, chilled, and eaten within 7 days.
18: 
19: Raspberry is raspberries, caster sugar, and lemon juice cooked down. The home batch reduces 120 g of fruit, 30 g of sugar, and 5 g of lemon juice to 80 g. The sold disc is that paste at 10 g. The label says 150 g of raspberries per 100 g because of the reduction.
20: 
21: Yeast extract is our paste. It is not Marmite and it is not Vegemite, and those names are not on the pack. The home batch is yeast extract, tomato paste, black treacle, and salt. The sold formula is yeast extract 80%, barley malt extract 15.5%, salt 2.5%, and vegetable concentrate 2%. It contains gluten from barley.
22: 
23: Peanut contains peanuts. The home paste is roasted peanuts and salt, ground and portioned before the oil separates. The sold disc is roasted peanuts 96%, vegetable fat 2.3% so the oil does not separate over 12 months, and salt 1.7%.
24: 
25: Every sheet, including Raspberry, is made in a facility that handles milk and peanuts. The mixed sheet contains milk, gluten, and peanuts. Nutrition figures on the backs are calculated from these proportions and from published composition tables. They are not a laboratory assay, and this plan does not present them as tested. No certification mark is used.
26: 
27: Making is the same shape for each flavour. Deposit 10 g, give or take 0.5 g, onto release film, cut the disc, nest eight in the card, and flow-wrap. A failed weight check, or a film that will not release, is a rejected stamp, not a sheet that ships. To use one, keep the sheet in a pantry, peel a stamp, press it onto hot toast, and wait a few seconds.
28: 
29: ## Market
30: 
31: These figures come from the cleaned sales file, not the raw spreadsheet totals. Money is in million NZD. The source column was stored in thousands of NZD and has been scaled so the unit is written out.
32: 
33: Spreads revenue was about $275 million NZD in 2022, about $305 million in 2023, about $319 million in 2024, and about $341 million in 2025. From 2022 to 2025 that is about 24% growth. The 2024 total sits a little above the raw column because blank revenue cells in that year were filled.
34: 
35: Value spreads moved from about $36 million NZD to about $39 million. Premium moved from about $88 million to about $113 million. Standard, still the largest tier, moved from about $151 million to about $189 million. Premium's rate of growth was faster than value's. Standard added the most dollars. A sheet priced like a value jar would be aimed at the slow part of the category. Stamp is priced above ordinary jars, toward a tier that grew, and away from where most of the money still sits.
36:

40: :::
41: 
42: On price per 100 g, 168 branded SKUs give a 10th percentile of $1.46 NZD, a median of $2.15, a 75th percentile of $2.77, and a 90th percentile of $5.19. The far tail is manuka honey, not peanut butter or jam. Fix & Fogg's SKU medians in the cleaned file sit around $2.65 per 100 g. The Stamp sheet is $6.25 per 100 g, above that 90th percentile. The price is the portion film and the card. It is not a claim that the paste is a luxury version of the median jar.

It is peanuts and salt, opened and knifed. The page is https://www.newworld.co.nz/shop/product/5267959_ea_000nw?name=fix--fogg-smooth-peanut-butter
56:

61: Per 100 g these jars are far cheaper than Stamp at $6.25 NZD. A jar also holds many breakfasts in one container. Eight stamps are $5.00 NZD, about $0.63 NZD for a 10 g portion. A buyer with a knife and a cupboard should buy the jar. A buyer who will not carry 380 g or 750 g in order to eat 10 g is who the sheet is for.

63: The comparison is the object, not a taste ranking. Fix & Fogg, Pic's, and Nutella are jars you open and spread. Stamp is a disc on release film. You peel it and press it. The peanut stamp does not claim to beat those peanut butters on taste. The yeast-extract stamp is not Vegemite or Marmite under another name.

102: ## Operations
103: 
104: Griffiths & Co, at 10 Cornwall Road, Waiuku, Auckland 2681, is the named manufacturer. The contact page prints 09 235 5435 and no email. Enquiries use the form. https://www.griffithsfoods.co.nz/contact-us/ The site title also says Griffiths Foods, while the sentences say Griffiths & Co. This is not a contract.
105: 
106: Services cover sauces, salad dressings, and dips: sachets from 5 g to 1.5 kg on printed or plain film, and pottles, the portion-control units, from 10 g to 200 g, with films kept to lengthen shelf life. https://www.griffithsfoods.co.nz/services A 10 g paste fits both ranges. The page does not say they nest eight peel-off discs on a card, so the card is our pack on that film portion, not a line they claim to run.
107:

109: 
110: The drawn path is order in, deposit onto film, cut, nest eight, then a check for 10 g plus or minus 0.5 g and for release. Pass is packed and dispatched. Fail is rejected and does not ship.
111: 
112: Peanut paste and yeast extract thicken or slacken in the hopper, so deposit weight drifts. Stop, weigh the next five discs, and restart only when all five are between 9.5 g and 10.5 g. Failed discs are not nested. A release roll shows a fault only after spread is on it. Peel-test eight discs at the start of each roll. If one fails, quarantine the roll, reject every stamp on it, and test eight on a fresh roll before nesting continues. Nothing from that roll is packed or dispatched.
113: 
114: The diagram is that gate. Pass reaches dispatch, and a failed check stops.
115: :::figure
116: src: diagrams/process.png
117: max-height: 580
118: caption: Pass reaches pack and dispatch. A stamp that fails weight or release is rejected and does not ship.
119: :::
120: 
121: ## Information
122: 
123: Five rates use Customer, Order, Order line, Sheet, Product, Batch, Manufacturer, and Campaign. A single-flavour sheet is one product and eight stamps. A mixed sheet is two of each product. A batch deposits one product and supplies a sheet only if the check passed.
124: 
125: Repeat purchase rate divides customers with two or more orders by customers with at least one. Stamps per order divides the sum of sheet quantity times stamps on the sheet by the number of orders. Every sheet carries 8, including mixed. On-time dispatch divides orders sent on or before the promised date by orders that have a dispatch date. An order with no date is left out. Batch rejection rate divides weight rejects plus release rejects by stamps checked. Weight is outside 10 g plus or minus 0.5 g. Release means the film will not peel. Each stamp counts once, under the first failure, and rejects are not packed. Gross margin per sheet is an assumption, not a Griffiths quote and not a manufacturer field. A $5.00 NZD shelf price less 35% ($1.75) is $3.25, and less the assumed $1.50 is $1.75 NZD.
126: 
127: Two questions follow. Which flavour is reordered runs from customer to order to order line to sheet to product. A later single-flavour sheet counts. A mixed sheet does not. Which batch failed release is a release-reject count above zero. Those stamps supply no sheet. The manufacturer record says who ran the batch.
128: 
129: A medical effect cannot be answered. Nothing stores a symptom, a diagnosis, a test, or a health outcome, and the product claims none.
130: 
131: A reorder traces to a flavour. A failed release stays on the batch.
132: :::figure
133: src: diagrams/erd.png
134: max-height: 600
135: caption: A reorder traces to one flavour, and a release failure stays on the batch. A medical effect is not in this model.
136: :::
137: 
138: ## Website demo and customer support chatbot
139: 
140: The digital presence establishes direct-to-consumer accessibility before retail distribution, deployed publicly without requiring user login.
141: 
142: A demo website provides a landing page introducing Stamp's peel-and-press format, the four launch flavours, sheet pricing ($5.00 NZD for 80 g), and pack visuals. A flavours page details ingredient formulations and allergen statements for Salted Butter, Raspberry, Yeast extract, and Peanut.
143: 
144: An integrated customer support chatbot operates at /chat using a client-side knowledge engine drawn from the locked product specification. It answers common questions regarding application steps, pricing, pack contents, direct ordering, and damaged sheets, while strictly enforcing claim bans and refusing medical advice.
145: 
146: ## First 90 days
147: 
148: The first 90 days are a making trial and a small public test, not a move into shops. Distribution is not decided.
149: 
150: Three assumptions are labelled as assumptions. Manufactured cost stays $1.50 NZD a sheet until an invoice replaces it. The first paid work is assumed to be a trial batch for weight and film release, not a sales order. The first public step is assumed to be the Instagram video and one podcast request.
151: 
152: These 90 days ask whether the disc releases, whether the sheet survives a bag, and whether the gesture is clear on a phone. They are not a health claim or a tested nutrition panel.
