```
def parse_copy(text: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Return sections of prose, figure, and row blocks."""
    sections: list[dict] = []
    current: dict | None = None
    prose: list[str] = []
    lines = text.splitlines()
    index = 0

    def flush() -> None:
        nonlocal prose
        if current is None:
            prose = []
            return
        chunk = "\n".join(prose).strip()
        prose = []
        if chunk:
            current["blocks"].append(("prose", chunk))

    while index < len(lines):
        line = lines[index]
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("## "):
            flush()
            current = {"title": stripped[3:].strip(), "blocks": []}
            sections.append(current)
            index += 1
            continue
        if stripped == ":::figure":
            flush()
            if current is None:
                raise SystemExit("figure block before any section")
            index += 1
            fields: dict[str, str] = {}
            while index < len(lines) and lines[index].strip() != ":::":
                raw = lines[index].strip()
                if ":" in raw:
                    key, value = raw.split(":", 1)
                    fields[key.strip()] = value.strip()
                index += 1
            current["blocks"].append(("figure", fields))
            index += 1
            continue
        if stripped == ":::row":
            flush()
            if current is None:
                raise SystemExit("row block before any section")
            index += 1
            items: list[dict[str, str]] = []
            pending: dict[str, str] = {}
            while index < len(lines) and lines[index].strip() != ":::":
                raw = lines[index].strip()
                if raw.startswith("src:"):
                    if pending.get("src") and pending.get("caption"):
                        items.append(pending)
                    pending = {"src": raw.split(":", 1)[1].strip()}
                elif raw.startswith("caption:"):
                    pending["caption"] = raw.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                index += 1
            if pending.get("src") and pending.get("caption"):
                items.append(pending)
            current["blocks"].append(("row", items))
            index += 1
            continue
        if stripped.startswith("# "):
            index += 1
            continue
        prose.append(line)
        index += 1
    flush()
    return sections


def prose_word_counts(sections: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, dict[str, int]]:
    per: dict[str, int] = {}
    total = 0
    for section in sections:
        parts: list[str] = []
        for block in section["blocks"]:
            if block[0] != "prose":
                continue
            for line in block[1].splitlines():
                if line.strip().startswith("|"):
                    continue
                parts.append(line)
        raw = "\n".join(parts)
        raw = re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)", r"\1", raw)
        raw = raw.replace("**", "").replace("*", "").replace("`", "")
        words = raw.split()
        per[section["title"]] = len(words)
        total += len(words)
    return total, per


def xml_text(text: str) -> str:
    text = text.replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;")

    def soften(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        url = match.group(0)
        plain = url.replace("&amp;", "&")
        limit = 480

        def wide(value: str) -> float:
            return pdfmetrics.stringWidth(value, "Manrope", 9.8)

        if wide(plain) <= limit:
            return url
        pieces = url.split("/")
        lines: list[str] = []
        current = pieces[0]
        for piece in pieces[1:]:
            addition = "/" + piece
            trial = (current + addition).replace("&amp;", "&")
            if current and wide(trial) > limit:
                lines.append(current)
                current = addition
            else:
                current += addition
        if current:
            lines.append(current)
        return "<br/>".join(lines)

    text = re.sub(r"https?://[^\s<]+", soften, text)
    text = re.sub(r"\*\*([^*]+)\*\*", r"<b>\1</b>", text)
    return text


def body_paragraph(text: str, style: ParagraphStyle):
    xml = xml_text(text)
    kind = SolidParagraph if "http" in xml else Paragraph
    return kind(xml, style)


def prepare_image(src: Path, dest: Path) -> tuple[int, int]:
    image = PILImage.open(src).convert("RGBA")
    base = PILImage.new("RGBA", image.size, (255, 255, 255, 255))
    flat = PILImage.alpha_composite(base, image).convert("RGB")
    flat.save(dest, "PNG")
    return flat.size


def create_cover_wordmark(src: Path, dest: Path) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Extract smooth, anti-aliased Electric Lavender STAMP wordmark."""
    img = PILImage.open(src).convert("RGBA")
    arr = np.array(img).astype(float)
    diff = np.sqrt(
        (arr[:, :, 0] - 226) ** 2
        + (arr[:, :, 1] - 75) ** 2
        + (arr[:, :, 2] - 255) ** 2
    )
    alpha = np.clip((diff - 20) / 60.0, 0, 1)
    out = np.zeros((img.height, img.width, 4), dtype=np.uint8)
    out[:, :, 0] = 226
    out[:, :, 1] = 75
    out[:, :, 2] = 255
    out[:, :, 3] = (alpha * 255).astype(np.uint8)
    res = PILImage.fromarray(out)
    bbox = res.getbbox()
    pad = 20
    box = (
        max(0, bbox[0] - pad),
        max(0, bbox[1] - pad),
        min(img.width, bbox[2] + pad),
        min(img.height, bbox[3] + pad),
    )
    cropped = res.crop(box)
    cropped.save(dest, "PNG")
    return cropped.size


class CoverPage(Flowable):
    def __init__(self, mark_path: str, px_w: int, px_h: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.mark_path = mark_path
        self.px_w = px_w
        self.px_h = px_h

    def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        self.avail_width = avail_width
        self.avail_height = avail_height
        return avail_width, avail_height

    def draw(self):
        canv = self.canv
        W = self.avail_width
        H = self.avail_height
        cx = W / 2

        # 1. Kicker Badge (flat solid pill, zero outlines)
        badge_w = 210
        badge_h = 24
        badge_x = cx - badge_w / 2
        badge_y = H - 90
        canv.setFillColor(TERTIARY)
        canv.roundRect(badge_x, badge_y, badge_w, badge_h, 12, stroke=0, fill=1)
        canv.setFillColor(PRIMARY)
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 8.5)
        canv.drawCentredString(cx, badge_y + 7.5, "STAMP SPREADS NEW ZEALAND")

        # 2. Hero Wordmark
        mark_w = 380
        mark_h = mark_w * self.px_h / self.px_w
        mark_x = cx - mark_w / 2
        mark_y = badge_y - 32 - mark_h
        canv.drawImage(
            self.mark_path,
            mark_x,
            mark_y,
            mark_w,
            mark_h,
            mask="auto",
            preserveAspectRatio=True,
        )

        # 3. Tagline (matching website hero: .hero-tagline)
        tag_y = mark_y - 32
        canv.setFillColor(PRIMARY)
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 24)
        canv.drawCentredString(cx, tag_y, "PEEL. PRESS. TOAST.")

        # 4. Lead text (matching website hero: .hero-lead)
        sub_y = tag_y - 24
        canv.setFillColor(WHITE)
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Semi", 12.5)
        canv.drawCentredString(
            cx, sub_y, "Single-Serve Toast Spread Discs on Food-Grade Release Film"
        )

        sub2_y = sub_y - 20
        canv.setFillColor(MUTED_LAVENDER)
        canv.setFont("Manrope", 10.5)
        canv.drawCentredString(
            cx, sub2_y, "No Knife. No Messy Jar. Ambient Shelf Stability."
        )

        # 5. Three Hero Badges (exact match to website hero: .hero-badges-row)
        badges_y = sub2_y - 34
        b_labels = ["$5.00 NZD / Sheet", "12-Month Pantry Stable", "No Jar Waste"]
        b_widths = [130, 155, 115]
        b_gap = 12
        total_bw = sum(b_widths) + b_gap * 2
        bx = cx - total_bw / 2
        for w, text in zip(b_widths, b_labels):
            canv.setFillColor(TERTIARY)
            canv.roundRect(bx, badges_y, w, 22, 11, stroke=0, fill=1)
            canv.setFillColor(PRIMARY)
            canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 8.5)
            canv.drawCentredString(bx + w / 2, badges_y + 6.5, text)
            bx += w + b_gap

        # 6. Flat Solid Card (matching website cards: Tertiary #3B0764, ZERO outlines)
        card_w = min(W - 20, 460)
        card_h = 130
        card_x = cx - card_w / 2
        card_y = badges_y - 38 - card_h
        canv.setFillColor(TERTIARY)
        canv.roundRect(card_x, card_y, card_w, card_h, 16, stroke=0, fill=1)

        # Card content (Two clean columns)
        col1_x = card_x + 24
        col2_x = card_x + card_w / 2 + 10
        row_y = card_y + card_h - 30
        gap = 32

        def row(x, y, label, val):
            canv.setFillColor(MUTED_LAVENDER)
            canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 8)
            canv.drawString(x, y + 10, label.upper())
            canv.setFillColor(WHITE)
            canv.setFont("Manrope-Semi", 10)
            canv.drawString(x, y - 2, val)

        row(col1_x, row_y, "Prepared By", "Jacob")
        row(col1_x, row_y - gap, "Date", "30 September 2026")
        row(col1_x, row_y - 2 * gap, "Document", "Commercial Business Plan")

        row(col2_x, row_y, "Live Digital Platform", "stamp-spreads.vercel.app")
        row(col2_x, row_y - gap, "Source Code", "github.com/JacobCrume/stamp-spreads")
        row(col2_x, row_y - 2 * gap, "Status", "Investor Proposal & Production Pilot")

        # 7. Bottom Confidential Line
        canv.setFillColor(MUTED_LAVENDER)
        canv.setFont("Manrope", 8.5)
        canv.drawCentredString(
            cx, 28, "Confidential Document  •  Stamp Spreads Ltd  •  Auckland, New Zealand"
        )


class SectionHeader(Flowable):
    def __init__(self, kicker: str, title: str):
        super().__init__()
        self.kicker = kicker.upper()
        self.title = title
        self.height = 36

    def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        self.avail_width = avail_width
        return avail_width, self.height

    def draw(self):
        canv = self.canv
        canv.saveState()
        # Kicker
        canv.setFillColor(PRIMARY)
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 8.5)
        canv.drawString(0, 24, self.kicker)

        # Title
        canv.setFillColor(WHITE)
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 15)
        canv.drawString(0, 7, self.title)

        # Clean bottom underline (matching website .data-identity)
        canv.setFillColor(PRIMARY)
        canv.rect(0, 0, self.avail_width, 2, stroke=0, fill=1)
        canv.restoreState()


class CleanFigureBlock(Flowable):
    def __init__(self, path: str, caption: str, max_height: float, pref_width: float | None):
        super().__init__()
        self.path = path
        self.caption = caption
        self.max_height = max_height
        self.pref_width = pref_width
        with PILImage.open(path) as image:
            self.px_w, self.px_h = image.size

    def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        self.avail_width = avail_width
        card_w = avail_width if self.pref_width is None else min(avail_width, self.pref_width)
        pad = 12
        inner_w = card_w - 2 * pad
        inner_max_h = self.max_height - 35
        scale = min(inner_w / self.px_w, inner_max_h / self.px_h)
        self.draw_w = self.px_w * scale
        self.draw_h = self.px_h * scale

        self.card_w = self.draw_w + 2 * pad
        self.paragraph = Paragraph(xml_text(self.caption), styles()["cap"])
        _cw, self.cap_h = self.paragraph.wrap(self.card_w, 800)
        self.card_h = self.draw_h + pad + 6 + self.cap_h
        return avail_width, self.card_h

    def draw(self):
        canv = self.canv
        cx = (self.avail_width - self.card_w) / 2
        pad = 12

        canv.saveState()
        # Flat solid card surface: Tertiary #3B0764, ZERO OUTLINES!
        canv.setFillColor(TERTIARY)
        canv.roundRect(cx, 0, self.card_w, self.card_h, 16, stroke=0, fill=1)

        # Image centered
        img_x = cx + (self.card_w - self.draw_w) / 2
        img_y = self.cap_h + 8
        canv.drawImage(
            self.path,
            img_x,
            img_y,
            self.draw_w,
            self.draw_h,
            mask="auto",
            preserveAspectRatio=True,
        )

        # Caption
        self.paragraph.drawOn(canv, cx, 4)
        canv.restoreState()


class CleanImageRow(Flowable):
    def __init__(self, items: list[tuple[str, str]], max_height: float):
        super().__init__()
        self.items = items
        self.max_height = max_height
        self.sizes = []
        for p, _c in items:
            with PILImage.open(p) as img:
                self.sizes.append(img.size)

    def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        count = len(self.items)
        gap = 14
        col_w = (avail_width - gap * (count - 1)) / count
        pad = 10
        inner_w = col_w - 2 * pad
        inner_max_h = self.max_height - 35
        self.cols = []
        row_h = 0
        cap_style = styles()["cap"]

        for (path, caption), (px_w, px_h) in zip(self.items, self.sizes):
            scale = min(inner_w / px_w, inner_max_h / px_h)
            draw_w = px_w * scale
            draw_h = px_h * scale
            paragraph = Paragraph(xml_text(caption), cap_style)
            _cw, cap_h = paragraph.wrap(col_w - 8, 800)
            card_h = draw_h + pad + 6 + cap_h
            row_h = max(row_h, card_h)
            self.cols.append((path, draw_w, draw_h, paragraph, cap_h, col_w, card_h))

        self.gap = gap
        self.avail_width = avail_width
        self.row_h = row_h
        return avail_width, row_h

    def draw(self):
        canv = self.canv
        x = 0
        pad = 10
        for path, draw_w, draw_h, paragraph, cap_h, col_w, card_h in self.cols:
            cy = self.row_h - card_h
            canv.saveState()
            canv.setFillColor(TERTIARY)
            canv.roundRect(x, cy, col_w, card_h, 16, stroke=0, fill=1)

            img_x = x + (col_w - draw_w) / 2
            img_y = cy + cap_h + 8
            canv.drawImage(
                path,
                img_x,
                img_y,
                draw_w,
                draw_h,
                mask="auto",
                preserveAspectRatio=True,
            )

            paragraph.drawOn(canv, x + 4, cy + 4)
            canv.restoreState()
            x += col_w + self.gap


def draw_cover(canvas, _doc) -> None:
    canvas.saveState()
    canvas.setFillColor(SECONDARY)
    canvas.rect(0, 0, A4[0], A4[1], stroke=0, fill=1)
    canvas.setTitle("STAMP Business Plan & Investor Prospectus")
    canvas.setAuthor("Jacob")
    canvas.restoreState()


def draw_body(canvas, doc) -> None:
    canvas.saveState()
    W, H = A4

    # Stationary Background: Deep Night Ink (#240340)
    canvas.setFillColor(SECONDARY)
    canvas.rect(0, 0, W, H, stroke=0, fill=1)

    # Floating Dynamic Header (Tertiary BG #3B0764, Primary Text #E24BFF, ZERO OUTLINES)
    pill_h = 26
    pill_y = H - 38
    pill_w = W - LEFT - RIGHT
    canvas.setFillColor(TERTIARY)
    canvas.roundRect(LEFT, pill_y, pill_w, pill_h, 13, stroke=0, fill=1)

    # Header text
    canvas.setFillColor(PRIMARY)
    canvas.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 9.5)
    canvas.drawString(LEFT + 14, pill_y + 8, "STAMP")

    canvas.setFillColor(WHITE)
    canvas.setFont("Manrope-Semi", 8.5)
    canvas.drawString(LEFT + 62, pill_y + 8, "PEEL. PRESS. TOAST.")

    canvas.setFillColor(MUTED_LAVENDER)
    canvas.setFont("Manrope-Med", 8)
    canvas.drawRightString(W - RIGHT - 14, pill_y + 8, "BUSINESS PLAN & INVESTOR PROSPECTUS")

    # Floating Footer
    foot_h = 24
    foot_y = 16
    canvas.setFillColor(TERTIARY)
    canvas.roundRect(LEFT, foot_y, pill_w, foot_h, 12, stroke=0, fill=1)

    canvas.setFillColor(MUTED_LAVENDER)
    canvas.setFont("Manrope-Semi", 8)
    canvas.drawString(LEFT + 14, foot_y + 7.5, "STAMP SPREADS NZ   |   CONFIDENTIAL")

    canvas.setFillColor(WHITE)
    canvas.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 8)
    canvas.drawRightString(W - RIGHT - 14, foot_y + 7.5, f"PAGE {doc.page}")

    canvas.setTitle("STAMP Business Plan & Investor Prospectus")
    canvas.setAuthor("Jacob")
    canvas.restoreState()


def resolve_src(src: str) -> Path:
    path = Path(src)
    if not path.is_absolute():
        path = ROOT / path
    if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"missing or empty image: {path}")
    return path


def check_inputs(copy_text: str) -> None:
    if "WAIT_FOR_INPUT" in copy_text or "TODO" in copy_text:
        raise SystemExit("copy.md still has placeholders; PDF not written")
    missing = []
    for relative in REQUIRED_INPUTS:
        path = ROOT / relative
        if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
            missing.append(relative)
    if missing:
        raise SystemExit("missing inputs, PDF not written: " + ", ".join(missing))


def build_story(sections: list[dict], work: Path, wordmark: tuple[str, int, int]) -> list:
    style = styles()
    story: list = []
    path, px_w, px_h = wordmark
    story.append(CoverPage(path, px_w, px_h))
    story.append(NextPageTemplate("body"))
    story.append(PageBreak())

    for section_index, section in enumerate(sections):
        if section_index:
            story.append(CondPageBreak(95))
        kicker = SECTION_KICKERS.get(section["title"], "STRATEGIC PROPOSAL")
        story.append(SectionHeader(kicker, section["title"]))
        story.append(Spacer(1, 10))

        pending = None
        for index, (kind, payload) in enumerate(section["blocks"]):
            if kind == "prose":
                if pending is not None:
                    story.append(pending)
                    pending = None
                paragraphs = [part.strip() for part in payload.split("\n\n") if part.strip()]
                nxt = (
                    section["blocks"][index + 1][0]
                    if index + 1 < len(section["blocks"])
                    else ""
                )
                hold = nxt in {"figure", "row"} and len(paragraphs) > 0
                body = paragraphs[:-1] if hold else paragraphs
                for part in body:
                    story.append(body_paragraph(part, style["body"]))
                if hold:
                    pending = body_paragraph(paragraphs[-1], style["body"])
                continue
            visuals = visual_flowables(kind, payload, work)
            if pending is not None:
                story.append(KeepTogether([pending, *visuals]))
                pending = None
            else:
                story.extend(visuals)
        if pending is not None:
            story.append(pending)
    return story


def visual_flowables(kind: str, payload, work: Path) -> list:
    if kind == "figure":
        src = resolve_src(payload["src"])
        caption = payload.get("caption", "").strip()
        if not caption:
            raise SystemExit(f"figure missing a caption: {src}")
        flat = work / f"fig-{len(list(work.iterdir()))}.png"
        prepare_image(src, flat)
        pref = float(payload["width"]) if payload.get("width") else None
        max_h = float(payload["max-height"]) if payload.get("max-height") else 400
        return [
            Spacer(1, 4),
            CleanFigureBlock(str(flat), caption, max_h, pref),
            Spacer(1, 8),
        ]
    if kind == "row":
        prepared = []
        for item in payload:
            src = resolve_src(item["src"])
            flat = work / f"row-{len(list(work.iterdir()))}.png"
            prepare_image(src, flat)
            prepared.append((str(flat), item["caption"]))
        return [Spacer(1, 4), CleanImageRow(prepared, 230), Spacer(1, 8)]
    raise SystemExit(f"unknown block {kind}")


def main() -> int:
    if not COPY_PATH.is_file() or COPY_PATH.stat().st_size == 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"missing copy: {COPY_PATH}")
    copy_text = COPY_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    check_inputs(copy_text)
    sections = parse_copy(copy_text)
    if not sections:
        raise SystemExit("copy.md has no sections")
    total, per_section = prose_word_counts(sections)
    for title, count in per_section.items():
        print(f"{count:4d}  {title}")
    print(f"{total:4d}  TOTAL")
    if total < MIN_WORDS or total > MAX_WORDS:
        print(
            f"error: prose word count {total} is outside {MIN_WORDS}–{MAX_WORDS}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        return 1

    register_fonts()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="stamp-plan-") as temporary:
        work = Path(temporary)
        mark = work / "cover_wordmark.png"
        px_w, px_h = create_cover_wordmark(ROOT / "brand" / "logo.png", mark)
        story = build_story(sections, work, (str(mark), px_w, px_h))
        tmp_out = work / "plan.pdf"
        frame_h = A4[1] - FRAME_BOTTOM - FRAME_TOP
        frame_w = A4[0] - LEFT - RIGHT
        document = BaseDocTemplate(
            str(tmp_out),
            pagesize=A4,
            title="STAMP Business Plan & Investor Prospectus",
            author="Jacob",
        )
        document.addPageTemplates(
            [
                PageTemplate(
                    id="cover",
                    frames=[
                        Frame(
                            36,
                            36,
                            A4[0] - 72,
                            A4[1] - 72,
                            id="cover",
                            showBoundary=0,
                        )
                    ],
                    onPage=draw_cover,
                ),
                PageTemplate(
                    id="body",
                    frames=[
                        Frame(
                            LEFT,
                            FRAME_BOTTOM,
                            frame_w,
                            frame_h,
                            id="body",
                            showBoundary=0,
                        )
                    ],
                    onPage=draw_body,
                ),
            ]
        )
        document.build(story)
        OUT_PATH.write_bytes(tmp_out.read_bytes())
    print(f"wrote {OUT_PATH}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```bash
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image as PILImage
import numpy as np

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4

from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle
from reportlab.lib.enums import TA_LEFT, TA_CENTER
from reportlab.platypus import (
    BaseDocTemplate, PageTemplate, Frame, Flowable,
    Paragraph, Spacer, PageBreak, NextPageTemplate
)
from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont

ROOT = Path("/home/jacob/Documents/INFO123 Project")

pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("Manrope-Med", str(FONT_DIR / "Manrope-500.ttf")))
pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("Manrope-Semi", str(FONT_DIR / "Manrope-600.ttf")))
pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("Manrope-Bold", str(FONT_DIR / "Manrope-700.ttf")))

# 4 Schemes from website/src/lib/theme.svelte.ts
SCHEMES = [
    {
        "id": "yeast",
        "primary": HexColor("#E24BFF"),
        "secondary": HexColor("#240340"),
        "tertiary": HexColor("#3B0764")
    },

    },

    },
    {

        "primary": HexColor("#FF8C30"),

        "tertiary": HexColor("#2D1403")
    }
]

TEXT_DARK = HexColor("#1A1024")
INK = HexColor("#3B0764")
WHITE = HexColor("#FFFFFF")

LEFT = 48
RIGHT = 48
FRAME_BOTTOM = 54
FRAME_TOP = 50

# Cover Wordmark helper: create a smooth Electric Lavender wordmark
def create_cover_wordmark(src: Path, dest: Path) -> tuple[int, int]:
    img = PILImage.open(src).convert("RGBA")
    arr = np.array(img).astype(float)
    diff = np.sqrt((arr[:, :, 0] - 226)**2 + (arr[:, :, 1] - 75)**2 + (arr[:, :, 2] - 255)**2)
    alpha = np.clip((diff - 20) / 60.0, 0, 1)
    out = np.zeros((img.height, img.width, 4), dtype=np.uint8)
    out[:, :, 0] = 226
    out[:, :, 1] = 75
    out[:, :, 2] = 255
    out[:, :, 3] = (alpha * 255).astype(np.uint8)
    res = PILImage.fromarray(out)
    bbox = res.getbbox()
    pad = 20
    box = (max(0, bbox[0]-pad), max(0, bbox[1]-pad), min(img.width, bbox[2]+pad), min(img.height, bbox[3]+pad))
    cropped = res.crop(box)
    cropped.save(dest)
    return cropped.size

# COVER PAGE FLOWABLE
class MinimalCover(Flowable):
    def __init__(self, mark_path: str, px_w: int, px_h: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.mark_path = mark_path
        self.px_w = px_w
        self.px_h = px_h

    def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        self.avail_width = avail_width
        self.avail_height = avail_height
        return avail_width, avail_height

    def draw(self):
        canv = self.canv
        W = self.avail_width
        H = self.avail_height
        cx = W / 2

        # Center block: Wordmark + Tagline
        mark_w = 400
        mark_h = mark_w * self.px_h / self.px_w
        center_y = H / 2
        mark_y = center_y + 10
        mark_x = cx - mark_w / 2
        canv.drawImage(self.mark_path, mark_x, mark_y, mark_w, mark_h, mask="auto", preserveAspectRatio=True)

        # Tagline in the center below wordmark
        tag_y = mark_y - 36
        canv.setFillColor(HexColor("#E24BFF"))
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 24)
        canv.drawCentredString(cx, tag_y, "PEEL. PRESS. TOAST.")

        # Bottom: "Commercial Business Plan" in white text
        canv.setFillColor(WHITE)
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Semi", 14)
        canv.drawCentredString(cx, 48, "Commercial Business Plan")

# SECTION DIVIDER PAGE FLOWABLE
class SectionDivider(Flowable):
    def __init__(self, num: str, kicker: str, title: str, subtitle: str, scheme: dict):
        super().__init__()
        self.num = num
        self.kicker = kicker.upper()
        self.title = title
        self.subtitle = subtitle
        self.scheme = scheme

    def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        self.avail_width = avail_width
        self.avail_height = avail_height
        return avail_width, avail_height

    def draw(self):
        canv = self.canv
        W = self.avail_width
        H = self.avail_height

        # Position section header in upper half
        y_anchor = H * 0.62

        # 1. Kicker / Section number pill
        pill_w = 190
        pill_h = 24
        pill_y = y_anchor + 60
        canv.setFillColor(self.scheme["tertiary"])
        canv.roundRect(0, pill_y, pill_w, pill_h, 12, stroke=0, fill=1)
        canv.setFillColor(self.scheme["primary"])
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 9)
        canv.drawCentredString(pill_w / 2, pill_y + 7.5, f"SECTION {self.num}  •  {self.kicker}")

        # 2. Main Title
        canv.setFillColor(WHITE)
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 32)
        canv.drawString(0, y_anchor + 12, self.title)

        # 3. Flat Accent Rule
        canv.setFillColor(self.scheme["primary"])
        canv.rect(0, y_anchor, W, 3, stroke=0, fill=1)

        # 4. Subtitle / Theme descriptor
        if self.subtitle:
            canv.setFillColor(WHITE)
            canv.setFont("Manrope-Med", 13)
            canv.drawString(0, y_anchor - 26, self.subtitle)

def draw_cover_bg(canv, doc):
    canv.saveState()
    canv.setFillColor(HexColor("#240340"))
    canv.rect(0, 0, A4[0], A4[1], stroke=0, fill=1)
    canv.restoreState()

def make_section_bg_drawer(scheme: dict, mark_path: str):
    def drawer(canv, doc):
        canv.saveState()
        W, H = A4
        # Full-bleed background color
        canv.setFillColor(scheme["secondary"])
        canv.rect(0, 0, W, H, stroke=0, fill=1)

        # Bottom footer on section page
        # Left: Wordmark in primary/white
        mark_w = 54
        mark_h = 13
        canv.drawImage(mark_path, LEFT, 26, mark_w, mark_h, mask="auto", preserveAspectRatio=True)

        # Right: Page number
        canv.setFillColor(WHITE)
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 9)
        canv.drawRightString(W - RIGHT, 28, f"{doc.page}")
        canv.restoreState()
    return drawer

def make_content_bg_drawer(ink_mark_path: str):
    def drawer(canv, doc):
        canv.saveState()
        W, H = A4
        # Pure White Background
        canv.setFillColor(WHITE)
        canv.rect(0, 0, W, H, stroke=0, fill=1)

        # Footer: STAMP wordmark on the bottom left, page number on the right
        mark_w = 54
        mark_h = 13.2
        canv.drawImage(ink_mark_path, LEFT, 26, mark_w, mark_h, mask="auto", preserveAspectRatio=True)

        canv.setFillColor(INK)
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 9)
        canv.drawRightString(W - RIGHT, 28, f"{doc.page}")
        canv.restoreState()
    return drawer

mark_path = Path("/tmp/cover_mark.png")
px_w, px_h = create_cover_wordmark(ROOT / "brand" / "logo.png", mark_path)
ink_mark_path = str(ROOT / "brand" / "explorations" / "wordmark-ink.png")

body_style = ParagraphStyle(
    "content_body",
    fontName="Manrope",
    fontSize=10.2,
    leading=15.2,
    textColor=TEXT_DARK,
    spaceBefore=0,
    spaceAfter=9,
    alignment=TA_LEFT,
)

title_style = ParagraphStyle(

    fontName="Manrope-Bold",
    fontSize=18,
    leading=22,
    textColor=INK,
    spaceBefore=0,
    spaceAfter=12,
    alignment=TA_LEFT,
)

doc = BaseDocTemplate("/tmp/test_3pages.pdf", pagesize=A4)

# Frame for full-page cover & section dividers
full_frame = Frame(LEFT, FRAME_BOTTOM, A4[0]-LEFT-RIGHT, A4[1]-FRAME_BOTTOM-FRAME_TOP, id="full", showBoundary=0)
# Frame for content pages
content_frame = Frame(LEFT, FRAME_BOTTOM, A4[0]-LEFT-RIGHT, A4[1]-FRAME_BOTTOM-FRAME_TOP, id="content", showBoundary=0)

templates = [
    PageTemplate(id="cover", frames=[full_frame], onPage=draw_cover_bg),

]

# Story: Page 1 (Cover), Page 2 (Section), Page 3 (Content)
story = [
```

```bash
def create_recolored_wordmark(src: Path, dest: Path, rgb: tuple[int, int, int]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    img = PILImage.open(src).convert("RGBA")
    arr = np.array(img).astype(float)
    diff = np.sqrt((arr[:, :, 0] - 226)**2 + (arr[:, :, 1] - 75)**2 + (arr[:, :, 2] - 255)**2)
    alpha = np.clip((diff - 20) / 60.0, 0, 1)
    out = np.zeros((img.height, img.width, 4), dtype=np.uint8)
    out[:, :, 0] = rgb[0]
    out[:, :, 1] = rgb[1]
    out[:, :, 2] = rgb[2]
    out[:, :, 3] = (alpha * 255).astype(np.uint8)
    res = PILImage.fromarray(out)
    bbox = res.getbbox()
    pad = 20
    box = (max(0, bbox[0]-pad), max(0, bbox[1]-pad), min(img.width, bbox[2]+pad), min(img.height, bbox[3]+pad))
    cropped = res.crop(box)
    cropped.save(dest)
    return cropped.size

# COVER PAGE FLOWABLE (Super simple, centered STAMP + PEEL. PRESS. TOAST., Commercial Business Plan at bottom)
class MinimalCover(Flowable):
    def __init__(self, mark_path: str, px_w: int, px_h: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.mark_path = mark_path
        self.px_w = px_w
        self.px_h = px_h

    def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        self.avail_width = avail_width
        self.avail_height = avail_height
        return avail_width, avail_height

    def draw(self):
        canv = self.canv
        W = self.avail_width
        H = self.avail_height
        cx = W / 2

        # Dead center: Wordmark + Tagline
        mark_w = 400
        mark_h = mark_w * self.px_h / self.px_w
        center_y = H / 2
        mark_y = center_y + 10
        mark_x = cx - mark_w / 2
        canv.drawImage(self.mark_path, mark_x, mark_y, mark_w, mark_h, mask="auto", preserveAspectRatio=True)

        tag_y = mark_y - 36
        canv.setFillColor(HexColor("#E24BFF"))
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 24)
        canv.drawCentredString(cx, tag_y, "PEEL. PRESS. TOAST.")

        # Bottom in white text
        canv.setFillColor(WHITE)
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Semi", 14)
        canv.drawCentredString(cx, 48, "Commercial Business Plan")

# SECTION PAGE FLOWABLE (No section 01 pill, no line, shorter subtitle, both title & subtitle primary colored)
class CleanSectionPage(Flowable):
    def __init__(self, title: str, subtitle: str, scheme: dict):
        super().__init__()
        self.title = title
        self.subtitle = subtitle
        self.scheme = scheme

    def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        self.avail_width = avail_width
        self.avail_height = avail_height
        return avail_width, avail_height

    def draw(self):
        canv = self.canv
        W = self.avail_width
        H = self.avail_height

        # Position title and subtitle in upper-middle area
        y_anchor = H * 0.60

        # Title: Primary colored
        canv.setFillColor(self.scheme["primary"])
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 36)
        canv.drawString(0, y_anchor, self.title)

        # Subtitle: Short, also Primary colored (no line between them)
        if self.subtitle:
            canv.setFillColor(self.scheme["primary"])
            canv.setFont("Manrope-Semi", 16)
            canv.drawString(0, y_anchor - 32, self.subtitle)

def draw_cover_bg(canv, doc):
    canv.saveState()
    canv.setFillColor(HexColor("#240340"))
    canv.rect(0, 0, A4[0], A4[1], stroke=0, fill=1)
    canv.restoreState()

def make_section_bg_drawer(scheme: dict, mark_path: str):
    def drawer(canv, doc):
        canv.saveState()
        W, H = A4
        canv.setFillColor(scheme["secondary"])
        canv.rect(0, 0, W, H, stroke=0, fill=1)

        # Footer on section page:
        # Left: wordmark in primary color
        mark_w = 54
        mark_h = 13.2
        canv.drawImage(mark_path, LEFT, 26, mark_w, mark_h, mask="auto", preserveAspectRatio=True)

        # Right: page number in primary color
        canv.setFillColor(scheme["primary"])
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 9)
        canv.drawRightString(W - RIGHT, 28, f"{doc.page}")
        canv.restoreState()
    return drawer

def make_content_bg_drawer(scheme: dict, mark_path: str):
    def drawer(canv, doc):
        canv.saveState()
        W, H = A4
        canv.setFillColor(WHITE)
        canv.rect(0, 0, W, H, stroke=0, fill=1)

        # Footer on content page:
        # Left: STAMP wordmark in scheme's primary (or dark ink)
        mark_w = 54
        mark_h = 13.2
        canv.drawImage(mark_path, LEFT, 26, mark_w, mark_h, mask="auto", preserveAspectRatio=True)

        # Right: Page number in scheme's primary
        canv.setFillColor(scheme["primary"])
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 9)
        canv.drawRightString(W - RIGHT, 28, f"{doc.page}")
        canv.restoreState()
    return drawer
```

class CleanSectionPage(Flowable):
    def __init__(self, title: str, subtitle: str, scheme: dict):
        super().__init__()
        self.title = title
        self.subtitle = subtitle
        self.scheme = scheme

    def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        self.avail_width = avail_width
        self.avail_height = avail_height
        return avail_width, avail_height

    def draw(self):
        canv = self.canv
        W = self.avail_width
        H = self.avail_height

        # Position title and subtitle in upper-middle area
        y_anchor = H * 0.60

        # Title: Primary colored
        canv.setFillColor(self.scheme["primary"])
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 36)
        canv.drawString(0, y_anchor, self.title)

        # Subtitle: Short, also Primary colored (no line between them)
        if self.subtitle:
            canv.setFillColor(self.scheme["primary"])
            canv.setFont("Manrope-Semi", 16)
            canv.drawString(0, y_anchor - 32, self.subtitle)

```
count is outside 1,500–2,500.

- Minimalist Cover Page: Deep Night Ink (#240340) with centered STAMP wordmark,

class SolidParagraph(Paragraph):
    """Do not split a short paragraph containing a URL awkwardly across pages."""

    def split(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        _width, height = self.wrap(avail_width, avail_height)
        if height <= avail_height:
            return [self]
        if avail_height > 680:
            return Paragraph.split(self, avail_width, avail_height)
        return []

def parse_copy(text: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Return sections of prose, figure, and row blocks."""
    sections: list[dict] = []
    current: dict | None = None
    prose: list[str] = []
    lines = text.splitlines()
    index = 0

    def flush() -> None:
        nonlocal prose
        if current is None:
            prose = []
            return
        chunk = "\n".join(prose).strip()
        prose = []
        if chunk:
            current["blocks"].append(("prose", chunk))

    while index < len(lines):
        line = lines[index]
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("## "):
            flush()
            current = {"title": stripped[3:].strip(), "blocks": []}
            sections.append(current)
            index += 1
            continue
        if stripped == ":::figure":
            flush()
            if current is None:
                raise SystemExit("figure block before any section")
            index += 1
            fields: dict[str, str] = {}
            while index < len(lines) and lines[index].strip() != ":::":
                raw = lines[index].strip()
                if ":" in raw:
                    key, value = raw.split(":", 1)
                    fields[key.strip()] = value.strip()
                index += 1
            current["blocks"].append(("figure", fields))
            index += 1
            continue
        if stripped == ":::row":
            flush()
            if current is None:
                raise SystemExit("row block before any section")
            index += 1
            items: list[dict[str, str]] = []
            pending: dict[str, str] = {}
            while index < len(lines) and lines[index].strip() != ":::":
                raw = lines[index].strip()
                if raw.startswith("src:"):
                    if pending.get("src") and pending.get("caption"):
                        items.append(pending)
                    pending = {"src": raw.split(":", 1)[1].strip()}
                elif raw.startswith("caption:"):
                    pending["caption"] = raw.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                index += 1
            if pending.get("src") and pending.get("caption"):
                items.append(pending)
            current["blocks"].append(("row", items))
            index += 1
            continue
        if stripped.startswith("# "):
            index += 1
            continue
        prose.append(line)
        index += 1
    flush()
    return sections


def prose_word_counts(sections: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, dict[str, int]]:
    per: dict[str, int] = {}
    total = 0
    for section in sections:
        parts: list[str] = []
        for block in section["blocks"]:
            if block[0] != "prose":
                continue
            for line in block[1].splitlines():
                if line.strip().startswith("|"):
                    continue
                parts.append(line)
        raw = "\n".join(parts)
        raw = re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)", r"\1", raw)
        raw = raw.replace("**", "").replace("*", "").replace("`", "")
        words = raw.split()
        per[section["title"]] = len(words)
        total += len(words)
    return total, per


def xml_text(text: str) -> str:
    text = text.replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;")

    def soften(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        url = match.group(0)
        plain = url.replace("&amp;", "&")
        limit = 480

        def wide(value: str) -> float:
            return pdfmetrics.stringWidth(value, "Manrope", 10.0)

        if wide(plain) <= limit:
            return url
        pieces = url.split("/")
        lines: list[str] = []
        current = pieces[0]
        for piece in pieces[1:]:
            addition = "/" + piece
            trial = (current + addition).replace("&amp;", "&")
            if current and wide(trial) > limit:
                lines.append(current)
                current = addition
            else:
                current += addition
        if current:
            lines.append(current)
        return "<br/>".join(lines)

    text = re.sub(r"https?://[^\s<]+", soften, text)
    text = re.sub(r"\*\*([^*]+)\*\*", r"<b>\1</b>", text)
    return text


def body_paragraph(text: str, style: ParagraphStyle):
    xml = xml_text(text)
    kind = SolidParagraph if "http" in xml else Paragraph
    return kind(xml, style)


def prepare_image(src: Path, dest: Path) -> tuple[int, int]:
    image = PILImage.open(src)
    if image.mode in ("RGBA", "LA") or (image.mode == "P" and "transparency" in image.info):
        image = image.convert("RGBA")
        base = PILImage.new("RGBA", image.size, (248, 250, 252, 255))
        flat = PILImage.alpha_composite(base, image).convert("RGB")
    else:
        flat = image.convert("RGB")
    flat.save(dest, "PNG")
    return flat.size


def create_recolored_wordmark(src: Path, dest: Path, rgb: tuple[int, int, int]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Extract smooth, anti-aliased STAMP wordmark recolored to rgb."""
    img = PILImage.open(src).convert("RGBA")
    arr = np.array(img).astype(float)
    diff = np.sqrt(
        (arr[:, :, 0] - 226) ** 2
        + (arr[:, :, 1] - 75) ** 2
        + (arr[:, :, 2] - 255) ** 2
    )
    alpha = np.clip((diff - 20) / 60.0, 0, 1)
    out = np.zeros((img.height, img.width, 4), dtype=np.uint8)
    out[:, :, 0] = rgb[0]
    out[:, :, 1] = rgb[1]
    out[:, :, 2] = rgb[2]
    out[:, :, 3] = (alpha * 255).astype(np.uint8)
    res = PILImage.fromarray(out)
    bbox = res.getbbox()
    if bbox:
        pad = 20
        box = (
            max(0, bbox[0] - pad),
            max(0, bbox[1] - pad),
            min(img.width, bbox[2] + pad),
            min(img.height, bbox[3] + pad),
        )
        cropped = res.crop(box)
    else:
        cropped = res
    cropped.save(dest, "PNG")
    return cropped.size

class MinimalCover(Flowable):
    """Ultra-minimalist cover page strictly matching user specifications."""

    def __init__(self, mark_path: str, px_w: int, px_h: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.mark_path = mark_path
        self.px_w = px_w
        self.px_h = px_h

    def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        self.avail_width = avail_width
        self.avail_height = avail_height
        return avail_width, avail_height

    def draw(self):
        canv = self.canv
        W = self.avail_width
        H = self.avail_height
        cx = W / 2

        # Centered STAMP Wordmark
        mark_w = 400
        mark_h = mark_w * self.px_h / self.px_w
        center_y = H / 2
        mark_y = center_y + 10
        mark_x = cx - mark_w / 2
        canv.drawImage(
            self.mark_path,
            mark_x,
            mark_y,
            mark_w,
            mark_h,
            mask="auto",
            preserveAspectRatio=True,
        )

        # Centered Tagline
        tag_y = mark_y - 36
        canv.setFillColor(HexColor("#E24BFF"))
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 24)
        canv.drawCentredString(cx, tag_y, "PEEL. PRESS. TOAST.")

        # Bottom text in white
        canv.setFillColor(white)
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Semi", 14)
        canv.drawCentredString(cx, 48, "Commercial Business Plan")


class CleanSectionPage(Flowable):
    """Dedicated full-bleed section divider page with primary title & subtitle."""

    def __init__(self, title: str, subtitle: str, scheme: dict):
        super().__init__()
        self.title = title
        self.subtitle = subtitle
        self.scheme = scheme

    def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        self.avail_width = avail_width
        self.avail_height = avail_height
        return avail_width, avail_height

    def draw(self):
        canv = self.canv
        H = self.avail_height

        # Position title and subtitle in upper-middle area
        y_anchor = H * 0.60

        # Title: Primary colored
        canv.setFillColor(self.scheme["primary"])
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 34)
        canv.drawString(0, y_anchor, self.title)

        # Subtitle: Short, also Primary colored (no line between them)
        if self.subtitle:
            canv.setFillColor(self.scheme["primary"])
            canv.setFont("Manrope-Semi", 15)
            canv.drawString(0, y_anchor - 30, self.subtitle)


class CleanFigureBlock(Flowable):
    """Clean frameless visual block on white canvas."""

    def __init__(self, path: str, caption: str, max_height: float, pref_width: float | None):
        super().__init__()
        self.path = path
        self.caption = caption
        self.max_height = max_height
        self.pref_width = pref_width
        with PILImage.open(path) as image:
            self.px_w, self.px_h = image.size

    def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        self.avail_width = avail_width
        card_w = avail_width if self.pref_width is None else min(avail_width, self.pref_width)
        pad = 12
        inner_w = card_w - 2 * pad
        inner_max_h = self.max_height - 35
        scale = min(inner_w / self.px_w, inner_max_h / self.px_h)
        self.draw_w = self.px_w * scale
        self.draw_h = self.px_h * scale

        self.card_w = self.draw_w + 2 * pad
        self.paragraph = Paragraph(xml_text(self.caption), styles()["cap"])
        _cw, self.cap_h = self.paragraph.wrap(self.card_w, 800)
        self.card_h = self.draw_h + pad + 6 + self.cap_h
        return avail_width, self.card_h

    def draw(self):
        canv = self.canv
        cx = (self.avail_width - self.card_w) / 2

        canv.saveState()
        # Light subtle card surface
        canv.setFillColor(HexColor("#F8FAFC"))
        canv.roundRect(cx, 0, self.card_w, self.card_h, 12, stroke=0, fill=1)

        img_x = cx + (self.card_w - self.draw_w) / 2
        img_y = self.cap_h + 8
        canv.drawImage(
            self.path,
            img_x,
            img_y,
            self.draw_w,
            self.draw_h,
            mask="auto",
            preserveAspectRatio=True,
        )

        self.paragraph.drawOn(canv, cx, 4)
        canv.restoreState()


class CleanImageRow(Flowable):
    """Clean row of frameless images on white canvas."""

    def __init__(self, items: list[tuple[str, str]], max_height: float):
        super().__init__()
        self.items = items
        self.max_height = max_height
        self.sizes = []
        for p, _c in items:
            with PILImage.open(p) as img:
                self.sizes.append(img.size)

    def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        count = len(self.items)
        gap = 14
        col_w = (avail_width - gap * (count - 1)) / count
        pad = 10
        inner_w = col_w - 2 * pad
        inner_max_h = self.max_height - 35
        self.cols = []
        row_h = 0
        cap_style = styles()["cap"]

        for (path, caption), (px_w, px_h) in zip(self.items, self.sizes):
            scale = min(inner_w / px_w, inner_max_h / px_h)
            draw_w = px_w * scale
            draw_h = px_h * scale
            paragraph = Paragraph(xml_text(caption), cap_style)
            _cw, cap_h = paragraph.wrap(col_w - 8, 800)
            card_h = draw_h + pad + 6 + cap_h
            row_h = max(row_h, card_h)
            self.cols.append((path, draw_w, draw_h, paragraph, cap_h, col_w, card_h))

        self.gap = gap
        self.avail_width = avail_width
        self.row_h = row_h
        return avail_width, row_h

    def draw(self):
        canv = self.canv
        x = 0
        for path, draw_w, draw_h, paragraph, cap_h, col_w, card_h in self.cols:
            cy = self.row_h - card_h
            canv.saveState()
            canv.setFillColor(HexColor("#F8FAFC"))
            canv.roundRect(x, cy, col_w, card_h, 12, stroke=0, fill=1)

            img_x = x + (col_w - draw_w) / 2
            img_y = cy + cap_h + 8
            canv.drawImage(
                path,
                img_x,
                img_y,
                draw_w,
                draw_h,
                mask="auto",
                preserveAspectRatio=True,
            )

            paragraph.drawOn(canv, x + 4, cy + 4)
            canv.restoreState()
            x += col_w + self.gap


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PAGE BACKGROUND DRAWERS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def draw_cover_bg(canv, _doc):
    canv.saveState()
    canv.setFillColor(HexColor("#240340"))
    canv.rect(0, 0, A4[0], A4[1], stroke=0, fill=1)
    canv.restoreState()


def make_section_bg_drawer(scheme: dict, mark_path: str):
    def drawer(canv, doc):
        canv.saveState()
        W, H = A4
        canv.setFillColor(scheme["secondary"])
        canv.rect(0, 0, W, H, stroke=0, fill=1)

        # Footer: STAMP wordmark on bottom left, page number on bottom right
        mark_w = 54
        mark_h = 13.2
        canv.drawImage(mark_path, LEFT, 26, mark_w, mark_h, mask="auto", preserveAspectRatio=True)

        canv.setFillColor(scheme["primary"])
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 9)
        canv.drawRightString(W - RIGHT, 28, f"{doc.page}")
        canv.restoreState()
    return drawer


def make_content_bg_drawer(scheme: dict, mark_path: str):
    def drawer(canv, doc):
        canv.saveState()
        W, H = A4
        canv.setFillColor(white)
        canv.rect(0, 0, W, H, stroke=0, fill=1)

        # Footer: STAMP wordmark in section primary on bottom left, page on right
        mark_w = 54
        mark_h = 13.2
        canv.drawImage(mark_path, LEFT, 26, mark_w, mark_h, mask="auto", preserveAspectRatio=True)

        canv.setFillColor(scheme["primary"])
        canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 9)
        canv.drawRightString(W - RIGHT, 28, f"{doc.page}")
        canv.restoreState()
    return drawer


def resolve_src(src: str) -> Path:
    path = Path(src)
    if not path.is_absolute():
        path = ROOT / path
    if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"missing or empty image: {path}")
    return path


def check_inputs(copy_text: str) -> None:
    if "WAIT_FOR_INPUT" in copy_text or "TODO" in copy_text:
        raise SystemExit("copy.md still has placeholders; PDF not written")
    missing = []
    for relative in REQUIRED_INPUTS:
        path = ROOT / relative
        if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
            missing.append(relative)
    if missing:
        raise SystemExit("missing inputs, PDF not written: " + ", ".join(missing))


def visual_flowables(kind: str, payload, work: Path) -> list:
    if kind == "figure":
        src = resolve_src(payload["src"])
        caption = payload.get("caption", "").strip()
        if not caption:
            raise SystemExit(f"figure missing a caption: {src}")
        flat = work / f"fig-{len(list(work.iterdir()))}.png"
        prepare_image(src, flat)
        pref = float(payload["width"]) if payload.get("width") else None
        max_h = float(payload["max-height"]) if payload.get("max-height") else 380
        return [
            Spacer(1, 6),
            CleanFigureBlock(str(flat), caption, max_h, pref),
            Spacer(1, 10),
        ]
    if kind == "row":
        prepared = []
        for item in payload:
            src = resolve_src(item["src"])
            flat = work / f"row-{len(list(work.iterdir()))}.png"
            prepare_image(src, flat)
            prepared.append((str(flat), item["caption"]))
        return [Spacer(1, 6), CleanImageRow(prepared, 220), Spacer(1, 10)]
    raise SystemExit(f"unknown block {kind}")


def build_story(sections: list[dict], work: Path, marks: dict[str, tuple[str, int, int]]) -> list:
    story: list = []

    # 1. Cover Page
    cover_path, px_w, px_h = marks["yeast"]
    story.append(MinimalCover(cover_path, px_w, px_h))

    # 2. Iterate each section
    for sec_idx, section in enumerate(sections):
        scheme = SCHEMES[sec_idx % len(SCHEMES)]
        scheme_id = scheme["id"]
        meta = SECTION_METADATA.get(section["title"], {
            "title": section["title"],
            "subtitle": "",
        })

        # Section Divider Page (dedicated full-bleed colored divider)
        story.append(NextPageTemplate(f"section_{scheme_id}"))
        story.append(PageBreak())
        story.append(CleanSectionPage(
            title=meta["title"],
            subtitle=meta["subtitle"],
            scheme=scheme,
        ))

        # Switch to Content Page Template for this section
        story.append(NextPageTemplate(f"content_{scheme_id}"))
        story.append(PageBreak())

        # Section Heading on Content Page
        title_style = ParagraphStyle(
            f"title_{scheme_id}",
            fontName="Manrope-Bold",
            fontSize=20,
            leading=25,
            textColor=scheme["primary"],
            spaceBefore=0,
            spaceAfter=14,
            alignment=TA_LEFT,
        )
        story.append(Paragraph(xml_text(meta["title"]), title_style))

        # Process Section Blocks
        pending = None
        for index, (kind, payload) in enumerate(section["blocks"]):
            if kind == "prose":
                if pending is not None:
                    story.append(pending)
                    pending = None
                paragraphs = [part.strip() for part in payload.split("\n\n") if part.strip()]
                nxt = (
                    section["blocks"][index + 1][0]
                    if index + 1 < len(section["blocks"])
                    else ""
                )
                hold = nxt in {"figure", "row"} and len(paragraphs) > 0
                body = paragraphs[:-1] if hold else paragraphs
                for part in body:
                    story.append(body_paragraph(part, styles()["body"]))
                if hold:
                    pending = body_paragraph(paragraphs[-1], styles()["body"])
                continue

            visuals = visual_flowables(kind, payload, work)
            if pending is not None:
                story.append(KeepTogether([pending, *visuals]))
                pending = None
            else:
                story.extend(visuals)

        if pending is not None:
            story.append(pending)

    return story


def main() -> int:
    if not COPY_PATH.is_file() or COPY_PATH.stat().st_size == 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"missing copy: {COPY_PATH}")
    copy_text = COPY_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    check_inputs(copy_text)
    sections = parse_copy(copy_text)
    if not sections:
        raise SystemExit("copy.md has no sections")
    total, per_section = prose_word_counts(sections)
    for title, count in per_section.items():
        print(f"{count:4d}  {title}")
    print(f"{total:4d}  TOTAL")
    if total < MIN_WORDS or total > MAX_WORDS:
        print(
            f"error: prose word count {total} is outside {MIN_WORDS}–{MAX_WORDS}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        return 1

    register_fonts()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="stamp-plan-") as temporary:
        work = Path(temporary)
        
        # Generate recolored anti-aliased wordmarks for each scheme
        marks: dict[str, tuple[str, int, int]] = {}
        for s in SCHEMES:
            mark_p = work / f"mark_{s['id']}.png"
            w, h = create_recolored_wordmark(ROOT / "brand" / "logo.png", mark_p, s["rgb"])
            marks[s["id"]] = (str(mark_p), w, h)

        tmp_out = work / "plan.pdf"
        frame_h = A4[1] - FRAME_BOTTOM - FRAME_TOP
        frame_w = A4[0] - LEFT - RIGHT

        document = BaseDocTemplate(
            str(tmp_out),
            pagesize=A4,
            title="STAMP Commercial Business Plan",
            author="Jacob",
        )

        full_frame = Frame(LEFT, FRAME_BOTTOM, frame_w, frame_h, id="full", showBoundary=0)
        content_frame = Frame(LEFT, FRAME_BOTTOM, frame_w, frame_h, id="content", showBoundary=0)

        templates = [
            PageTemplate(id="cover", frames=[full_frame], onPage=draw_cover_bg)
        ]
        for s in SCHEMES:
            sid = s["id"]
            mark_path = marks[sid][0]
            templates.append(
                PageTemplate(
                    id=f"section_{sid}",
                    frames=[full_frame],
                    onPage=make_section_bg_drawer(s, mark_path),
                )
            )
            templates.append(
                PageTemplate(
                    id=f"content_{sid}",
                    frames=[content_frame],
                    onPage=make_content_bg_drawer(s, mark_path),
                )
            )
        document.addPageTemplates(templates)

        story = build_story(sections, work, marks)
        document.build(story)
        OUT_PATH.write_bytes(tmp_out.read_bytes())

    print(f"Successfully generated {OUT_PATH} ({OUT_PATH.stat().st_size:,} bytes)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```bash
$ python3 -c '
from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet, ParagraphStyle
from reportlab.lib.colors import HexColor, white
from reportlab.platypus.flowables import Flowable
from PIL import Image as PILImage
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4
from reportlab.lib.enums import TA_CENTER, TA_LEFT

# Create a test script to render CleanFigureBlock with bolder styling
class BoldFigureBlock(Flowable):
    def __init__(self, path: str, caption: str, max_height: float, scheme: dict):
        super().__init__()
        self.path = path
        self.caption = caption
        self.max_height = max_height
        self.scheme = scheme
        with PILImage.open(path) as image:
            self.px_w, self.px_h = image.size

    def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        self.avail_width = avail_width
        pad = 14
        inner_w = avail_width - 2 * pad
        inner_max_h = self.max_height - 40
        scale = min(inner_w / self.px_w, inner_max_h / self.px_h)
        self.draw_w = self.px_w * scale
        self.draw_h = self.px_h * scale
        self.card_w = avail_width

        cap_style = ParagraphStyle(
            "bcap",
            fontName="Helvetica-Bold",
            fontSize=8.8,
            leading=12.5,
            textColor=HexColor("#1E293B"),
            alignment=TA_CENTER
        )
        self.paragraph = Paragraph(self.caption, cap_style)
        _w, self.cap_h = self.paragraph.wrap(self.card_w - 28, 800)
        self.card_h = self.draw_h + pad + 16 + self.cap_h + 6
        return avail_width, self.card_h

    def draw(self):
        canv = self.canv
        W = self.card_w
        H = self.card_h
        r = 12

        canv.saveState()
        # 1. Solid bold tinted surface (visibly distinct from white)
        canv.setFillColor(HexColor("#EEF2F6"))
        canv.roundRect(0, 0, W, H, r, stroke=0, fill=1)

        # 2. Bold top accent bar in primary color
        canv.setFillColor(self.scheme["primary"])
        # Draw rounded top or pill bar
        bar_h = 5
        canv.roundRect(0, H - bar_h, W, bar_h, 2.5, stroke=0, fill=1)

        # 3. Image
        img_x = (W - self.draw_w) / 2
        img_y = self.cap_h + 12
        canv.drawImage(self.path, img_x, img_y, self.draw_w, self.draw_h, mask="auto", preserveAspectRatio=True)

        # 4. Caption
        self.paragraph.drawOn(canv, 14, 8)
        canv.restoreState()

doc = SimpleDocTemplate("/tmp/test_bold_container.pdf", pagesize=A4, leftMargin=48, rightMargin=48, topMargin=50, bottomMargin=54)
scheme = {"primary": HexColor("#E24BFF"), "secondary": HexColor("#240340")}
story = [
    BoldFigureBlock("/tmp/test_chart_1.png", "<b>Figure 1:</b> Cleaned New Zealand supermarket scan data shows the spreads category expanding from $275M to $341M NZD (2022 vs 2025).", 280, scheme)
]
doc.build(story)
print("Built /tmp/test_bold_container.pdf")
'
```

```bash
$ python3 -c '
import pypdf
from reportlab.platypus import Paragraph, SimpleDocTemplate
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet
import re
from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont

pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("Manrope", "brand/fonts/Manrope-400.ttf"))

def xml_text(text: str) -> str:
    text = text.replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;")

    def soften(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        url = match.group(0)
        punct = ""
        while url and url[-1] in ".,;:!?)":
            punct = url[-1] + punct
            url = url[:-1]
            
        plain = url.replace("&amp;", "&")
        limit = 480

        def wide(value: str) -> float:
            return pdfmetrics.stringWidth(value, "Manrope", 10.0)

        if wide(plain) <= limit:
            return f"<a href=\"{url}\" color=\"#6D28D9\"><u>{url}</u></a>{punct}"
        pieces = url.split("/")
        lines: list[str] = []
        current = pieces[0]
        for piece in pieces[1:]:
            addition = "/" + piece
            trial = (current + addition).replace("&amp;", "&")
            if current and wide(trial) > limit:
                lines.append(current)
                current = addition
            else:
                current += addition
        if current:
            lines.append(current)
        display = "<br/>".join(lines)
        return f"<a href=\"{url}\" color=\"#6D28D9\"><u>{display}</u></a>{punct}"

    text = re.sub(r"https?://[^\s<]+", soften, text)
    text = re.sub(r"\*\*([^*]+)\*\*", r"<b>\1</b>", text)
    return text

doc = SimpleDocTemplate("/tmp/test_soften.pdf")
styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
p1 = Paragraph(xml_text("Fix & Fogg: https://www.newworld.co.nz/shop/product/5267959_ea_000nw?name=fix--fogg-smooth-peanut-butter. Great product!"), styles["Normal"])
p2 = Paragraph(xml_text("Visit https://stamp-spreads.vercel.app and https://github.com/JacobCrume/stamp-spreads."), styles["Normal"])
doc.build([p1, p2])

reader = pypdf.PdfReader("/tmp/test_soften.pdf")
page = reader.pages[0]
print("Total annotations:", len(page.get("/Annots", [])))
for a in page.get("/Annots", []):
    print("Link URI:", a.get_object().get("/A").get("/URI"))
'
```

```
"""Market figures for the Stamp commercial business plan.

Figures are branded strictly following Stamp's visual identity:
- Manrope typography (Bold, Semi, Medium)
- Stamp brand palette: Deep Night Ink (#240340), Deep Solid Purple (#3B0764),
  Electric Lavender (#E24BFF), Wild Raspberry (#FF467A), Roasted Peanut (#FF8C30),
  Electric Butter (#FFD640)
- High-contrast, clean minimalist layout with subtle grids and bold data callouts
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.font_manager as fm
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "figures"
DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "sales-clean.csv"
FONT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "brand" / "fonts"

# Register Manrope fonts with Matplotlib
for weight in ["400", "500", "600", "700"]:
    font_file = FONT_DIR / f"Manrope-{weight}.ttf"
    if font_file.is_file():
        fm.fontManager.addfont(str(font_file))

plt.rcParams["font.family"] = "Manrope"

CATEGORY_ORDER = [
    "Breakfast Cereals",
    "Nutritional Cereal Bars",
    "Spreads",
    "Liquid Breakfasts",
]

TIER_ORDER = ["Value", "Standard", "Premium"]

BRAND_COLOURS = {
    "Breakfast Cereals": "#3B0764",       # Deep Solid Purple
    "Nutritional Cereal Bars": "#FF8C30", # Peanut Ochre
    "Spreads": "#E24BFF",                 # Electric Lavender (highlighted)
    "Liquid Breakfasts": "#FF467A",       # Wild Raspberry
    "2022": "#3B0764",                    # Deep Solid Purple
    "2025": "#E24BFF",                    # Electric Lavender
}


def quarterly_revenue(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    quarters = sorted(frame["Date"].unique())
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 5.2), dpi=200)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor("white")
    ax.set_facecolor("white")

    for category in CATEGORY_ORDER:
        part = frame[frame["Category"] == category]
        series = (
            part.groupby("Date")["Revenue (Thousands NZD)"].sum().reindex(quarters).fillna(0)
            / 1000
        )
        is_spreads = category == "Spreads"
        ax.plot(
            quarters,
            series.values,
            label=f"{category} (Focus)" if is_spreads else category,
            color=BRAND_COLOURS[category],
            linewidth=3.2 if is_spreads else 1.8,
            alpha=1.0 if is_spreads else 0.75,
            zorder=5 if is_spreads else 3,
        )

    ax.set_title(
        "Quarterly Breakfast Category Revenue in New Zealand (2022–2025)",
        fontsize=13.5,
        fontweight="bold",
        color="#240340",
        pad=16,
    )
    ax.set_ylabel("Revenue (Million NZD)", fontsize=10.5, fontweight="bold", color="#475569", labelpad=10)
    ax.set_xlabel("Quarter", fontsize=10.5, fontweight="bold", color="#475569", labelpad=10)

    legend = ax.legend(
        frameon=True,
        facecolor="#F8FAFC",
        edgecolor="#E2E8F0",
        fontsize=9.5,
        loc="upper left",
    )
    for text in legend.get_texts():
        text.set_color("#1A1024")
        text.set_fontweight("bold")

    ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelrotation=45, colors="#475569", labelsize=9)
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", colors="#64748B", labelsize=9.5)
    ax.grid(axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.4, color="#CBD5E1", zorder=0)
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["left"].set_color("#E2E8F0")
    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#CBD5E1")

    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(OUT / "01-quarterly-revenue-by-category.png", dpi=200)
    plt.close(fig)


def tier_comparison(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    spreads = frame[frame["Category"] == "Spreads"].copy()
    spreads["year"] = spreads["Date"].str.slice(0, 4)
    part = spreads[spreads["year"].isin(["2022", "2025"])]
    totals = (
        part.groupby(["year", "Price Tier"])["Revenue (Thousands NZD)"].sum().unstack("year")
        / 1000
    )
    totals = totals.reindex(TIER_ORDER)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5, 4.8), dpi=200)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor("white")
    ax.set_facecolor("white")

    positions = np.arange(len(TIER_ORDER))
    width = 0.35

    rects1 = ax.bar(
        positions - width / 2,
        totals["2022"],
        width=width,
        label="2022 Revenue",
        color=BRAND_COLOURS["2022"],
        edgecolor="none",
        zorder=3,
    )
    rects2 = ax.bar(
        positions + width / 2,
        totals["2025"],
        width=width,
        label="2025 Revenue",
        color=BRAND_COLOURS["2025"],
        edgecolor="none",
        zorder=3,
    )

    # Direct value annotations above each bar
    for rect in rects1:
        h = rect.get_height()
        ax.annotate(
            f"${h:.1f}M",
            (rect.get_x() + rect.get_width() / 2, h),
            xytext=(0, 5),
            textcoords="offset points",
            ha="center",
            va="bottom",
            fontsize=9.5,
            fontweight="bold",
            color="#3B0764",
        )

    for rect in rects2:
        h = rect.get_height()
        ax.annotate(
            f"${h:.1f}M",
            (rect.get_x() + rect.get_width() / 2, h),
            xytext=(0, 5),
            textcoords="offset points",
            ha="center",
            va="bottom",
            fontsize=9.5,
            fontweight="bold",
            color="#A21CAF",
        )

    ax.set_xticks(positions)
    ax.set_xticklabels(TIER_ORDER, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", color="#1A1024")
    ax.set_ylabel("Revenue (Million NZD)", fontsize=10.5, fontweight="bold", color="#475569", labelpad=10)
    ax.set_title(
        "New Zealand Spreads Category Revenue by Price Tier (2022 vs 2025)",
        fontsize=13,
        fontweight="bold",
        color="#240340",
        pad=16,
    )

    ax.grid(axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.4, color="#CBD5E1", zorder=0)
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["left"].set_color("#E2E8F0")
    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#CBD5E1")
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", colors="#64748B", labelsize=9.5)
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", colors="#1A1024", length=0)
    ax.set_ylim(0, max(totals.max()) * 1.18)

    legend = ax.legend(
        frameon=True,
        facecolor="#F8FAFC",
        edgecolor="#E2E8F0",
        fontsize=9.5,
        loc="upper left",
    )
    for text in legend.get_texts():
        text.set_color("#1A1024")
        text.set_fontweight("bold")

    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(OUT / "02-spreads-revenue-by-tier-2022-vs-2025.png", dpi=200)
    plt.close(fig)


def price_distribution(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    spreads = frame[
        (frame["Category"] == "Spreads")
        & (frame["Market Segment"] == "Branded")
        & frame["price_usable"]
        & frame["price_per_100g"].notna()
    ].copy()

    sku = spreads.groupby(["Product Name", "Brand", "Weight"], as_index=False)[
        "price_per_100g"
    ].median()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5, 4.8), dpi=200)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor("white")
    ax.set_facecolor("white")

    # Histogram with Stamp brand colors
    n, bins, patches = ax.hist(
        sku["price_per_100g"],
        bins=26,
        color="#240340",
        edgecolor="white",
        linewidth=1.2,
        zorder=3,
    )

    for patch in patches:
        if patch.get_x() >= 5.0:
            patch.set_facecolor("#3B0764")

    # Stamp price line
    stamp_price = 6.25
    ax.axvline(stamp_price, color="#E24BFF", linestyle="-", linewidth=2.6, zorder=4)

    # 90th percentile benchmark line
    p90 = sku["price_per_100g"].quantile(0.9)
    ax.axvline(p90, color="#FF8C30", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.8, zorder=4)

    # Annotations
    ylim = ax.get_ylim()[1]
    ax.text(
        stamp_price + 0.15,
        ylim * 0.88,
        "STAMP: $6.25 / 100 g\nFormat Innovation Premium",
        fontsize=9.5,
        fontweight="bold",
        color="#A21CAF",
        va="top",
    )

    ax.text(
        p90 - 0.15,
        ylim * 0.72,
        f"90th Percentile: ${p90:.2f} / 100 g",
        fontsize=8.5,
        fontweight="bold",
        color="#C2410C",
        ha="right",
        va="top",
    )

    ax.set_xlabel("Shelf Price per 100 g (NZD)", fontsize=10.5, fontweight="bold", color="#475569", labelpad=8)
    ax.set_ylabel("Number of Branded Spread SKUs", fontsize=10.5, fontweight="bold", color="#475569", labelpad=8)
    ax.set_title(
        "Shelf Price Distribution Across 154 Branded New Zealand Spread SKUs",
        fontsize=13,
        fontweight="bold",
        color="#240340",
        pad=16,
    )

    ax.grid(axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.4, color="#CBD5E1", zorder=0)
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["left"].set_color("#E2E8F0")
    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#CBD5E1")
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", colors="#64748B", labelsize=9.5)
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", colors="#1A1024", labelsize=9.5)

    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(OUT / "03-branded-spreads-price-per-100g.png", dpi=200)
    plt.close(fig)

    quantiles = sku["price_per_100g"].quantile([0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9])
    print("branded spread SKUs", len(sku))
    print(quantiles.to_string())
    print("min", round(sku["price_per_100g"].min(), 2), "max", round(sku["price_per_100g"].max(), 2))


def main() -> None:
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    frame = pd.read_csv(DATA)
    quarterly_revenue(frame)
    tier_comparison(frame)
    price_distribution(frame)
    print("Successfully regenerated branded figures in data/figures/")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```
class SolidParagraph(Paragraph):
    """Do not split a short paragraph containing a URL awkwardly across pages."""

    def split(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        _width, height = self.wrap(avail_width, avail_height)
        if height <= avail_height:
            return [self]
        if avail_height > 680:
            return Paragraph.split(self, avail_width, avail_height)
        return []

def parse_copy(text: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Return sections of prose, figure, and row blocks."""
    sections: list[dict] = []
    current: dict | None = None
    prose: list[str] = []
    lines = text.splitlines()
    index = 0

    def flush() -> None:
        nonlocal prose
        if current is None:
            prose = []
            return
        chunk = "\n".join(prose).strip()
        prose = []
        if chunk:
            current["blocks"].append(("prose", chunk))

    while index < len(lines):
        line = lines[index]
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("## "):
            flush()
            current = {"title": stripped[3:].strip(), "blocks": []}
            sections.append(current)
            index += 1
            continue
        if stripped == ":::figure":
            flush()
            if current is None:
                raise SystemExit("figure block before any section")
            index += 1
            fields: dict[str, str] = {}
            while index < len(lines) and lines[index].strip() != ":::":
                raw = lines[index].strip()
                if ":" in raw:
                    key, value = raw.split(":", 1)
                    fields[key.strip()] = value.strip()
                index += 1
            current["blocks"].append(("figure", fields))
            index += 1
            continue
        if stripped == ":::row":
            flush()
            if current is None:
                raise SystemExit("row block before any section")
            index += 1
            items: list[dict[str, str]] = []
            pending: dict[str, str] = {}
            while index < len(lines) and lines[index].strip() != ":::":
                raw = lines[index].strip()
                if raw.startswith("src:"):
                    if pending.get("src") and pending.get("caption"):
                        items.append(pending)
                    pending = {"src": raw.split(":", 1)[1].strip()}
                elif raw.startswith("caption:"):
                    pending["caption"] = raw.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                index += 1
            if pending.get("src") and pending.get("caption"):
                items.append(pending)
            current["blocks"].append(("row", items))
            index += 1
            continue
        if stripped.startswith("# "):
            index += 1
            continue
        prose.append(line)
        index += 1
    flush()
    return sections


def prose_word_counts(sections: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, dict[str, int]]:
    per: dict[str, int] = {}
    total = 0
    for section in sections:
        parts: list[str] = []
        for block in section["blocks"]:
            if block[0] != "prose":
                continue
            for line in block[1].splitlines():
                if line.strip().startswith("|"):
                    continue
                parts.append(line)
        raw = "\n".join(parts)
        raw = re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)", r"\1", raw)
        raw = raw.replace("**", "").replace("*", "").replace("`", "")
        words = raw.split()
        per[section["title"]] = len(words)
        total += len(words)
    return total, per


def xml_text(text: str) -> str:
    text = text.replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;")

    def soften(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        url = match.group(0)
        punct = ""
        while url and url[-1] in ".,;:!?)":
            punct = url[-1] + punct
            url = url[:-1]

        plain = url.replace("&amp;", "&")
        limit = 480

        def wide(value: str) -> float:
            return pdfmetrics.stringWidth(value, "Manrope", 10.0)

        if wide(plain) <= limit:
            return f'<a href="{url}" color="#6D28D9"><u>{url}</u></a>{punct}'
        pieces = url.split("/")
        lines: list[str] = []
        current = pieces[0]
        for piece in pieces[1:]:
            addition = "/" + piece
            trial = (current + addition).replace("&amp;", "&")
            if current and wide(trial) > limit:
                lines.append(current)
                current = addition
            else:
                current += addition
        if current:
            lines.append(current)
        display = "<br/>".join(lines)
        return f'<a href="{url}" color="#6D28D9"><u>{display}</u></a>{punct}'

    # Make raw URLs clickable hyperlinks
    text = re.sub(r"https?://[^\s<]+", soften, text)
    # Bold text
    text = re.sub(r"\*\*([^*]+)\*\*", r"<b>\1</b>", text)
    return text


def body_paragraph(text: str, style: ParagraphStyle):
    xml = xml_text(text)
    kind = SolidParagraph if "http" in xml else Paragraph
    return kind(xml, style)


def prepare_image(src: Path, dest: Path) -> tuple[int, int]:
    image = PILImage.open(src)
    if image.mode in ("RGBA", "LA") or (image.mode == "P" and "transparency" in image.info):
        image = image.convert("RGBA")
        base = PILImage.new("RGBA", image.size, (238, 242, 246, 255))
        flat = PILImage.alpha_composite(base, image).convert("RGB")
    else:
        flat = image.convert("RGB")
    flat.save(dest, "PNG")
    return flat.size


def create_recolored_wordmark(src: Path, dest: Path, rgb: tuple[int, int, int]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Extract smooth, anti-aliased STAMP wordmark recolored to rgb."""
    img = PILImage.open(src).convert("RGBA")
    arr = np.array(img).astype(float)
    diff = np.sqrt(
        (arr[:, :, 0] - 226) ** 2
        + (arr[:, :, 1] - 75) ** 2
        + (arr[:, :, 2] - 255) ** 2
    )
    alpha = np.clip((diff - 20) / 60.0, 0, 1)
    out = np.zeros((img.height, img.width, 4), dtype=np.uint8)
    out[:, :, 0] = rgb[0]
    out[:, :, 1] = rgb[1]
    out[:, :, 2] = rgb[2]
    out[:, :, 3] = (alpha * 255).astype(np.uint8)
    res = PILImage.fromarray(out)
    bbox = res.getbbox()
    if bbox:
        pad = 20
        box = (
            max(0, bbox[0] - pad),
            max(0, bbox[1] - pad),
            min(img.width, bbox[2] + pad),
            min(img.height, bbox[3] + pad),
        )
        cropped = res.crop(box)
    else:
        cropped = res
    cropped.save(dest, "PNG")
    return cropped.size
```
